+  scale: { weight: 0.15, label: '基金规模', description: '规模越大越稳定，100亿以上边际递减' },
+  momentum: { weight: 0.20, label: '动量因子', description: '近期涨幅加权，越近权重越高' },
+  valuation: { weight: 0.20, label: '估值', description: '基于行业估值分位数，低估加分' },
+};
+
+// GET /api/stock-picker/factors
+router.get('/api/stock-picker/factors', authMiddleware, subscriptionMiddleware, (req, res) => {
+  res.json({ factors: DEFAULT_FACTORS });
+});
+
+// POST /api/stock-picker/rank
+router.post('/api/stock-picker/rank', authMiddleware, subscriptionMiddleware, async (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const { industry, type, limit = 30, factors: userFactors } = req.body;
+    const pool = getPool();
+    const factors = userFactors || DEFAULT_FACTORS;
+
+    // 查询基金+最新净值
+    let query = `
+      SELECT f.code, f.name, f.type, f.industry, f.total_fee, f.scale, f.valuation, f.rating,
+             f.management_fee, f.custody_fee, f.service_fee, f.manager,
+             n.nav, n.return_1w, n.return_1m, n.return_3m, n.return_6m, n.return_1y
+      FROM funds f
+      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
+        SELECT nav, return_1w, return_1m, return_3m, return_6m, return_1y
+        FROM fund_nav WHERE fund_code = f.code ORDER BY nav_date DESC LIMIT 1
+      ) n ON true
+      WHERE n.nav IS NOT NULL
+    `;
+    const params = [];
+    if (industry) { params.push(industry); query += ` AND f.industry = $${params.length}`; }
+    if (type) { params.push(type); query += ` AND f.type = $${params.length}`; }
+    const result = await pool.query(query, params);
+    const funds = result.rows;
+
+    // 评分函数
+    function scoreFund(fund) {
+      const breakdown = {};
+      const r1y = parseFloat(fund.return_1y) || 0;
+      const r6m = parseFloat(fund.return_6m) || 0;
+      const r3m = parseFloat(fund.return_3m) || 0;
+      const r1m = parseFloat(fund.return_1m) || 0;
+      const r1w = parseFloat(fund.return_1w) || 0;
+      const fee = parseFloat(fund.total_fee) || 0.6;
+      const scale = parseFloat(fund.scale) || 0;
+
+      // 收益得分：50%以上边际递减
+      const returnScore = r1y > 50 ? (50 + (r1y - 50) * 0.3) / 100 : r1y / 100;
+      breakdown.return1y = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, returnScore));
+
+      // 费率得分：越低越好，0.2%得1分，1.5%得0分
+      breakdown.fee = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (1.5 - fee) / 1.3));
+
+      // 规模得分：对数标准化
+      const logScale = scale > 0 ? Math.log10(scale) : 0;
+      breakdown.scale = Math.min(1, logScale / 3);
+
+      // 动量得分：近期加权（1周50% + 1月30% + 3月20%）
+      const momentumScore = (r1w * 0.5 + r1m * 0.3 + r3m * 0.2) / 20;
+      breakdown.momentum = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, momentumScore));
+
+      // 估值得分：基于行业估值
+      let valScore = 0.5;
+      if (fund.valuation === '低估') valScore = 0.9;
+      else if (fund.valuation === '合理') valScore = 0.6;
+      else if (fund.valuation === '高估') valScore = 0.2;
+      breakdown.valuation = valScore;
+
+      // 综合评分
+      let total = 0;
+      for (const [key, f] of Object.entries(factors)) {
+        if (breakdown[key] !== undefined && f.weight) {
+          total += breakdown[key] * f.weight;
+        }
+      }
+
+      // 推荐理由
+      const reasons = [];
+      if (breakdown.return1y > 0.6) reasons.push(`近1年收益${r1y.toFixed(1)}%表现优秀`);
+      if (breakdown.fee > 0.7) reasons.push(`综合费率${fee.toFixed(2)}%较低`);
+      if (breakdown.scale > 0.6) reasons.push(`规模${scale.toFixed(1)}亿稳定性好`);
+      if (breakdown.momentum > 0.5) reasons.push('近期动量强劲');
+      if (breakdown.valuation > 0.7) reasons.push('当前估值较低');
+      const reasoning = reasons.length > 0 ? reasons.join('；') : '综合指标均衡';
+
+      return { score: total, breakdown, reasoning };
+    }
+
+    // 评分排序
+    const ranked = funds.map(fund => {
+      const { score, breakdown, reasoning } = scoreFund(fund);
+      return {
+        fund: {
+          code: fund.code,
+          name: fund.name,
+          type: fund.type,
+          industry: fund.industry,
+          nav: parseFloat(fund.nav) || 0,
+          return1y: parseFloat(fund.return_1y) || 0,
+          return6m: parseFloat(fund.return_6m) || 0,
+          return3m: parseFloat(fund.return_3m) || 0,
+          return1m: parseFloat(fund.return_1m) || 0,
+          return1w: parseFloat(fund.return_1w) || 0,
+          totalFee: parseFloat(fund.total_fee) || 0,
+          mgmtFee: parseFloat(fund.management_fee) || 0,
+          custodyFee: parseFloat(fund.custody_fee) || 0,
+          scale: parseFloat(fund.scale) || 0,
+          rating: fund.rating,
+          manager: fund.manager || '',
+        },
+        score: Math.round(score * 1000) / 10,
+        breakdown: {
+          return1y: Math.round(breakdown.return1y * 100),
+          fee: Math.round(breakdown.fee * 100),
+          scale: Math.round(breakdown.scale * 100),
+          momentum: Math.round(breakdown.momentum * 100),
+          valuation: Math.round(breakdown.valuation * 100),
+        },
+        reasoning,
+      };
+    }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, limit);
+
+    // 行业统计
+    const industryStats = {};
+    ranked.forEach(r => {
+      const ind = r.fund.industry;
+      if (!industryStats[ind]) industryStats[ind] = { count: 0, totalScore: 0, avgReturn: 0, totalReturn: 0 };
+      industryStats[ind].count++;
+      industryStats[ind].totalScore += r.score;
+      industryStats[ind].totalReturn += r.fund.return1y;
+    });
+    Object.values(industryStats).forEach(s => {
+      s.avgScore = Math.round(s.totalScore / s.count * 10) / 10;
+      s.avgReturn = Math.round(s.totalReturn / s.count * 10) / 10;
+    });
+
+    res.json({ ranked, total: funds.length, factors, industryStats });
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error('AI选股失败:', e.message);
+    res.status(500).json({ error: '选股失败' });
+  }
+});
+
+// POST /api/stock-picker/backtest — 回测模拟（top N 等权组合 vs 沪深300）
+router.post('/api/stock-picker/backtest', authMiddleware, subscriptionMiddleware, async (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const { codes, days = 180 } = req.body;
+    if (!codes || !Array.isArray(codes) || codes.length === 0) {
+      return res.status(400).json({ error: '请提供基金代码' });
+    }
+    const pool = getPool();
+    const limit = Math.min(days, 365);
+
+    // 获取每只基金的净值历史
+    const fundHistories = {};
+    for (const code of codes.slice(0, 10)) {
+      const navRes = await pool.query(
+        'SELECT nav, nav_date FROM fund_nav WHERE fund_code = $1 ORDER BY nav_date DESC LIMIT $2',
+        [code, limit]
+      );
+      fundHistories[code] = navRes.rows.reverse();
+    }
+
+    // 获取沪深300基准（用 market_indices 里最近的价格，或从基金净值推算）
+    const hs300NavRes = await pool.query(
+      'SELECT nav, nav_date FROM fund_nav WHERE fund_code = $1 ORDER BY nav_date DESC LIMIT $2',
+      ['110020', limit] // 易方达沪深300ETF联接A
+    );
+    const hs300History = hs300NavRes.rows.reverse();
+
+    // 计算等权组合净值（归一化到100）
+    const allDates = new Set();
+    Object.values(fundHistories).forEach(h => h.forEach(r => allDates.add(r.nav_date.toISOString().slice(0, 10))));
+    hs300History.forEach(r => allDates.add(r.nav_date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)));
+    const sortedDates = [...allDates].sort();
+
+    // 为每只基金建立日期->净值映射
+    const fundMaps = {};
+    for (const [code, history] of Object.entries(fundHistories)) {
+      fundMaps[code] = {};
+      history.forEach(r => { fundMaps[code][r.nav_date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)] = parseFloat(r.nav); });
+    }
+    const hs300Map = {};
+    hs300History.forEach(r => { hs300Map[r.nav_date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)] = parseFloat(r.nav); });
+
+    // 找到所有基金都有数据的起始日期
+    const validCodes = Object.keys(fundHistories);
+    const startDate = sortedDates.find(date => validCodes.every(code => fundMaps[code][date]));
+    if (!startDate) return res.json({ dates: [], portfolio: [], benchmark: [], summary: null });
+
+    const startIdx = sortedDates.indexOf(startDate);
+    const activeDates = sortedDates.slice(startIdx);
+
+    // 计算组合和基准的归一化净值（起点=100）
+    const portfolio = [];
+    const benchmark = [];
+    const baseValues = {};
+    validCodes.forEach(code => { baseValues[code] = fundMaps[code][startDate]; });
+    const hs300Base = hs300Map[startDate] || 1;
+
+    for (const date of activeDates) {
+      // 等权组合
+      let avgReturn = 0;
+      let validCount = 0;
+      validCodes.forEach(code => {
+        if (fundMaps[code][date]) {
+          avgReturn += (fundMaps[code][date] / baseValues[code] - 1);
+          validCount++;
+        }
+      });
+      if (validCount > 0) {
+        portfolio.push({ date, value: 100 * (1 + avgReturn / validCount) });
+      }
+      // 基准
+      if (hs300Map[date]) {
+        benchmark.push({ date, value: 100 * (hs300Map[date] / hs300Base) });
+      }
+    }
+
+    // 计算摘要
+    const portReturn = portfolio.length > 1 ? (portfolio[portfolio.length - 1].value / 100 - 1) * 100 : 0;
+    const benchReturn = benchmark.length > 1 ? (benchmark[benchmark.length - 1].value / 100 - 1) * 100 : 0;
+    const alpha = portReturn - benchReturn;
+
+    // 最大回撤
+    let maxDD = 0, peak = 100;
+    portfolio.forEach(p => {
+      if (p.value > peak) peak = p.value;
+      const dd = (peak - p.value) / peak;
+      if (dd > maxDD) maxDD = dd;
+    });
+
+    // 胜率（组合跑赢基准的天数占比）
+    let winDays = 0;
+    const minLen = Math.min(portfolio.length, benchmark.length);
+    for (let i = 0; i < minLen; i++) {
+      if (portfolio[i].value > benchmark[i].value) winDays++;
+    }
+
+    res.json({
+      dates: portfolio.map(p => p.date),
+      portfolio: portfolio.map(p => Math.round(p.value * 100) / 100),
+      benchmark: benchmark.map(p => Math.round(p.value * 100) / 100),
+      summary: {
+        portReturn: Math.round(portReturn * 100) / 100,
+        benchReturn: Math.round(benchReturn * 100) / 100,
+        alpha: Math.round(alpha * 100) / 100,
+        maxDrawdown: Math.round(maxDD * 10000) / 100,
+        winRate: minLen > 0 ? Math.round(winDays / minLen * 100) : 0,
+        days: portfolio.length,
+        funds: validCodes.length,
+      },
+    });
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error('回测失败:', e.message);
+    res.status(500).json({ error: '回测失败' });
+  }
+});
+
+// POST /api/stock-picker/portfolio — 一键建仓建议
+router.post('/api/stock-picker/portfolio', authMiddleware, subscriptionMiddleware, async (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const { topN = 5, budget = 10000, strategy = 'balanced' } = req.body;
+    const pool = getPool();
+
+    // 复用选股逻辑获取 top N
+    const result = await pool.query(`
+      SELECT f.code, f.name, f.type, f.industry, f.total_fee, f.scale, f.valuation,
+             n.return_1y, n.return_1m, n.return_3m, n.return_1w
+      FROM funds f
+      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
+        SELECT return_1y, return_1m, return_3m, return_1w
+        FROM fund_nav WHERE fund_code = f.code ORDER BY nav_date DESC LIMIT 1
+      ) n ON true
+      WHERE n.return_1y IS NOT NULL
+      ORDER BY n.return_1y DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50
+    `);
+
+    // 简单评分选 top N
+    const scored = result.rows.map(f => {
+      const r1y = parseFloat(f.return_1y) || 0;
+      const fee = parseFloat(f.total_fee) || 0.6;
+      const scale = parseFloat(f.scale) || 0;
+      return {
+        code: f.code, name: f.name, industry: f.industry,
+        score: r1y * 0.4 + (1.5 - fee) * 20 + Math.log10(scale || 1) * 10,
+        return1y: r1y, totalFee: fee, scale,
+      };
+    }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, topN);
+
+    // 等权分配
+    const perFund = Math.round(budget / topN);
+    const allocation = scored.map(f => ({
+      ...f,
+      amount: perFund,
+      weight: Math.round(100 / topN),
+    }));
+
+    res.json({ allocation, totalBudget: budget, perFund, strategy });
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error('建仓建议失败:', e.message);
+    res.status(500).json({ error: '建仓建议失败' });
+  }
+});
+
+module.exports = router;

+// Rate limiting for order creation (5 per minute per user)
+const orderRateLimit = new Map();
+function checkOrderRateLimit(userId) {
+  const now = Date.now();
+  const record = orderRateLimit.get(userId) || { count: 0, resetTime: now + 60000 };
+  if (now > record.resetTime) { record.count = 0; record.resetTime = now + 60000; }
+  record.count++;
+  orderRateLimit.set(userId, record);
+  return record.count <= 5;
+}
+setInterval(() => { const now = Date.now(); for (const [uid, r] of orderRateLimit) { if (now > r.resetTime + 60000) orderRateLimit.delete(uid); } }, 5 * 60 * 1000);
+
+// POST /api/subscription/create-order — 需登录
+router.post('/api/subscription/create-order', authMiddleware, async (req, res) => {
+  if (!checkOrderRateLimit(req.user.id)) return res.status(429).json({ error: '创建订单过于频繁，请稍后再试' });
+  try {
+    const planId = req.body.planId || 1;
+    const order = await subService.createOrder(req.user.id, planId);
+
+    // 调用支付宝创建二维码
+    let qrCodeUrl = '';
+    let qrCodeBase64 = '';
+    try {
+      const alipayRes = await createPayment(order.out_trade_no, order.amount, `基金推荐助手-${order.plan_name}`);
+      const precreateRes = alipayRes.alipay_trade_precreate_response || alipayRes;
+      if (precreateRes.code === '10000' && precreateRes.qrCode) {
+        qrCodeUrl = precreateRes.qrCode;
+        qrCodeBase64 = await QRCode.toDataURL(qrCodeUrl, { width: 280, margin: 1 });
+      }
+    } catch (payErr) {
+      console.warn('支付宝预创建失败:', payErr.message);
+    }
+
+    res.json({
+      orderId: order.id,
+      outTradeNo: order.out_trade_no,
+      amount: order.amount,
+      planName: order.plan_name,
+      qrCodeUrl,
+      qrCodeBase64,
+    });
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error('创建订单失败:', e.message);
+    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message || '创建订单失败' });
+  }

+  try {
+    const { outTradeNo } = req.body;
+    if (!outTradeNo) return res.status(400).json({ error: '缺少订单号' });
+

+    const pool = require('../db.cjs').getPool();
+    const local = await pool.query('SELECT status FROM subscription_orders WHERE out_trade_no = $1 AND user_id = $2', [outTradeNo, req.user.id]);
+    if (local.rows.length > 0 && local.rows[0].status === 'paid') {
+      return res.json({ paid: true });
+    }
+
+    // 查支付宝
+    try {
+      const alipayRes = await queryPayment(outTradeNo);
+      const tradeRes = alipayRes.alipay_trade_query_response || alipayRes;
+      if (tradeRes.code === '10000' && (tradeRes.tradeStatus === 'TRADE_SUCCESS' || tradeRes.tradeStatus === 'TRADE_FINISHED')) {
+        const order = await pool.query('SELECT id FROM subscription_orders WHERE out_trade_no = $1', [outTradeNo]);
+        if (order.rows.length > 0) {
+          await subService.activateByTradeNo(outTradeNo, tradeRes.tradeNo || '');
+          return res.json({ paid: true });
+        }
+      }
+    } catch (queryErr) {
+      console.warn('支付宝查询失败:', queryErr.message);
+    }
+
+    res.json({ paid: false });
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error('查询订单失败:', e.message);

+      console.log(`[支付宝回调] 订单 ${params.out_trade_no} 支付成功`);
+    }
+    res.send('success');

+/**
+ * AI Context Provider - Injects live portfolio, market, and fund data into system prompt
+ * Optimized: parallel queries, single JOIN instead of N+1
+ */
+
+const { getPool } = require('../db.cjs');
+const fundService = require('../fund-service.cjs');
+
+function extractFundCodes(message) {
+  const codePattern = /\b(\d{6})\b/g;
+  const codes = [];
+  let match;
+  while ((match = codePattern.exec(message)) !== null) {
+    codes.push(match[1]);
+  }
+  return [...new Set(codes)];
+}
+
+async function buildContext(message, userId) {
+  const pool = getPool();
+  const fundCodes = extractFundCodes(message);
+  let context = '';
+
+  // 并行执行所有数据查询
+  const tasks = [];
+
+  // 1. 持仓数据（单次 JOIN 查询，不再 N+1）
+  if (userId) {
+    tasks.push(
+      pool.query(`
+        WITH latest_nav AS (
+          SELECT DISTINCT ON (fund_code)
+            fund_code, current_nav, market_value, pnl, pnl_percent, nav_updated_at
+          FROM fund_records
+          WHERE user_id = $1 AND record_type != 'sell'
+          ORDER BY fund_code, updated_at DESC
+        )
+        SELECT h.fund_code, h.fund_name, h.total_shares, h.total_cost,
+               n.current_nav, n.market_value, n.pnl, n.pnl_percent, n.nav_updated_at
+        FROM (
+          SELECT fund_code, fund_name,
+                 SUM(shares) as total_shares,
+                 SUM(shares * cost_price + buy_fee) as total_cost
+          FROM fund_records
+          WHERE user_id = $1 AND record_type != 'sell'
+          GROUP BY fund_code, fund_name
+          HAVING SUM(shares) > 0
+        ) h
+        LEFT JOIN latest_nav n ON n.fund_code = h.fund_code
+        ORDER BY n.market_value DESC NULLS LAST
+      `, [userId]).catch(() => ({ rows: [] }))
+    );
+  } else {
+    tasks.push(Promise.resolve({ rows: [] }));
+  }
+
+  // 2. 市场指数
+  tasks.push(
+    fundService.getMarketIndices().catch(() => [])
+  );
+
+  // 3. 行业数据
+  tasks.push(
+    pool.query(
+      `SELECT industry, COUNT(*) as count FROM funds WHERE industry IS NOT NULL AND industry != '' GROUP BY industry ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 15`
+    ).catch(() => ({ rows: [] }))
+  );
+
+  // 4. 已实现收益
+  if (userId) {
+    tasks.push(
+      pool.query(`
+        SELECT fund_name, SUM(realized_pnl) as realized_pnl
+        FROM fund_records
+        WHERE user_id = $1 AND record_type = 'sell' AND realized_pnl IS NOT NULL
+        GROUP BY fund_name
+      `, [userId]).catch(() => ({ rows: [] }))
+    );
+  } else {
+    tasks.push(Promise.resolve({ rows: [] }));
+  }
+
+  // 5. 具体基金详情（最多 3 只）
+  if (fundCodes.length > 0) {
+    tasks.push(
+      Promise.all(
+        fundCodes.slice(0, 3).map(code =>
+          fundService.getAllFundsWithNav({ search: code })
+            .then(result => {
+              const funds = result.data || result || [];
+              return funds.find(f => f.code === code) || funds[0] || null;
+            })
+            .catch(() => null)
+        )
+      )
+    );
+  } else {
+    tasks.push(Promise.resolve([]));
+  }
+
+  const [holdingsRes, indices, industriesRes, realizedRes, fundDetails] = await Promise.all(tasks);
+
+  // === 组装持仓上下文 ===
+  const holdings = holdingsRes.rows || [];
+  if (holdings.length > 0) {
+    const totalValue = holdings.reduce((s, h) => s + parseFloat(h.market_value || 0), 0);
+    const totalCost = holdings.reduce((s, h) => s + parseFloat(h.total_cost || 0), 0);
+    const totalPnl = totalValue - totalCost;
+    const totalReturn = totalCost > 0 ? (totalPnl / totalCost * 100) : 0;
+
+    context += `\n## 📦 用户当前持仓\n\n`;
+    context += `| 基金代码 | 基金名称 | 份额 | 成本价 | 现价 | 市值 | 收益 | 收益率 |\n`;
+    context += `|:--------:|---------|-----:|------:|-----:|-----:|-----:|------:|\n`;
+    for (const h of holdings) {
+      const shares = parseFloat(h.total_shares);
+      const cost = parseFloat(h.total_cost);
+      const nav = parseFloat(h.current_nav || 0);
+      const value = parseFloat(h.market_value || 0);
+      const pnl = parseFloat(h.pnl || 0);
+      const pnlPct = parseFloat(h.pnl_percent || 0);
+      context += `| ${h.fund_code} | ${h.fund_name} | ${shares.toFixed(2)} | ${cost > 0 ? (cost / shares).toFixed(4) : 'N/A'} | ${nav?.toFixed(4) || 'N/A'} | ${value.toFixed(2)} | ${pnl >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${pnl.toFixed(2)} | ${pnlPct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${pnlPct.toFixed(2)}% |\n`;
+    }
+    context += `\n**💰 持仓汇总**：总市值 **¥${totalValue.toFixed(2)}** | 总成本 **¥${totalCost.toFixed(2)}** | 总收益 **${totalPnl >= 0 ? '+' : ''}¥${totalPnl.toFixed(2)}**（**${totalReturn >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${totalReturn.toFixed(2)}%**）\n`;
+
+    if (holdings.length > 1) {
+      context += `\n**📊 持仓集中度**：\n`;
+      for (const h of holdings) {
+        const value = parseFloat(h.market_value || 0);
+        const weight = totalValue > 0 ? (value / totalValue * 100) : 0;
+        context += `- ${h.fund_name}：占比 **${weight.toFixed(1)}%**\n`;
+      }
+    }
+
+    // 已实现收益
+    const realizedRows = realizedRes.rows || [];
+    if (realizedRows.length > 0) {
+      const totalRealized = realizedRows.reduce((s, r) => s + parseFloat(r.realized_pnl || 0), 0);
+      context += `\n**💎 已实现收益**：${totalRealized >= 0 ? '+' : ''}¥${totalRealized.toFixed(2)}\n`;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // === 组装市场指数上下文 ===
+  if (indices && indices.length > 0) {
+    context += `\n## 📈 大盘指数行情\n\n`;
+    context += `| 指数名称 | 最新价 | 涨跌幅 | PE分位 | 估值状态 |\n`;
+    context += `|:--------:|------:|------:|------:|:------:|\n`;
+    for (const idx of indices) {
+      const icon = (idx.changePercent || 0) >= 0 ? '🔴' : '🟢';
+      const pe = idx.pePercentile != null ? `${idx.pePercentile}%` : '-';
+      context += `| ${idx.name} | ${idx.price?.toFixed(2) || '-'} | ${icon} ${(idx.changePercent || 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${(idx.changePercent || 0).toFixed(2)}% | ${pe} | ${idx.valuationStatus || idx.valuation || '-'} |\n`;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // === 组装行业上下文 ===
+  const industries = industriesRes.rows || [];
+  if (industries.length > 0) {
+    context += `\n## 🏷️ 热门行业板块\n\n`;
+    context += industries.map(r => `${r.industry}(${r.count}只)`).join(' | ');
+    context += '\n';
+  }
+
+  // === 组装基金详情上下文 ===
+  if (fundDetails && fundDetails.length > 0) {
+    for (const fund of fundDetails) {
+      if (!fund) continue;
+      context += `\n## 🔍 基金详情：${fund.name}（${fund.code}）\n\n`;
+      context += `- 类型：${fund.type || '-'}\n`;
+      context += `- 行业：${fund.industry || '-'}\n`;
+      context += `- 规模：${fund.scale?.toFixed(2) || '-'}亿\n`;
+      context += `- 费率：${fund.totalFee?.toFixed(2) || '-'}%\n`;
+      context += `- 近1年收益：${fund.return1y >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${fund.return1y?.toFixed(2) || '-'}%\n`;
+      context += `- 近6月收益：${fund.return6m >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${fund.return6m?.toFixed(2) || '-'}%\n`;
+      context += `- 近3月收益：${fund.return3m >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${fund.return3m?.toFixed(2) || '-'}%\n`;
+      context += `- 近1月收益：${fund.return1m >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${fund.return1m?.toFixed(2) || '-'}%\n`;
+      if (fund.isGoldSelected) context += `- ⭐ **金选基金**\n`;
+      if (fund.manager) context += `- 基金经理：${fund.manager}\n`;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return context;
+}

+'use strict';

+const { getPool } = require('./db.cjs');
+
+/**
+ * 创建订阅订单
+ */
+async function createOrder(userId, planId) {
+  const pool = getPool();
+  const plan = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM subscription_plans WHERE id = $1 AND is_active = true', [planId]);
+  if (plan.rows.length === 0) {
+    throw new Error('套餐不存在或已下架');
+  }
+  const { price, name } = plan.rows[0];
+  const outTradeNo = `SUB_${userId}_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
+  const result = await pool.query(
+    `INSERT INTO subscription_orders (user_id, plan_id, out_trade_no, amount, status)
+     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending') RETURNING *`,
+    [userId, planId, outTradeNo, price]
+  );
+  return { ...result.rows[0], plan_name: name };
+}
+
+/**
+ * 获取用户当前订阅状态
+ */
+async function getActiveSubscription(userId, role) {
+  const pool = getPool();
+  // 管理员直接返回会员状态
+  if (role === 'admin') return { isPremium: true, expiresAt: '2099-12-31', planName: '管理员', daysRemaining: 9999 };
+  const result = await pool.query(
+    `SELECT subscription_status, subscription_end, subscription_plan_id FROM users WHERE id = $1`,
+    [userId]
+  );
+  if (result.rows.length === 0) return { isPremium: false };
+  const { subscription_status, subscription_end, subscription_plan_id } = result.rows[0];
+  const isPremium = subscription_status === 'premium' && subscription_end && new Date(subscription_end) > new Date();
+  let planName = null;
+  if (isPremium && subscription_plan_id) {
+    const plan = await pool.query('SELECT name FROM subscription_plans WHERE id = $1', [subscription_plan_id]);
+    planName = plan.rows[0]?.name || null;
+  }
+  return {
+    isPremium,
+    expiresAt: subscription_end,
+    planName,
+    daysRemaining: isPremium ? Math.ceil((new Date(subscription_end) - new Date()) / 86400000) : 0,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * 支付成功后激活订阅
+ */
+async function activateSubscription(userId, orderId) {
+  const pool = getPool();
+  const client = await pool.connect();
+  try {
+    await client.query('BEGIN');
+    const order = await client.query('SELECT * FROM subscription_orders WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2', [orderId, userId]);
+    if (order.rows.length === 0) throw new Error('订单不存在');
+    const plan = await client.query('SELECT duration_days FROM subscription_plans WHERE id = $1', [order.rows[0].plan_id]);
+    const days = plan.rows[0]?.duration_days || 30;
+    const now = new Date();
+    const end = new Date(now.getTime() + days * 86400000);
+    await client.query(
+      `UPDATE users SET subscription_status = 'premium', subscription_plan_id = $1, subscription_start = $2, subscription_end = $3 WHERE id = $4`,
+      [order.rows[0].plan_id, now, end, userId]
+    );
+    await client.query(
+      `UPDATE subscription_orders SET status = 'paid', paid_at = $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $2`,
+      [now, orderId]
+    );
+    await client.query('COMMIT');
+    return { success: true, expiresAt: end };
+  } catch (e) {
+    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
+    throw e;
+  } finally {
+    client.release();
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * 通过外部交易号激活（支付宝回调用）
+ */
+async function activateByTradeNo(outTradeNo, tradeNo) {
+  const pool = getPool();
+  const client = await pool.connect();
+  try {
+    await client.query('BEGIN');
+    const order = await client.query('SELECT * FROM subscription_orders WHERE out_trade_no = $1', [outTradeNo]);
+    if (order.rows.length === 0) throw new Error('订单不存在');
+    if (order.rows[0].status === 'paid') { await client.query('COMMIT'); return { success: true, alreadyPaid: true }; }
+    const plan = await client.query('SELECT duration_days FROM subscription_plans WHERE id = $1', [order.rows[0].plan_id]);
+    const days = plan.rows[0]?.duration_days || 30;
+    const now = new Date();
+    const end = new Date(now.getTime() + days * 86400000);
+    await client.query(
+      `UPDATE users SET subscription_status = 'premium', subscription_plan_id = $1, subscription_start = $2, subscription_end = $3 WHERE id = $4`,
+      [order.rows[0].plan_id, now, end, order.rows[0].user_id]
+    );
+    await client.query(
+      `UPDATE subscription_orders SET status = 'paid', trade_no = $1, paid_at = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = $3`,
+      [tradeNo, now, outTradeNo]
+    );
+    await client.query('COMMIT');
+    return { success: true, expiresAt: end };
+  } catch (e) {
+    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
+    throw e;
+  } finally {
+    client.release();
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * 获取所有活跃套餐
+ */
+async function getPlans() {
+  const pool = getPool();
+  const result = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM subscription_plans WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY price');
+  return result.rows;
+}
+
+/**
+ * 获取用户订单历史
+ */
+async function getOrdersByUser(userId, limit = 20) {
+  const pool = getPool();
+  const result = await pool.query(
+    `SELECT o.*, p.name as plan_name FROM subscription_orders o
+     JOIN subscription_plans p ON o.plan_id = p.id
+     WHERE o.user_id = $1 ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT $2`,
+    [userId, limit]
+  );
+  return result.rows;
+}
+
+module.exports = { createOrder, getActiveSubscription, activateSubscription, activateByTradeNo, getPlans, getOrdersByUser };

+/**

+async function createPayment(outTradeNo, totalAmount, subject) {
+  const sdk = getAlipaySdk();
+  if (!sdk) throw new Error('支付宝SDK未配置');
+  const notifyUrl = process.env.ALIPAY_NOTIFY_URL || 'http://47.116.77.67:8688/api/subscription/notify';
+  const result = await sdk.exec('alipay.trade.precreate', {
+    bizContent: {
+      outTradeNo,
+      totalAmount: totalAmount.toString(),
+      subject,
+    },
+    notifyUrl,
+  });
+  return result;

+ */
+async function queryPayment(outTradeNo) {
+  const sdk = getAlipaySdk();
+  if (!sdk) throw new Error('支付宝SDK未配置');
+  const result = await sdk.exec('alipay.trade.query', {
+    bizContent: { outTradeNo },
+  });
+  return result;
+}

+/**
+ * 验证支付宝异步通知签名
+ */
+function verifyNotification(postData) {
+  const sdk = getAlipaySdk();
+  if (!sdk) return false;
+  return sdk.checkNotifySign(postData);
+}

+const winston = require('winston');
+const path = require('path');
+
+const logDir = path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'logs');
+
+const logger = winston.createLogger({
+  level: 'info',
+  format: winston.format.combine(
+    winston.format.timestamp({ format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss' }),
+    winston.format.printf(({ timestamp, level, message }) => {
+      return `${timestamp} [${level.toUpperCase()}] ${message}`;
+    })
+  ),
+  transports: [
+    new winston.transports.File({ filename: path.join(logDir, 'error.log'), level: 'error', maxsize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, maxFiles: 5 }),
+    new winston.transports.File({ filename: path.join(logDir, 'warn.log'), level: 'warn', maxsize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, maxFiles: 3 }),
+    new winston.transports.File({ filename: path.join(logDir, 'combined.log'), maxsize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, maxFiles: 5 }),
+    new winston.transports.Console({ format: winston.format.combine(winston.format.colorize(), winston.format.simple()) }),
+  ],
+});
+
+module.exports = logger;

+const axios = require('axios');
+const { API_URLS, REQUEST_DEFAULTS } = require('../config/index.cjs');
+
+/**
+ * 获取并存储基金历史净值（从东方财富API）
+ * 多个路由模块共用：analytics（收益地图）、insights（VIP分析）
+ */
+async function fetchAndStoreHistoricalNav(pool, fundCode, fundName, year) {
+  // Ensure fund exists in funds table (FK requirement)
+  const existingFund = await pool.query('SELECT code FROM funds WHERE code = $1', [fundCode]);
+  if (existingFund.rows.length === 0) {
+    await pool.query(
+      `INSERT INTO funds (code, name, type, industry) VALUES ($1, $2, '混合型', '其他')
+       ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING`,
+      [fundCode, fundName || fundCode]
+    );
+  }
+
+  // Fetch up to 260 days of historical NAV from eastmoney
+  const res = await axios.get(
+    `${API_URLS.EASTMONEY_NAV_HISTORY}?fundCode=${fundCode}&pageIndex=1&pageSize=365`,
+    { timeout: 10000, headers: { Referer: REQUEST_DEFAULTS.REFERER_EASTMONEY, 'User-Agent': REQUEST_DEFAULTS.USER_AGENT } }
+  );
+  const list = res.data?.Data?.LSJZList;
+  if (!list || list.length === 0) return;
+
+  let inserted = 0;
+  for (const item of list) {
+    const navDate = item.FSRQ; // e.g. "2025-01-15"
+    const nav = parseFloat(item.DWJZ);
+    if (!navDate || isNaN(nav)) continue;
+
+    await pool.query(
+      `INSERT INTO fund_nav (fund_code, nav, total_nav, nav_date)
+       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
+       ON CONFLICT (fund_code, nav_date) DO NOTHING`,
+      [fundCode, nav, parseFloat(item.LJJZ) || null, navDate]
+    );
+    inserted++;
+  }
+  console.log(`[VIP分析] ${fundCode} 获取并存储 ${inserted} 条历史净值`);
+}

+/**
+ * 计算定投执行日期
+ * DCA模块共用
+ */
+function getDcaExecutionDates(plan, fromDate, toDate) {
+  const dates = [];
+  const start = new Date(fromDate);
+  start.setDate(start.getDate() + 1);
+  const end = new Date(toDate);
+
+  const current = new Date(start);
+  current.setDate(1);
+
+  while (current <= end) {
+    let execDate;
+
+    switch (plan.frequency) {
+      case 'weekly': {
+        const targetDay = plan.day_of_week || 1;
+        const firstOfWeek = new Date(current);
+        const dayDiff = (targetDay - firstOfWeek.getDay() + 7) % 7;
+        firstOfWeek.setDate(firstOfWeek.getDate() + dayDiff);
+        execDate = firstOfWeek;
+        current.setDate(current.getDate() + 7);
+        break;
+      }
+      case 'biweekly': {
+        const targetDay = plan.day_of_week || 1;
+        const firstOfWeek = new Date(current);
+        const dayDiff = (targetDay - firstOfWeek.getDay() + 7) % 7;
+        firstOfWeek.setDate(firstOfWeek.getDate() + dayDiff);
+        execDate = firstOfWeek;
+        current.setDate(current.getDate() + 14);
+        break;
+      }
+      case 'monthly': {
+        execDate = new Date(current.getFullYear(), current.getMonth(), plan.day_of_month || 1);
+        current.setMonth(current.getMonth() + 1);
+        break;
+      }
+      case 'quarterly': {
+        execDate = new Date(current.getFullYear(), current.getMonth(), plan.day_of_month || 1);
+        current.setMonth(current.getMonth() + 3);
+        break;
+      }
+      default:
+        return dates;
+    }
+
+    if (execDate >= start && execDate <= end) {
+      dates.push(new Date(execDate));
+    }
+  }
+
+  return dates;
+}

+/**
+ * 资产类别分类
+ * insights模块共用
+ */
+function classifyAsset(fundCode, fundName, industry, type) {
+  const name = (fundName || '').toLowerCase();
+  const ind = (industry || '').toLowerCase();
+  const t = (type || '').toLowerCase();
+
+  // 货币基金
+  if (t === '货币' || ind.includes('货币')) return '货币基金';
+  // 债券/固收
+  if (t === '债券' || ind.includes('债券') || name.includes('债') || name.includes('回报')) return '固收';
+  // 海外（QDII / 纳斯达克 / 标普 / 港股）
+  if (t === 'qdii' || ind.includes('纳斯达克') || ind.includes('标普') || ind.includes('港股') || name.includes('纳斯达克') || name.includes('标普')) return '海外股';
+  // 黄金
+  if (ind.includes('黄金') || name.includes('黄金')) return '固收';
+  // 国内股 - 进攻型（科技成长类）
+  const aggressiveKeywords = ['半导体', '芯片', '人工智能', 'ai', '新能源', '光伏', '军工', '科创', '机器人', '信息技术', '科技'];
+  if (aggressiveKeywords.some(k => ind.includes(k) || name.includes(k))) return '国内股(进攻)';
+  // 国内股 - 防御型（消费、医药、红利、宽基）
+  return '国内股(防御)';
+}

+/**
+ * 生成组合智能建议
+ * insights模块使用
+ */
+function generateSuggestions(holdings, categories, totalValue, market, riskProfile) {
+  const suggestions = [];
+
+  if (totalValue === 0) return suggestions;
+
+  const catMap = {};
+  for (const c of categories) catMap[c.name] = c;
+
+  // --- 基于资产配置的建议 ---
+  const stockCategories = categories.filter(c => c.name.includes('股'));
+  const stockWeight = stockCategories.reduce((s, c) => s + c.weight, 0);
+  const bondWeight = (catMap['固收']?.weight || 0) + (catMap['货币基金']?.weight || 0);
+
+  if (stockWeight > 80) {
+    suggestions.push({
+      type: 'risk', level: 'warning',
+      title: '权益仓位过高',
+      detail: `股票类资产占比 ${stockWeight.toFixed(0)}%，建议适当增配固收或货币基金降低组合波动。`,
+    });
+  }
+  if (bondWeight > 70) {
+    suggestions.push({
+      type: 'opportunity', level: 'info',
+      title: '固收占比偏高',
+      detail: `固收+货币占比 ${bondWeight.toFixed(0)}%，收益率可能偏低。可根据风险承受能力适当增配宽基指数基金。`,
+    });
+  }
+
+  // --- 集中度风险 ---
+  for (const h of holdings) {
+    const weight = totalValue > 0 ? (h.market_value / totalValue) * 100 : 0;
+    if (weight > 30) {
+      suggestions.push({
+        type: 'risk', level: 'warning',
+        title: `持仓集中：${h.fund_name}`,
+        detail: `单只基金占比 ${weight.toFixed(1)}%，集中度过高。建议分散至其他资产类别以降低非系统性风险。`,
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  // --- 进攻/防御平衡 ---
+  const attackWeight = catMap['国内股(进攻)']?.weight || 0;
+  const defenseWeight = catMap['国内股(防御)']?.weight || 0;
+  if (attackWeight > 50 && defenseWeight < 20) {
+    suggestions.push({
+      type: 'balance', level: 'info',
+      title: '进攻型仓位偏重',
+      detail: `进攻型资产(半导体/AI/新能源等)占比 ${attackWeight.toFixed(0)}%，防御型(消费/红利/宽基)仅 ${defenseWeight.toFixed(0)}%。建议增配红利或沪深300等防御性资产平滑波动。`,
+    });
+  }
+
+  // --- 海外配置 ---
+  const overseasWeight = catMap['海外股']?.weight || 0;
+  if (overseasWeight < 10 && stockWeight > 30) {
+    suggestions.push({
+      type: 'opportunity', level: 'info',
+      title: '建议增配海外资产',
+      detail: '海外资产占比偏低，适当配置纳斯达克100或标普500可提升组合地域分散度，降低单一市场风险。',
+    });
+  }
+
+  // --- 基于风险评估的建议 ---
+  if (riskProfile && riskProfile.allocation) {
+    const targetMap = {};
+    for (const a of riskProfile.allocation) {
+      const ind = a.industry || '';
+      if (ind.includes('货币') || ind.includes('余额')) targetMap['货币基金'] = (targetMap['货币基金'] || 0) + a.percentage;
+      else if (ind.includes('债') || ind.includes('稳健')) targetMap['固收'] = (targetMap['固收'] || 0) + a.percentage;
+      else if (ind.includes('纳斯达克') || ind.includes('标普') || ind.includes('港')) targetMap['海外股'] = (targetMap['海外股'] || 0) + a.percentage;
+      else if (ind.includes('半导体') || ind.includes('芯片') || ind.includes('人工智能') || ind.includes('AI') || ind.includes('新能源') || ind.includes('光伏')) targetMap['国内股(进攻)'] = (targetMap['国内股(进攻)'] || 0) + a.percentage;
+      else targetMap['国内股(防御)'] = (targetMap['国内股(防御)'] || 0) + a.percentage;
+    }
+
+    for (const [cat, target] of Object.entries(targetMap)) {
+      const current = catMap[cat]?.weight || 0;
+      const diff = target - current;
+      if (Math.abs(diff) > 10) {
+        const action = diff > 0 ? '增配' : '减配';
+        suggestions.push({
+          type: 'rebalance', level: diff > 0 ? 'info' : 'warning',
+          title: `${cat}: ${action}建议`,
+          detail: `您的${riskProfile.riskType}画像建议${cat}配置约${target}%，当前仅${current.toFixed(0)}%，建议${action}约${Math.abs(diff).toFixed(0)}个百分点。`,
+        });
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  // --- 基于市场行情的建议 ---
+  const undervalued = market.filter(m => m.pePercentile > 0 && m.pePercentile < 35);
+  const overvalued = market.filter(m => m.pePercentile > 70);
+
+  if (undervalued.length > 0) {
+    const names = undervalued.map(m => m.name).join('、');
+    suggestions.push({
+      type: 'market', level: 'info',
+      title: '低估指数值得关注',
+      detail: `${names}当前估值处于历史偏低区间(PE分位<35%)，是定投或加仓的好时机。`,
+    });
+  }
+  if (overvalued.length > 0) {
+    const names = overvalued.map(m => m.name).join('、');
+    suggestions.push({
+      type: 'market', level: 'warning',
+      title: '高估指数注意风险',
+      detail: `${names}当前估值偏高(PE分位>70%)，建议减仓或暂停定投，等待回调。`,
+    });
+  }
+
+  // --- 盈亏分析 ---
+  const lossHoldings = holdings.filter(h => h.pnl < 0);
+  const profitHoldings = holdings.filter(h => h.pnl > 0);
+  if (lossHoldings.length > 0) {
+    const totalLoss = lossHoldings.reduce((s, h) => s + Math.abs(h.pnl), 0);
+    const avgLossPct = lossHoldings.reduce((s, h) => s + Math.abs(h.pnl_percent), 0) / lossHoldings.length;
+    if (avgLossPct > 10) {
+      suggestions.push({
+        type: 'action', level: 'warning',
+        title: '亏损基金需关注',
+        detail: `${lossHoldings.length}只基金合计亏损¥${totalLoss.toFixed(0)}，平均跌幅${avgLossPct.toFixed(1)}%。若基本面未变可坚持定投摊低成本，若行业逻辑已变建议止损换仓。`,
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (suggestions.length === 0) {
+    suggestions.push({
+      type: 'info', level: 'success',
+      title: '组合状态良好',
+      detail: '当前资产配置较为均衡，继续保持定投纪律，定期检视组合。',
+    });
+  }
+
+  return suggestions;
+}
+
+/**
+ * 3层NAV解析：API -> fund_nav -> cmb_zhaoyin_nav
+ * analytics和insights模块共用
+ */
+async function resolveLatestNav(pool, fundCodes) {
+  const navMap = {};
+
+  // 1. 从 fund_nav 表获取最新净值
+  const latestNavResult = await pool.query(
+    `SELECT DISTINCT ON (fund_code) fund_code, nav, nav_date
+     FROM fund_nav WHERE fund_code = ANY($1)
+     ORDER BY fund_code, nav_date DESC`,
+    [fundCodes]
+  );
+  for (const row of latestNavResult.rows) {
+    navMap[row.fund_code] = { nav: parseFloat(row.nav), date: row.nav_date };
+  }
+
+  // 2. 对 fund_nav 表中没有的代码，从 cmb_zhaoyin_nav 表补充（招行理财产品）
+  const missingCodes = fundCodes.filter(code => !navMap[code]);
+  if (missingCodes.length > 0) {
+    const cmbNavResult = await pool.query(
+      `SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_code) product_code, unit_nav, nav_date
+       FROM cmb_zhaoyin_nav WHERE product_code = ANY($1)
+       ORDER BY product_code, nav_date DESC`,
+      [missingCodes]
+    );
+    for (const row of cmbNavResult.rows) {
+      if (row.unit_nav) {
+        navMap[row.product_code] = { nav: parseFloat(row.unit_nav), date: row.nav_date };
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return navMap;
+}
+
+module.exports = {
+  fetchAndStoreHistoricalNav,
+  getDcaExecutionDates,
+  classifyAsset,
+  generateSuggestions,
+  resolveLatestNav,
+};

+/**
+ * 共享统计工具 — Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar/最大回撤等风险指标计算
+ * 消除 vip-insights 和 holdings-risk 中的重复代码
+ */
+
+const RISK_FREE_RATE = 0.02; // 年化无风险利率 2%
+const TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR = 252;
+
+/**
+ * 从价格/净值序列计算日收益率
+ * @param {number[]} prices - 价格/净值数组（按时间正序）
+ * @returns {number[]} 日收益率数组
+ */
+function calcDailyReturns(prices) {
+  const returns = [];
+  for (let i = 1; i < prices.length; i++) {
+    if (prices[i - 1] > 0) {
+      returns.push((prices[i] - prices[i - 1]) / prices[i - 1]);
+    }
+  }
+  return returns;
+}
+
+/**
+ * 计算最大回撤（百分比）
+ * @param {number[]} prices - 价格/净值数组
+ * @returns {number} 最大回撤百分比（0-100）
+ */
+function calcMaxDrawdown(prices) {
+  let maxDD = 0;
+  let peak = prices[0];
+  for (const p of prices) {
+    if (p > peak) peak = p;
+    const dd = (peak - p) / peak;
+    if (dd > maxDD) maxDD = dd;
+  }
+  return parseFloat((maxDD * 100).toFixed(2));
+}
+
+/**
+ * 计算年化收益率
+ * @param {number[]} prices - 价格/净值数组
+ * @returns {{ annualizedReturn: number, returnPeriod: string }}
+ */
+function calcAnnualizedReturn(prices) {
+  const totalDays = prices.length;
+  if (totalDays < 2) return { annualizedReturn: 0, returnPeriod: '' };
+
+  const totalPeriodReturn = (prices[totalDays - 1] - prices[0]) / prices[0];
+
+  if (totalDays >= 200) {
+    const raw = (Math.pow(1 + totalPeriodReturn, TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR / totalDays) - 1) * 100;
+    return {
+      annualizedReturn: parseFloat(Math.max(-99, Math.min(500, raw)).toFixed(2)),
+      returnPeriod: '年化',
+    };
+  }
+
+  const calendarDays = Math.round((totalDays - 1) * 365 / TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR);
+  return {
+    annualizedReturn: parseFloat((totalPeriodReturn * 100).toFixed(2)),
+    returnPeriod: `${calendarDays}天`,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * 计算完整风险指标集（用于 vip-insights 深度分析）
+ * @param {number[]} dailyValues - 每日组合净值数组
+ * @returns {object} 包含所有风险指标的对象
+ */
+function calcFullRiskMetrics(dailyValues) {
+  const result = {
+    annualizedReturn: 0,
+    returnPeriod: '',
+    maxDrawdown: 0,
+    volatility: 0,
+    sharpeRatio: 0,
+    sortinoRatio: 0,
+    calmarRatio: 0,
+    winRate: 0,
+    profitLossRatio: 0,
+  };
+
+  if (dailyValues.length < 2) return result;
+
+  const dailyReturns = calcDailyReturns(dailyValues);
+
+  // 年化收益率
+  const { annualizedReturn, returnPeriod } = calcAnnualizedReturn(dailyValues);
+  result.annualizedReturn = annualizedReturn;
+  result.returnPeriod = returnPeriod;
+
+  // 最大回撤
+  result.maxDrawdown = calcMaxDrawdown(dailyValues);
+
+  // 波动率（年化）
+  const avgReturn = dailyReturns.reduce((s, r) => s + r, 0) / dailyReturns.length;
+  const variance = dailyReturns.reduce((s, r) => s + Math.pow(r - avgReturn, 2), 0) / dailyReturns.length;
+  result.volatility = parseFloat(Math.min(200, Math.sqrt(variance) * Math.sqrt(TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR) * 100).toFixed(2));
+
+  // 夏普比率
+  const riskFreeDaily = RISK_FREE_RATE / TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR;
+  const excessReturns = dailyReturns.map(r => r - riskFreeDaily);
+  const avgExcess = excessReturns.reduce((s, r) => s + r, 0) / excessReturns.length;
+  const stdExcess = Math.sqrt(excessReturns.reduce((s, r) => s + Math.pow(r - avgExcess, 2), 0) / excessReturns.length);
+  const rawSharpe = stdExcess > 0 ? (avgExcess / stdExcess * Math.sqrt(TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR)) : 0;
+  result.sharpeRatio = parseFloat(Math.max(-5, Math.min(10, rawSharpe)).toFixed(2));
+
+  // 卡玛比率
+  result.calmarRatio = result.maxDrawdown > 0
+    ? parseFloat(Math.max(-20, Math.min(20, result.annualizedReturn / result.maxDrawdown)).toFixed(2))
+    : 0;
+
+  // 胜率
+  const profitDays = dailyReturns.filter(r => r > 0).length;
+  result.winRate = parseFloat(((profitDays / dailyReturns.length) * 100).toFixed(2));
+
+  // 盈亏比
+  const avgProfit = profitDays > 0
+    ? dailyReturns.filter(r => r > 0).reduce((s, r) => s + r, 0) / profitDays
+    : 0;
+  const lossDays = dailyReturns.length - profitDays;
+  const avgLoss = lossDays > 0
+    ? Math.abs(dailyReturns.filter(r => r < 0).reduce((s, r) => s + r, 0) / lossDays)
+    : 0;
+  result.profitLossRatio = avgLoss > 0 ? parseFloat(Math.min(20, avgProfit / avgLoss).toFixed(2)) : 0;
+
+  // 索提诺比率（需要至少20个数据点）
+  if (dailyReturns.length >= 20) {
+    const downSide = dailyReturns.filter(r => r < riskFreeDaily);
+    const downVar = downSide.length > 0
+      ? downSide.reduce((s, r) => s + (r - riskFreeDaily) ** 2, 0) / downSide.length
+      : 0;
+    const downDev = Math.sqrt(downVar) * Math.sqrt(TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR) * 100;
+    result.sortinoRatio = downDev > 0
+      ? parseFloat(Math.max(-10, Math.min(20, (result.annualizedReturn - RISK_FREE_RATE * 100) / downDev)).toFixed(2))
+      : 0;
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+/**
+ * 计算简化风险指标（用于 holdings-risk 单只基金分析）
+ * @param {number[]} navs - 净值数组（按时间正序）
+ * @returns {object|null} 风险指标对象，数据不足返回 null
+ */
+function calcSimpleRiskMetrics(navs) {
+  if (navs.length < 30) return null;
+
+  const returns = calcDailyReturns(navs);
+  const n = returns.length;
+  if (n < 30) return null;
+
+  const mean = returns.reduce((s, r) => s + r, 0) / n;
+  const variance = returns.reduce((s, r) => s + (r - mean) ** 2, 0) / (n - 1);
+  const std = Math.sqrt(variance);
+  const annualReturn = mean * TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR;
+  const annualVol = std * Math.sqrt(TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR);
+
+  // Sharpe
+  const riskFreeDaily = RISK_FREE_RATE / TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR;
+  const excess = returns.map(r => r - riskFreeDaily);
+  const meanExcess = excess.reduce((s, r) => s + r, 0) / n;
+  const sharpe = std > 0 ? (meanExcess / std) * Math.sqrt(TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR) : 0;
+
+  // Sortino
+  const downSide = returns.filter(r => r < riskFreeDaily);
+  const downVar = downSide.length > 0
+    ? downSide.reduce((s, r) => s + (r - riskFreeDaily) ** 2, 0) / downSide.length
+    : 0;
+  const downDev = Math.sqrt(downVar);
+  const sortino = downDev > 0 ? (meanExcess / downDev) * Math.sqrt(TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR) : 0;
+
+  // Max Drawdown
+  const maxDD = calcMaxDrawdown(navs) / 100; // 转回小数
+
+  // Calmar
+  const calmar = maxDD > 0 ? annualReturn / maxDD : 0;
+
+  return {
+    sharpe: Math.round(sharpe * 100) / 100,
+    sortino: Math.round(sortino * 100) / 100,
+    calmar: Math.round(calmar * 100) / 100,
+    maxDrawdown: Math.round(maxDD * 10000) / 100,
+    annualReturn: Math.round(annualReturn * 10000) / 100,
+    annualVolatility: Math.round(annualVol * 10000) / 100,
+    dataPoints: n,
+  };
+}
+
+module.exports = {
+  calcDailyReturns,
+  calcMaxDrawdown,
+  calcAnnualizedReturn,
+  calcFullRiskMetrics,
+  calcSimpleRiskMetrics,
+  RISK_FREE_RATE,
+  TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR,
+};

@@ -0,0 +1,212 @@
+import { useEffect } from 'react';
+import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
+import gsap from 'gsap';
+
+/**
+ * Non-invasive GSAP animation enhancer.
+ *
+ * CSS hides .ant-card and .ant-statistic-content-value by default.
+ * IntersectionObserver reveals them with a staggered slide-up as they
+ * scroll into view, then marks them with .gsap-revealed so CSS no longer
+ * hides them.
+ *
+ * Handles antd Tabs: inactive tabs use display:none which prevents
+ * IntersectionObserver from firing. When a tab becomes active and its
+ * cards become visible, we detect this via attribute mutations and
+ * re-trigger the reveal animation.
+ */
+export default function GsapEnhancer() {
+  const { pathname } = useLocation();
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let cancelled = false;
+    const ioSet = new Set<IntersectionObserver>();
+    const cleanups: (() => void)[] = [];
+
+    // Cards that have been animated and are currently visible
+    const revealed = new WeakSet<Element>();
+    // Cards that were processed but are in hidden tabs (display:none)
+    // — need re-animation when their tab becomes active
+    const pendingReveal = new WeakSet<Element>();
+    let cardCounter = 0;
+
+    function revealCard(card: Element, forceReveal = false) {
+      if (revealed.has(card) && !forceReveal) return;
+      const index = cardCounter++;
+
+      // If the card is hidden (display:none), defer animation
+      if (!isVisible(card)) {
+        pendingReveal.add(card);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      revealed.add(card);
+      pendingReveal.delete(card);
+
+      const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
+        ([entry]) => {
+          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
+            gsap.to(entry.target, {
+              opacity: 1,
+              y: 0,
+              duration: 0.5,
+              delay: index * 0.06,
+              ease: 'power2.out',
+              onComplete() {
+                entry.target.classList.add('gsap-revealed');
+                gsap.set(entry.target, { clearProps: 'opacity,transform' });
+              },
+            });
+            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
+          }
+        },
+        { threshold: 0.1 }
+      );
+      observer.observe(card);
+      ioSet.add(observer);
+    }
+
+    function revealStat(stat: Element) {
+      if (revealed.has(stat) || !isVisible(stat)) return;
+      revealed.add(stat);
+
+      gsap.to(stat, {
+        opacity: 1,
+        y: 0,
+        duration: 0.4,
+        delay: 0.2,
+        ease: 'power2.out',
+        onComplete() {
+          stat.classList.add('gsap-revealed');
+          gsap.set(stat, { clearProps: 'opacity,transform' });
+        },
+      });
+    }
+
+    function setupTilt(card: Element) {
+      const el = card as HTMLElement;
+      if (el.dataset.tiltBound) return;
+      el.dataset.tiltBound = '1';
+      el.style.transformStyle = 'preserve-3d';
+      el.style.willChange = 'transform';
+
+      const handleMouse = (e: MouseEvent) => {
+        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
+        const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width - 0.5;
+        const y = (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height - 0.5;
+        gsap.to(el, {
+          rotationY: x * 8,
+          rotationX: -y * 8,
+          transformPerspective: 600,
+          duration: 0.3,
+          ease: 'power2.out',
+        });
+      };
+
+      const handleLeave = () => {
+        gsap.to(el, {
+          rotationY: 0,
+          rotationX: 0,
+          duration: 0.5,
+          ease: 'elastic.out(1, 0.5)',
+        });
+      };
+
+      el.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouse);
+      el.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleLeave);
+      cleanups.push(() => {
+        el.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouse);
+        el.removeEventListener('mouseleave', handleLeave);
+      });
+    }
+
+    /** Check if an element is visible (not display:none) */
+    function isVisible(el: Element): boolean {
+      if (el instanceof HTMLElement && el.offsetParent === null && getComputedStyle(el).display === 'none') {
+        return false;
+      }
+      return true;
+    }
+
+    /** Process all cards currently in the DOM */
+    function processAll() {
+      document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card').forEach((c) => revealCard(c));
+      document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card-hoverable').forEach(setupTilt);
+      document.querySelectorAll('.ant-statistic-content-value').forEach(revealStat);
+    }
+
+    /** Re-trigger animation for cards that just became visible (e.g. tab switch) */
+    function processPendingReveals() {
+      // Walk pendingReveal WeakSet — WeakSet isn't iterable, so re-scan
+      document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card').forEach((card) => {
+        if (pendingReveal.has(card) && isVisible(card)) {
+          // Reset the "revealed" state so revealCard can run
+          revealed.delete(card);
+          card.classList.remove('gsap-revealed');
+          // Re-apply hidden state
+          gsap.set(card, { opacity: 0, y: 24 });
+          revealCard(card);
+          if (card.classList.contains('ant-card-hoverable')) setupTilt(card);
+        }
+      });
+      document.querySelectorAll('.ant-statistic-content-value').forEach((stat) => {
+        if (isVisible(stat) && !stat.classList.contains('gsap-revealed')) {
+          revealed.delete(stat);
+          revealStat(stat);
+        }
+      });
+    }
+
+    // 1. MutationObserver: catch new cards AND attribute changes (tab switches)
+    const mo = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
+      if (cancelled) return;
+      let hasAttrChange = false;
+
+      for (const m of mutations) {
+        if (m.type === 'childList' && m.addedNodes.length > 0) {
+          for (const node of m.addedNodes) {
+            if (!(node instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
+            if (node.classList.contains('ant-card')) {
+              revealCard(node);
+              if (node.classList.contains('ant-card-hoverable')) setupTilt(node);
+            }
+            node.querySelectorAll?.('.ant-card').forEach((c) => {
+              revealCard(c);
+              if (c.classList.contains('ant-card-hoverable')) setupTilt(c);
+            });
+            if (node.classList.contains('ant-statistic-content-value')) revealStat(node);
+            node.querySelectorAll?.('.ant-statistic-content-value').forEach(revealStat);
+          }
+        }
+        // Tab panels change their style attribute when switching tabs
+        if (m.type === 'attributes' && m.attributeName === 'style') {
+          hasAttrChange = true;
+        }
+      }
+
+      // If style attributes changed (tab switch), check for pending reveals
+      if (hasAttrChange) {
+        requestAnimationFrame(() => processPendingReveals());
+      }
+    });
+
+    mo.observe(document.body, {
+      childList: true,
+      subtree: true,
+      attributes: true,
+      attributeFilter: ['style'],
+    });
+    cleanups.push(() => mo.disconnect());
+
+    // 2. Initial processing
+    processAll();
+
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+      ioSet.forEach((o) => o.disconnect());
+      cleanups.forEach((fn) => fn());
+    };
+  }, [pathname]);
+
+  return null;
+}

+import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
+import { Card, Tag, List, Space, Typography, Badge, Spin, Empty, Button, Tooltip, Input, Segmented, message } from 'antd';
+import {
+  ThunderboltOutlined,
+  ReloadOutlined,
+  BellOutlined,
+  RiseOutlined,
+  FallOutlined,
+  EyeOutlined,
+  StockOutlined,
+  BankOutlined,
+  FileProtectOutlined,
+  WarningOutlined,
+  GlobalOutlined,
+  ShopOutlined,
+  ExclamationCircleOutlined,
+  SearchOutlined,
+  LinkOutlined,
+} from '@ant-design/icons';
+import { newsApi } from '../services/api';
+import { useTheme } from '../contexts/ThemeContext';
+
+const { Text, Paragraph } = Typography;
+
+const categoryIcons: Record<string, React.ReactNode> = {
+  earnings: <StockOutlined />,
+  orders: <FileProtectOutlined />,
+  tech: <ThunderboltOutlined />,
+  accident: <WarningOutlined />,
+  policy: <BankOutlined />,
+  mna: <GlobalOutlined />,
+  macro: <ShopOutlined />,
+  other: <ExclamationCircleOutlined />,
+};
+
+const actionConfig: Record<string, { label: string; color: string; icon: React.ReactNode }> = {
+  buy: { label: '关注加仓', color: '#52c41a', icon: <RiseOutlined /> },
+  sell: { label: '评估减仓', color: '#f5222d', icon: <FallOutlined /> },
+  watch: { label: '密切关注', color: '#1677ff', icon: <EyeOutlined /> },
+  hold: { label: '持有观望', color: '#8c8c8c', icon: <EyeOutlined /> },
+};
+
+interface NewsFeedProps {
+  compact?: boolean; // 紧凑模式（嵌入其他页面）
+  maxItems?: number;
+  showHeader?: boolean;
+}
+
+export default function NewsFeed({ compact = false, maxItems = 50, showHeader = true }: NewsFeedProps) {
+  const { isDark } = useTheme();
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+  const [news, setNews] = useState<any[]>([]);
+  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
+  const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState<string>('all');
+  const [filterImpact, setFilterImpact] = useState<string>('medium');
+  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState('');
+  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
+  const [lastFetch, setLastFetch] = useState<string>('');
+  const [sseConnected, setSseConnected] = useState(false);
+  const [breakingNews, setBreakingNews] = useState<any[]>([]);
+  const esRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
+
+  // 获取新闻列表
+  const fetchNews = async () => {
+    try {
+      // impact: 'medium' 表示"中影响以上"，发送 high,medium 给后端
+      const impactParam = filterImpact === 'all' ? undefined
+        : filterImpact === 'medium' ? 'high,medium'
+        : filterImpact;
+      const data = await newsApi.getNews({
+        category: filterCategory !== 'all' ? filterCategory : undefined,
+        impact: impactParam,
+        keyword: keyword || undefined,
+        pageSize: maxItems,
+      });
+      setNews(data.items);
+      setTotal(data.total);
+      setLastFetch(data.lastFetchTime);
+      if (data.categories) setCategories(data.categories);
+    } catch (err) {
+      // 静默失败
+    } finally {
+      setLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  // SSE 实时连接
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const es = newsApi.connectSSE((data) => {
+      if (data.type === 'init') {
+        // 初始数据，合并到列表
+        setNews(prev => {
+          const existing = new Set(prev.map(n => n.id));
+          const newItems = data.items.filter((n: any) => !existing.has(n.id));
+          return [...newItems, ...prev].slice(0, maxItems);
+        });
+      } else if (data.type === 'news') {
+        // 新的突发新闻
+        setBreakingNews(prev => [...data.items, ...prev].slice(0, 10));
+        setNews(prev => {
+          const existing = new Set(prev.map(n => n.id));
+          const newItems = data.items.filter((n: any) => !existing.has(n.id));
+          return [...newItems, ...prev].slice(0, maxItems);
+        });
+        // 显示通知
+        data.items.forEach((item: any) => {
+          if (item.impact === 'high') {
+            message.warning({
+              content: `突发: ${item.title.substring(0, 40)}...`,
+              duration: 5,
+            });
+          }
+        });
+      }
+    });
+    esRef.current = es;
+    setSseConnected(true);
+
+    return () => {
+      es.abort();
+      setSseConnected(false);
+    };
+  }, [maxItems]);
+
+  // 首次加载和筛选变化
+  useEffect(() => {
+    fetchNews();
+  }, [filterCategory, filterImpact, keyword]);
+
+  const formatTime = (isoTime: string) => {
+    const date = new Date(isoTime);
+    const now = new Date();
+    const diff = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
+    if (diff < 60000) return '刚刚';
+    if (diff < 3600000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60000)}分钟前`;
+    if (diff < 86400000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600000)}小时前`;
+    return `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()} ${String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <div>
+      {showHeader && (
+        <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 12 }}>
+            <Space size={8}>
+              <BellOutlined style={{ color: 'var(--primary)', fontSize: 18 }} />
+              <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>实时财经快讯</Text>
+              <Badge status={sseConnected ? 'success' : 'default'} text={
+                <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{sseConnected ? '实时连接中' : '已断开'}</Text>
+              } />
+              {total > 0 && <Tag color="blue">{total} 条</Tag>}
+            </Space>
+            <Button size="small" icon={<ReloadOutlined />} onClick={fetchNews}>刷新</Button>
+          </div>
+

+          {!compact && (

+                size="small"
+                value={filterImpact}
+                onChange={v => setFilterImpact(v as string)}
+                options={[
+                  { value: 'all', label: '全部' },
+                  { value: 'high', label: '🔴 高影响' },
+                  { value: 'medium', label: '🟠 中影响' },
+                ]}
+              />
+              <Input
+                size="small"
+                placeholder="搜索关键词"
+                prefix={<SearchOutlined />}
+                value={keyword}
+                onChange={e => setKeyword(e.target.value)}
+                style={{ width: 160 }}
+                allowClear
+              />
+            </Space>
+          )}
+        </div>
+      )}
+
+      {/* 突发新闻高亮 */}
+      {breakingNews.length > 0 && !compact && (
+        <Card
+          size="small"

+            </div>
+          ))}
+        </Card>
+      )}
+

+      {loading ? (
+        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 40 }}><Spin /></div>
+      ) : news.length === 0 ? (
+        <Empty description="暂无新闻" image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} />
+      ) : (
+        <List
+          size="small"
+          dataSource={news}

+              ? { color: 'red', text: '高影响' }

+                <div style={{ width: '100%' }}>

+                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 4, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+                    <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{formatTime(item.time)}</Text>
+                    <Tag style={{ fontSize: 10, margin: 0 }}>{item.source}</Tag>
+                    <Tag color={catCfg.color} style={{ fontSize: 10, margin: 0 }}>
+                      {categoryIcons[item.category]} {catCfg.label}
+                    </Tag>
+                    <Tag color={impactTag.color} style={{ fontSize: 10, margin: 0 }}>{impactTag.text}</Tag>
+                  </div>
+

+                  <a

+                      {item.title}
+                    </Text>
+                  </a>
+

+                  {!compact && item.content && item.content !== item.title && (
+                    <Paragraph
+                      ellipsis={{ rows: 2 }}

+                    >
+                      {item.content}
+                    </Paragraph>
+                  )}

+                    <div style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
+                      {item.stocks.slice(0, 5).map((s: any) => (
+                        <Tag key={s.code} style={{ fontSize: 10, margin: '0 4px 2px 0' }}>
+                          {s.name || s.code}
+                        </Tag>
+                      ))}
+                    </div>
+                  )}
+
+                  {/* 投资建议操作标签 */}
+                  {item.advice && (
+                    <div style={{
+                      marginTop: 6, padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: 4,
+                      background: 'var(--bg-secondary)', fontSize: 12,
+                      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4,
+                    }}>
+                      {actionConfig[item.action]?.icon}
+                      <Text style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{item.advice}</Text>
+                    </div>
+                  )}
+                </div>
+              </List.Item>
+            );
+          }}
+        />
+      )}
+
+      {lastFetch && (
+        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 8 }}>
+          <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
+            最后更新: {new Date(lastFetch).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}
+          </Text>
+        </div>
+      )}
+    </div>
+  );
+}

+import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+import { Card, Row, Col, Tag, Space, Alert, Spin, Empty, Badge, Progress, Statistic, Divider, Tooltip } from 'antd';
+import {
+  CrownOutlined, ThunderboltOutlined, SafetyOutlined, RiseOutlined, FallOutlined,

+  CheckCircleOutlined, WarningOutlined, StarOutlined, RocketOutlined,

+} from '@ant-design/icons';
+import ReactECharts from 'echarts-for-react';
+import { portfolioApi } from '../services/api';
+import { useTheme } from '../contexts/ThemeContext';
+import { getEchartsTheme } from '../utils/echarts-theme';
+
+interface VIPData {
+  healthScore: number;
+  healthLevel: string;
+  dataQuality: string;
+  totalCost: number;
+  totalValue: number;
+  totalPnl: number;
+  totalReturn: number;
+  metrics: {
+    annualizedReturn: number;
+    maxDrawdown: number;
+    sharpeRatio: number;
+    calmarRatio: number;
+    volatility: number;
+    winRate: number;
+    profitLossRatio: number;
+    avgHoldingDays: number;
+    returnPeriod?: string;
+  };
+  attribution: { category: string; contribution: number; weight: number; pnl: number; value: number }[];
+  monthlyReturns: { month: string; return: number; value: number }[];
+  riskMetrics: { name: string; value: number; benchmark: number; status: string }[];
+  alerts: { type: string; level: string; title: string; detail: string; action: string }[];
+  aiAdvice: { priority: string; title: string; detail: string; impact: string }[];
+}
+
+export default function VIPInsights() {
+  const { isDark } = useTheme();
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+  const [data, setData] = useState<VIPData | null>(null);
+  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let cancelled = false;
+    setLoading(true);
+    setError(null);
+    portfolioApi.getVIPInsights()
+      .then(d => { if (!cancelled) setData(d); })
+      .catch((e) => { if (!cancelled) { setData(null); setError(e.message || '加载失败'); } })
+      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); });
+    return () => { cancelled = true; };
+  }, []);
+
+  if (loading) {
+    return <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}><div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '60px 0' }}><Spin size="large" tip="正在分析您的持仓数据..." /></div></Card>;
+  }
+
+  if (error) {
+    return <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}><Alert type="error" message="VIP分析加载失败" description={error} showIcon /></Card>;
+  }
+
+  if (!data || data.dataQuality === 'empty') {
+    return <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}><Empty description="暂无持仓数据，请先添加持仓记录" /></Card>;
+  }
+
+  const pnlColor = (v: number) => v >= 0 ? '#cf1322' : '#3f8600';
+  const pnlSign = (v: number) => v >= 0 ? '+' : '';
+
+  const qualityConfig: Record<string, { label: string; color: string; desc: string }> = {
+    excellent: { label: '数据充分', color: '#52c41a', desc: '近1年完整数据' },
+    good: { label: '数据良好', color: '#1890ff', desc: '近2月+数据' },
+    fair: { label: '数据较少', color: '#faad14', desc: '部分历史数据' },
+    poor: { label: '数据不足', color: '#ff4d4f', desc: '建议刷新净值' },
+  };
+  const quality = qualityConfig[data.dataQuality] || qualityConfig.poor;
+
+  // 组合健康评分环形图
+  const scoreOption = {
+    series: [{
+      type: 'gauge',
+      startAngle: 220,
+      endAngle: -40,
+      min: 0,
+      max: 100,
+      radius: '85%',
+      progress: { show: true, width: 14, itemStyle: { color: data.healthScore >= 80 ? '#52c41a' : data.healthScore >= 60 ? '#1890ff' : data.healthScore >= 40 ? '#faad14' : '#ff4d4f' } },
+      axisLine: { lineStyle: { width: 14, color: [[1, '#e8e8e8']] } },
+      axisTick: { show: false },
+      splitLine: { show: false },
+      axisLabel: { show: false },
+      pointer: { show: false },
+      title: { show: false },
+      detail: {
+        valueAnimation: true,
+        fontSize: 36,
+        fontWeight: 700,
+        color: data.healthScore >= 80 ? '#52c41a' : data.healthScore >= 60 ? '#1890ff' : data.healthScore >= 40 ? '#faad14' : '#ff4d4f',
+        formatter: '{value}',
+        offsetCenter: [0, '10%'],
+      },
+      data: [{ value: data.healthScore }],
+    }],
+  };
+
+  // 收益归因柱状图
+  const attributionOption = {
+    tooltip: {
+      trigger: 'axis',
+      formatter: (params: any) => {

+interface Fund {
+  code: string;

+  type: string;
+  company: string;
