+}
+
+interface FundComparePanelProps {
+  selectedCodes: string[];
+  setSelectedCodes: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
+  showCompare: boolean;
+  setShowCompare: (v: boolean) => void;
+  allFunds: Fund[];
+  isDark: boolean;
+}
+
+export function FundComparePanel({
+  selectedCodes, setSelectedCodes,
+  showCompare, setShowCompare,
+  allFunds, isDark,
+}: FundComparePanelProps) {
+  const [compareData, setCompareData] = useState<Fund[]>([]);
+  const [compareLoading, setCompareLoading] = useState(false);
+  const [compareError, setCompareError] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [compareSearchCode, setCompareSearchCode] = useState('');
+  const [navHistory, setNavHistory] = useState<Record<string, any[]>>({});
+  const [premiumData, setPremiumData] = useState<any>(null);
+  const [premiumLoading, setPremiumLoading] = useState(false);
+  const [navHistoryLoading, setNavHistoryLoading] = useState(false);
+  const debounceTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    return () => { if (debounceTimer.current) clearTimeout(debounceTimer.current); };
+  }, []);
+
+  const loadCompareData = async () => {
+    if (selectedCodes.length === 0) return;
+    setCompareLoading(true);
+    setCompareError(null);
+    try {
+      const data = await fundApi.compareFunds(selectedCodes);
+      setCompareData(Array.isArray(data) ? data.filter((f: Fund | null) => f && f.code) : []);
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('加载对比数据失败:', error);
+      setCompareData([]);
+      setCompareError('加载对比数据失败，请检查基金代码是否正确');
+    } finally {
+      setCompareLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const loadNavHistory = async () => {
+    if (selectedCodes.length === 0) return;
+    setNavHistoryLoading(true);
+    try {
+      const data = await fundApi.compareNavHistory(selectedCodes);
+      setNavHistory(data);
+    } catch {
+      setNavHistory({});
+    } finally {
+      setNavHistoryLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (showCompare && selectedCodes.length > 0) {
+      loadCompareData();
+      loadNavHistory();
+    } else {
+      setCompareData([]);
+      setCompareError(null);
+      setNavHistory({});
+    }
+    setPremiumData(null);
+  }, [selectedCodes, showCompare]);
+
+  const addFundToCompare = useCallback((code?: string) => {
+    const fundCode = (code || compareSearchCode).trim();
+    if (!fundCode) return;
+    if (selectedCodes.includes(fundCode)) return;
+    if (selectedCodes.length >= 5) return;
+    const exists = allFunds.some(f => f.code === fundCode);
+    if (!exists) return;
+    setSelectedCodes(prev => [...prev, fundCode]);
+    setCompareSearchCode('');
+  }, [compareSearchCode, selectedCodes, allFunds, setSelectedCodes]);
+
+  const removeFundFromCompare = useCallback((code: string) => {
+    setSelectedCodes(prev => prev.filter(c => c !== code));
+  }, [setSelectedCodes]);
+
+  const handleCompareSearchChange = useCallback((value: string) => {
+    if (debounceTimer.current) {
+      clearTimeout(debounceTimer.current);
+    }
+    debounceTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
+      setCompareSearchCode(value);
+    }, 150);
+  }, []);
+
+  const compareSearchOptions = useMemo(() => {
+    const keyword = compareSearchCode.trim();
+    if (!keyword || allFunds.length === 0) return [];
+    return allFunds
+      .filter(f => f.code.includes(keyword) || f.name.includes(keyword))
+      .slice(0, 8)
+      .map(f => ({
+        value: f.code,
+        label: `${f.code} - ${f.name} (${f.industry})`,
+      }));
+  }, [compareSearchCode, allFunds]);
+
+  const navChartOption = useMemo(() => {
+    const codes = Object.keys(navHistory);
+    if (codes.length === 0) return null;
+    const allDates = new Set<string>();
+    codes.forEach(code => navHistory[code]?.forEach(d => allDates.add(d.date)));
+    const sortedDates = Array.from(allDates).sort();
+    if (sortedDates.length < 2) return null;
+    const colors = ['#1677ff', '#52c41a', '#faad14', '#ff4d4f', '#722ed1'];
+    return {
+      tooltip: {
+        trigger: 'axis' as const,
+        formatter: (params: any) => {
+          let html = `${params[0]?.axisValue}<br/>`;
+          params.forEach((p: any) => {
+            html += `${p.marker} ${p.seriesName}: ${p.value}%<br/>`;
+          });
+          return html;
+        },
+      },
+      legend: {
+        data: codes.map(c => {
+          const fund = compareData.find(f => f.code === c) || allFunds.find(f => f.code === c);
+          return fund?.name || c;
+        }),
+        bottom: 0,
+        type: 'scroll' as const,
+      },
+      grid: { top: 20, right: 20, bottom: 40, left: 60 },
+      xAxis: {
+        type: 'category' as const,
+        data: sortedDates,
+        axisLabel: { fontSize: 10, interval: Math.floor(sortedDates.length / 8) },
+      },
+      yAxis: {
+        type: 'value' as const,
+        axisLabel: { formatter: '{value}%', fontSize: 10 },
+        splitLine: { lineStyle: { type: 'dashed' as const } },
+      },
+      series: codes.map((code, i) => {
+        const fund = compareData.find(f => f.code === code) || allFunds.find(f => f.code === code);
+        const dataMap = new Map(navHistory[code]?.map(d => [d.date, d.return_pct]));
+        return {
+          name: fund?.name || code,
+          type: 'line' as const,
+          data: sortedDates.map(d => dataMap.get(d) ?? null),
+          connectNulls: true,
+          smooth: true,
+          lineStyle: { width: 2 },
+          itemStyle: { color: colors[i % colors.length] },
+          showSymbol: false,
+        };
+      }),
+    };
+  }, [navHistory, compareData, allFunds]);
+
+  const handlePremium = async () => {
+    if (selectedCodes.length < 2) return;
+    setPremiumLoading(true);
+    try {
+      const data = await fundCompareApi.premiumAnalyze(selectedCodes);
+      setPremiumData(data);
+    } catch (e: any) {
+      if (e.message?.includes('会员')) {
+        message.warning('深度分析需要开通会员');
+      } else {
+        message.error(e.message || '深度分析失败');
+      }
+    } finally {
+      setPremiumLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const compareChartOption = useMemo(() => {
+    if (compareData.length < 2) return null;
+    return {
+      tooltip: { trigger: 'axis' as const },
+      legend: { data: compareData.map(f => f.name) },
+      xAxis: {
+        type: 'category' as const,
+        data: ['近1年', '近6月', '近3月', '近1月', '近1周'],
+      },
+      yAxis: { type: 'value' as const, axisLabel: { formatter: '{value}%' } },
+      series: compareData.map((fund, i) => ({
+        name: fund.name,
+        type: 'bar' as const,
+        data: [fund.return1y ?? 0, fund.return6m ?? 0, fund.return3m ?? 0, fund.return1m ?? 0, fund.return1w ?? 0],
+        itemStyle: {
+          color: ['#1677ff', '#52c41a', '#faad14', '#ff4d4f', '#722ed1'][i % 5],
+        },
+      })),
+    };
+  }, [compareData]);
+
+  const tableData = useMemo(() => {
+    if (compareData.length === 0) return [];
+    const safeNum = (f: Fund, key: keyof Fund, decimals = 2) => {
+      const v = f[key];
+      if (v === undefined || v === null) return '-';
+      const n = Number(v);
+      return isNaN(n) ? '-' : n.toFixed(decimals);
+    };
+    const safeStr = (f: Fund, key: keyof Fund) => {
+      const v = f[key];
+      return v !== undefined && v !== null ? v : '-';
+    };
+    const entries = (key: string) => Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, key]));
+
+    return [
+      { key: '_group_basic', label: '基本信息', ...entries('_group') },
+      { key: 'index', label: '跟踪指数', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, f.index || '-'])) },
+      { key: 'type', label: '基金类型', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, f.type || '-'])) },
+      { key: 'nav', label: '最新净值', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, f.nav?.toFixed(4) ?? '-'])) },
+      { key: 'fundManager', label: '基金经理', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'fundManager')])) },
+      { key: 'company', label: '基金公司', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'company')])) },
+
+      { key: '_group_return', label: '收益指标', ...entries('_group') },
+      { key: 'return1y', label: '近1年收益', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'return1y')])) },
+      { key: 'return6m', label: '近6月收益', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'return6m')])) },
+      { key: 'return3m', label: '近3月收益', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'return3m')])) },
+      { key: 'return1m', label: '近1月收益', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'return1m')])) },
+      { key: 'return1w', label: '近1周收益', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'return1w')])) },
+
+      { key: '_group_fee', label: '费率详情', ...entries('_group') },
+      { key: 'managementFee', label: '管理费率/年', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'managementFee')])) },
+      { key: 'custodyFee', label: '托管费率/年', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'custodyFee')])) },
+      { key: 'serviceFee', label: '销售服务费/年', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'serviceFee')])) },
+      { key: 'totalFee', label: '综合费率/年', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'totalFee')])) },
+      { key: 'purchaseFee', label: '申购费率(原)', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, f.purchaseFee ? `${f.purchaseFee}%` : '-'])) },
+      { key: 'purchaseFeeDiscount', label: '申购费率(支付宝1折)', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, f.purchaseFeeDiscount ? `${f.purchaseFeeDiscount}%` : '-'])) },
+      { key: 'redeemFee', label: '赎回费率(>=1年)', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, f.redeemFee?.find(r => r.period.includes('1-2年') || r.period.includes('1年'))?.rate !== undefined ? `${f.redeemFee.find(r => r.period.includes('1-2年') || r.period.includes('1年'))!.rate}%` : '-'])) },
+
+      { key: '_group_holder', label: '规模与持有人', ...entries('_group') },
+      { key: 'scale', label: '基金规模(亿)', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'scale', 1)])) },
+      { key: 'share', label: '份额(亿份)', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'share')])) },
+      { key: 'shareChange', label: '份额变化(%)', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'shareChange')])) },
+      { key: 'institutionHold', label: '机构持有(%)', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'institutionHold')])) },
+      { key: 'individualHold', label: '个人持有(%)', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'individualHold')])) },
+
+      { key: '_group_purchase', label: '申购与限额', ...entries('_group') },
+      { key: 'purchaseStatus', label: '申购状态', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'purchaseStatus')])) },
+      { key: 'dailyLimit', label: '每日限额', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, f.dailyLimit === 0 ? '暂停' : f.dailyLimit ? `${f.dailyLimit}万` : '-'])) },
+
+      { key: '_group_valuation', label: '估值指标', ...entries('_group') },
+      { key: 'pe', label: 'PE(TTM)', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'pe')])) },
+      { key: 'pb', label: 'PB', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'pb')])) },
+      { key: 'pePercentile', label: 'PE历史分位(%)', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'pePercentile')])) },
+      { key: 'pbPercentile', label: 'PB历史分位(%)', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeNum(f, 'pbPercentile')])) },
+      { key: 'valuation', label: '估值判断', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'valuation')])) },
+
+      { key: '_group_summary', label: '综合评价', ...entries('_group') },
+      { key: 'rating', label: '推荐评级', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'rating')])) },
+      { key: 'riskLevel', label: '风险等级', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'riskLevel')])) },
+      { key: 'suitableFor', label: '适合人群', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'suitableFor')])) },
+      { key: 'recommendation', label: '推荐理由', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'recommendation')])) },
+      { key: 'investmentAdvice', label: '投资建议', ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, safeStr(f, 'investmentAdvice')])) },
+
+      { key: '_group_holdings', label: '前十大重仓股', ...entries('_group') },
+      ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({
+        key: `holding_${i}`,
+        label: `重仓${i + 1}`,
+        ...Object.fromEntries(compareData.map(f => [f.code, f.topHoldings?.[i] ? `${f.topHoldings[i].name} (${f.topHoldings[i].percentage}%)` : '-'])),
+      })),
+    ];
+  }, [compareData]);
+
+  const tableColumns = useMemo(() => [
+    {
+      title: '指标',
+      dataIndex: 'label',
+      key: 'label',
+      width: 160,
+      fixed: 'left' as const,
+      render: (text: string, record: any) => {
+        if (record.key.startsWith('_group')) {
+          return <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14, color: '#1677ff' }}>{text}</span>;
+        }
+        return <span style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{text}</span>;
+      },
+    },
+    ...compareData.map(fund => ({
+      title: <Link to={`/funds/${fund.code}`} style={{ color: '#1677ff' }}>{fund.name}<div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999', fontWeight: 400 }}>{fund.code}</div></Link>,
+      dataIndex: fund.code,
+      key: fund.code,
+      render: (val: any, record: any) => {
+        if (record.key.startsWith('_group')) return null;
+        if (val === '-' || val === undefined || val === null) return <span style={{ color: isDark ? '#555' : '#ccc' }}>-</span>;
+
+        if (['return1y', 'return6m', 'return3m', 'return1m', 'return1w'].includes(record.key)) {
+          const num = Number(val);
+          return <span style={{ color: getReturnColor(num), fontWeight: 600 }}>{formatReturn(num)}</span>;
+        }
+
+        if (record.key === 'valuation') return getValuationText(val);
+
+        if (record.key === 'rating') return <span style={{ color: '#faad14' }}>{'★'.repeat(Number(val) || 0)}</span>;
+
+        if (['managementFee', 'custodyFee', 'serviceFee', 'totalFee'].includes(record.key)) {
+          const num = Number(val);
+          if (isNaN(num)) return val;
+          const isHigh = record.key === 'totalFee' && num > 0.8;
+          return <span style={{ fontWeight: isHigh ? 700 : 500, color: isHigh ? '#ff4d4f' : undefined }}>{num.toFixed(2)}%</span>;
+        }
+
+        if (['pePercentile', 'pbPercentile'].includes(record.key)) {
+          const num = Number(val);
+          if (isNaN(num)) return val;
+          const color = num < 30 ? '#52c41a' : num > 70 ? '#ff4d4f' : '#1677ff';
+          return <span style={{ color, fontWeight: 600 }}>{num.toFixed(1)}%</span>;
+        }
+
+        if (record.key === 'purchaseStatus') {
+          const statusMap: Record<string, { color: string; text: string }> = {
+            open: { color: 'green', text: '开放申购' },
+            limited: { color: 'orange', text: '限大额' },
+            suspended: { color: 'red', text: '暂停申购' },
+          };
+          const s = statusMap[val] || { color: 'default', text: val };
+          return <Tag color={s.color}>{s.text}</Tag>;
+        }
+
+        if (record.key === 'riskLevel') {
+          const riskMap: Record<string, { color: string; text: string }> = {
+            low: { color: 'green', text: '低风险' },
+            medium: { color: 'blue', text: '中风险' },
+            high: { color: 'red', text: '高风险' },
+          };
+          const r = riskMap[val] || { color: 'default', text: val };
+          return <Tag color={r.color}>{r.text}</Tag>;
+        }
+
+        if (record.key === 'shareChange') {
+          const num = Number(val);
+          if (isNaN(num)) return val;
+          return <span style={{ color: num > 0 ? '#52c41a' : '#ff4d4f', fontWeight: 600 }}>{num > 0 ? '+' : ''}{num}%</span>;
+        }
+
+        if (record.key === 'institutionHold') {
+          const num = Number(val);
+          if (isNaN(num)) return val;
+          return <span style={{ fontWeight: num >= 10 ? 700 : 400, color: num >= 10 ? '#faad14' : undefined }}>{num}%</span>;
+        }
+
+        if (record.key === 'dailyLimit') {
+          return <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: val === '暂停' ? '#ff4d4f' : isDark ? '#e8e8e8' : '#333' }}>{val}</span>;
+        }
+
+        if (['recommendation', 'investmentAdvice'].includes(record.key)) {
+          const text = String(val);
+          return <Tooltip title={text}><span style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{text.length > 30 ? text.slice(0, 30) + '...' : text}</span></Tooltip>;
+        }
+
+        return val;
+      },
+    })),
+  ], [compareData, isDark]);
+
+  if (!showCompare) return null;
+
+  return (
+    <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
+      <Card
+        title={
+          <Space>
+            <SwapOutlined style={{ color: '#1677ff' }} />
+            <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 16 }}>基金对比</span>
+          </Space>
+        }
+        extra={
+          <Button
+            type="text"
+            icon={<CloseCircleOutlined />}
+            onClick={() => { setShowCompare(false); setSelectedCodes([]); setPremiumData(null); }}
+          >
+            关闭对比
+          </Button>
+        }
+        style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
+      >
+        <Space>
+          <AutoComplete
+            value={compareSearchCode}
+            onChange={handleCompareSearchChange}
+            options={compareSearchOptions}
+            onSelect={(value) => {
+              setCompareSearchCode('');
+              addFundToCompare(value);
+            }}
+            style={{ width: 400 }}
+            placeholder="输入基金代码或名称搜索添加..."
+            allowClear
+          />
+          <Button
+            type="primary"
+            icon={<SearchOutlined />}
+            onClick={() => addFundToCompare()}
+            disabled={!compareSearchCode.trim() || selectedCodes.length >= 5}
+          >
+            添加
+          </Button>
+        </Space>
+        <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
+          <span style={{ color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666', fontSize: 13 }}>已添加 {selectedCodes.length}/5 只基金</span>
+          {selectedCodes.length > 0 && (
+            <Space size={8} wrap style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
+              {selectedCodes.map((code) => {
+                const fund = allFunds.find(f => f.code === code);
+                return (
+                  <Tag
+                    key={code}
+                    closable
+                    onClose={() => removeFundFromCompare(code)}
+                    color="blue"
+                  >
+                    {fund ? `${fund.name}(${code})` : code}
+                  </Tag>
+                );
+              })}
+            </Space>
+          )}
+        </div>
+      </Card>
+
+      {compareError && (
+        <Alert type="error" message={compareError} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }} closable onClose={() => setCompareError(null)} />
+      )}
+
+      {compareLoading ? (
+        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 60 }}><Spin size="large" /></div>
+      ) : compareData.length === 0 ? (
+        <Card style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 40, color: '#999' }}>
+          <p style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>请添加基金开始对比</p>
+          <p style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: 13 }}>支持同时对比最多5只基金</p>
+        </Card>
+      ) : (
+        <>
+          {compareChartOption && (
+            <Card title="收益对比" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+              <ReactECharts theme={getEchartsTheme(isDark)} option={compareChartOption} style={{ height: 300 }} opts={{ renderer: 'svg' }} />
+            </Card>
+          )}
+
+          {navChartOption && (
+            <Card
+              title="净值走势对比（近6月）"
+              style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
+              extra={navHistoryLoading ? <Spin size="small" /> : null}
+            >
+              <ReactECharts theme={getEchartsTheme(isDark)} option={navChartOption} style={{ height: 350 }} opts={{ renderer: 'svg' }} />
+              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#8c8c8c' }}>
+                起点归一化为0%，展示各基金相对收益走势
+              </div>
+            </Card>
+          )}
+
+          <Card title="对比详情" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+            <div className="compare-table-scroll">
+              <Table
+                dataSource={tableData}
+                columns={tableColumns}
+                pagination={false}
+                size="small"
+                rowKey="key"
+                rowClassName={(record) => record.key.startsWith('_group') ? 'compare-group-row' : ''}
+              />
+            </div>
+
+            {compareData.length >= 2 && (() => {
+              const validFunds = compareData.filter(f => f.return1y !== undefined && f.return1y !== null);
+              if (validFunds.length < 2) return null;
+              const bestReturn = validFunds.reduce((best, f) => f.return1y > best.return1y ? f : best);
+              const validFeeFunds = compareData.filter(f => f.totalFee !== undefined && f.totalFee !== null);
+              const bestFee = validFeeFunds.length > 0
+                ? validFeeFunds.reduce((best, f) => (f.totalFee || 999) < (best.totalFee || 999) ? f : best)
+                : null;
+              return (
+                <Alert
+                  type="success"
+                  message="对比结论"
+                  description={
+                    <span>
+                      收益最高：<strong>{bestReturn.name}</strong>（近1年 {bestReturn.return1y?.toFixed(2)}%）
+                      {bestFee && bestReturn.code !== bestFee.code && (
+                        <>，费率最低：<strong>{bestFee.name}</strong>（{bestFee.totalFee?.toFixed(2)}%/年）</>
+                      )}
+                    </span>
+                  }
+                  style={{ marginTop: 16 }}
+                  showIcon
+                />
+              );
+            })()}
+          </Card>
+
+          {/* 深度分析按钮 */}
+          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', margin: '16px 0' }}>
+            <Button type="primary" loading={premiumLoading} onClick={handlePremium}
+              disabled={selectedCodes.length < 2}>
+              深度分析（会员）
+            </Button>
+          </div>
+
+          {/* 深度分析结果 */}
+          {premiumData && (
+            <>
+              <Card title="风险指标" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+                <Table dataSource={premiumData.results} rowKey="code" size="small" pagination={false}
+                  columns={[
+                    { title: '基金', dataIndex: 'name' },
+                    { title: '年化波动率', render: (_: any, r: any) => `${r.riskMetrics.volatility}%` },
+                    { title: '最大回撤', render: (_: any, r: any) => <span style={{ color: '#ff4d4f' }}>{r.riskMetrics.maxDrawdown}%</span> },
+                    { title: '夏普比率', render: (_: any, r: any) => <span style={{ color: r.riskMetrics.sharpeRatio > 0 ? '#52c41a' : '#ff4d4f' }}>{r.riskMetrics.sharpeRatio}</span> },
+                    { title: '卡玛比率', render: (_: any, r: any) => r.riskMetrics.calmarRatio },
+                    { title: '3年持有成本', render: (_: any, r: any) => `${r.feeComparison.cost3y}%` },
+                  ]}
+                />
+              </Card>
+              <Card title="投资建议" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+                <Space direction="vertical" style={{ width: '100%' }}>
+                  <div><Tag color="blue">短期</Tag> {premiumData.recommendation.shortTerm}</div>
+                  <div><Tag color="green">中期</Tag> {premiumData.recommendation.mediumTerm}</div>
+                  <div><Tag color="purple">长期</Tag> {premiumData.recommendation.longTerm}</div>
+                  <div><Tag color="orange">低费率</Tag> {premiumData.recommendation.lowestFee}</div>
+                </Space>
+              </Card>
+            </>
+          )}
+        </>
+      )}
+
+      <Card title="热门对比组合">
+        <Row gutter={16}>

+import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
+import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
+import { Card, Spin, Alert, Button } from 'antd';
+import { fundApi } from '../../services/api';
+import type { HS300Analysis } from '../../types';
+
+interface HS300AnalysisPanelProps {
+  visible: boolean;
+  isDark: boolean;
+}
+
+export function HS300AnalysisPanel({ visible, isDark }: HS300AnalysisPanelProps) {
+  const [hs300Data, setHs300Data] = useState<HS300Analysis | null>(null);
+  const [hs300Loading, setHs300Loading] = useState(false);
+  const [hs300Tab, setHs300Tab] = useState('funds');
+  const [hs300SortField, setHs300SortField] = useState<string>('return1y');
+  const [hs300SortOrder, setHs300SortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');
+  const [hs300FundFilter, setHs300FundFilter] = useState<'all' | 'etf' | 'link' | 'enhanced'>('all');
+
+  const loadHS300 = async () => {
+    setHs300Loading(true);
+    try {
+      const result = await fundApi.getHS300Analysis();
+      setHs300Data(result);
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('加载沪深300分析数据失败:', error);
+    } finally {
+      setHs300Loading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (visible && !hs300Data && !hs300Loading) {
+      loadHS300();
+    }
+  }, [visible]);
+
+  const hs300SortIcon = (field: string) => {
+    if (hs300SortField !== field) return '↕';
+    return hs300SortOrder === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓';
+  };
+
+  const hs300HandleSort = (field: string) => {
+    if (hs300SortField === field) {
+      setHs300SortOrder(hs300SortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
+    } else {
+      setHs300SortField(field);
+      setHs300SortOrder('desc');
+    }
+  };
+
+  const hs300FilteredFunds = useMemo(() => {
+    if (!hs300Data) return [];
+    let funds = [...hs300Data.funds];
+    if (hs300FundFilter === 'etf') funds = funds.filter(f => f.isETF);
+    else if (hs300FundFilter === 'link') funds = funds.filter(f => !f.isETF && !f.isEnhanced);
+    else if (hs300FundFilter === 'enhanced') funds = funds.filter(f => f.isEnhanced);
+    return funds.sort((a, b) => {
+      let valA = 0, valB = 0;
+      switch (hs300SortField) {
+        case 'return1y': valA = a.return1y ?? 0; valB = b.return1y ?? 0; break;
+        case 'return6m': valA = a.return6m ?? 0; valB = b.return6m ?? 0; break;
+        case 'return3m': valA = a.return3m ?? 0; valB = b.return3m ?? 0; break;
+        case 'return1m': valA = a.return1m ?? 0; valB = b.return1m ?? 0; break;
+        case 'totalFee': valA = a.totalFee ?? 0; valB = b.totalFee ?? 0; break;
+        case 'scale': valA = a.scale ?? 0; valB = b.scale ?? 0; break;
+        default: valA = a.return1y ?? 0; valB = b.return1y ?? 0;
+      }
+      return hs300SortOrder === 'asc' ? valA - valB : valB - valA;
+    });
+  }, [hs300Data, hs300SortField, hs300SortOrder, hs300FundFilter]);
+
+  const hs300GetValuationColor = (v: string) => {
+    if (v.includes('极低') || v.includes('低估')) return '#52c41a';
+    if (v.includes('偏低')) return '#73d13d';
+    if (v.includes('合理')) return '#1677ff';
+    if (v.includes('偏高') || v.includes('高')) return '#ff4d4f';
+    return isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666';
+  };
+
+  if (!visible) return null;
+
+  return (
+    <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+      {hs300Loading ? (
+        <Card style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 60 }}>
+          <Spin size="large" tip="加载沪深300分析数据..." />
+        </Card>
+      ) : !hs300Data ? (
+        <Card>
+          <Alert type="error" message="加载失败" description="沪深300分析数据加载失败，请稍后重试" showIcon style={{ marginBottom: 16 }} />
+          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+            <Button type="primary" onClick={loadHS300}>重新加载</Button>
+          </div>
+        </Card>
+      ) : (
+        <>
+          {/* 估值概览 */}
+          <Card style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a5f 0%, #2d5a87 100%)', border: 'none', marginBottom: 16 }}>
+            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 20 }}>
+              <div>
+                <h3 style={{ color: 'white', marginBottom: 8 }}>沪深300指数估值</h3>
+                <p style={{ opacity: 0.85, fontSize: 14, color: 'white' }}>{hs300Data.recommendation.summary}</p>
+              </div>
+              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 16, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+                {[
+                  { label: 'PE(TTM)', value: `${hs300Data.valuation.pe ?? '--'}x` },
+                  { label: 'PB', value: `${hs300Data.valuation.pb ?? '--'}x` },
+                  { label: 'PE历史分位', value: `${hs300Data.valuation.pePercentile ?? '--'}%` },
+                  { label: '股息率', value: `${hs300Data.valuation.dividendYield ?? '--'}%` },
+                ].map(item => (
+                  <div key={item.label} style={{ background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)', padding: '10px 16px', borderRadius: 8, textAlign: 'center' }}>
+                    <div style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 700, color: 'white' }}>{item.value}</div>
+                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11, opacity: 0.8, color: 'white' }}>{item.label}</div>
+                  </div>
+                ))}
+              </div>
+            </div>
+          </Card>
+
+          {/* 标签页 */}
+          <Card style={{ padding: 0, marginBottom: 16 }}>
+            <div style={{ display: 'flex', borderBottom: isDark ? '1px solid #333' : '1px solid #e8e8e8', overflowX: 'auto' }}>
+              {[
+                { key: 'funds', label: `基金对比 (${hs300Data.funds.length})` },
+                { key: 'holdings', label: `权重股分析 (${hs300Data.topHoldings.length})` },
+                { key: 'strategy', label: '投资策略' },
+              ].map((tab) => (
+                <button
+                  key={tab.key}
+                  onClick={() => setHs300Tab(tab.key)}
+                  style={{
+                    padding: '10px 20px', border: 'none', background: 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
+                    borderBottom: hs300Tab === tab.key ? '2px solid #1677ff' : '2px solid transparent',
+                    color: hs300Tab === tab.key ? '#1677ff' : (isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666'),
+                    fontWeight: hs300Tab === tab.key ? 600 : 400, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
+                  }}
+                >
+                  {tab.label}
+                </button>
+              ))}
+            </div>
+          </Card>
+
+          {/* 基金对比 */}
+          {hs300Tab === 'funds' && (
+            <>
+              <Card style={{ padding: '12px 20px', marginBottom: 16 }}>
+                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+                  <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666', marginRight: 8 }}>筛选：</span>
+                  {[
+                    { key: 'all', label: '全部' },
+                    { key: 'etf', label: 'ETF' },
+                    { key: 'link', label: 'ETF联接' },
+                    { key: 'enhanced', label: '指数增强' },
+                  ].map(f => (
+                    <button
+                      key={f.key}
+                      onClick={() => setHs300FundFilter(f.key as any)}
+                      style={{
+                        padding: '4px 12px',
+                        border: hs300FundFilter === f.key ? '1px solid #1677ff' : (isDark ? '1px solid #444' : '1px solid #d9d9d9'),
+                        borderRadius: 4,
+                        background: hs300FundFilter === f.key ? (isDark ? '#111a2c' : '#e6f4ff') : (isDark ? '#1a1a1a' : 'white'),
+                        color: hs300FundFilter === f.key ? '#1677ff' : (isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666'),
+                        cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 13,
+                      }}
+                    >
+                      {f.label}
+                    </button>
+                  ))}
+                </div>
+              </Card>
+
+              <Card style={{ background: isDark ? '#162312' : '#f6ffed', border: '1px solid #b7eb8f', marginBottom: 16 }}>
+                <h4 style={{ color: '#52c41a', marginBottom: 12 }}>首选推荐</h4>
+                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
+                  {hs300Data.recommendation.bestPicks.map(pick => (
+                    <div key={pick.code} style={{ background: isDark ? '#1a1a1a' : 'white', padding: 12, borderRadius: 8 }}>
+                      <Link to={`/funds/${pick.code}`} style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#1677ff' }}>{pick.name} ({pick.code})</Link>
+                      <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666', marginTop: 4 }}>{pick.reason}</p>
+                    </div>
+                  ))}
+                </div>
+              </Card>
+
+              <Card>
+                <h3 className="card-title">沪深300指数基金完整对比</h3>
+                <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
+                  <table className="table">
+                    <thead>
+                      <tr>
+                        <th>代码</th>
+                        <th>基金名称</th>
+                        <th>类型</th>
+                        <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={() => hs300HandleSort('return1y')}>近1年 {hs300SortIcon('return1y')}</th>
+                        <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={() => hs300HandleSort('return6m')}>近6月 {hs300SortIcon('return6m')}</th>
+                        <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={() => hs300HandleSort('return3m')}>近3月 {hs300SortIcon('return3m')}</th>
+                        <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={() => hs300HandleSort('return1m')}>近1月 {hs300SortIcon('return1m')}</th>
+                        <th>近1周</th>
+                        <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={() => hs300HandleSort('totalFee')}>综合费率 {hs300SortIcon('totalFee')}</th>
+                        <th>申购费</th>
+                        <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={() => hs300HandleSort('scale')}>规模(亿) {hs300SortIcon('scale')}</th>
+                        <th>超额收益</th>
+                        <th>评级</th>

+                          <td><span className={(fund.return6m ?? 0) > 0 ? 'rise' : (fund.return6m ?? 0) < 0 ? 'fall' : ''}>{(fund.return6m ?? 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{(fund.return6m ?? 0).toFixed(2)}%</span></td>
+                          <td><span className={(fund.return3m ?? 0) > 0 ? 'rise' : (fund.return3m ?? 0) < 0 ? 'fall' : ''}>{(fund.return3m ?? 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{(fund.return3m ?? 0).toFixed(2)}%</span></td>
+                          <td><span className={(fund.return1m ?? 0) > 0 ? 'rise' : (fund.return1m ?? 0) < 0 ? 'fall' : ''}>{(fund.return1m ?? 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{(fund.return1m ?? 0).toFixed(2)}%</span></td>
+                          <td><span className={(fund.return1w ?? 0) > 0 ? 'rise' : (fund.return1w ?? 0) < 0 ? 'fall' : ''}>{(fund.return1w ?? 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{(fund.return1w ?? 0).toFixed(2)}%</span></td>

+  const handleDcaFrequencyChange = (val: string) => {
+    setDcaFrequency(val as any);
+    setDcaAmount(DCA_FREQ_CONFIG[val].defaultAmount);
+    setDcaResult(null);
+  };
+
+  const handleDcaCalculate = () => {
+    const cfg = DCA_FREQ_CONFIG[dcaFrequency];
+    const periodRate = dcaExpectedReturn / 100 / cfg.periodsPerYear;
+
+    let totalPeriods: number;
+    if (dcaFrequency === 'daily') totalPeriods = Math.round(dcaPeriod * TRADING_DAYS_PER_MONTH);
+    else if (dcaFrequency === 'weekly') totalPeriods = Math.round(dcaPeriod * WEEKS_PER_MONTH);
+    else totalPeriods = dcaPeriod;
+
+    let totalValue = 0;
+    const details: any[] = [];
+
+    for (let i = 0; i < totalPeriods; i++) {
+      totalValue = (totalValue + dcaAmount) * (1 + periodRate);
+      const cumulativeInvestment = dcaAmount * (i + 1);
+      details.push({
+        index: i + 1,
+        investment: dcaAmount,
+        cumulativeInvestment,
+        value: parseFloat(totalValue.toFixed(2)),
+        returnRate: parseFloat((((totalValue - cumulativeInvestment) / cumulativeInvestment) * 100).toFixed(2)),
+      });
+    }
+
+    const totalInvestment = dcaAmount * totalPeriods;
+    const totalReturn = totalInvestment > 0 ? ((totalValue - totalInvestment) / totalInvestment) * 100 : 0;
+    const years = dcaPeriod / 12;
+    const annualizedReturn = years > 0 ? (Math.pow(totalValue / totalInvestment, 1 / years) - 1) * 100 : 0;
+
+    setDcaResult({
+      totalInvestment,
+      totalValue: parseFloat(totalValue.toFixed(2)),
+      totalReturn: parseFloat(totalReturn.toFixed(2)),
+      annualizedReturn: parseFloat(annualizedReturn.toFixed(2)),
+      details,
+      totalPeriods,
+    });
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <>
+      <Card title="定投参数" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+        <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+          <span style={{ fontWeight: 500, marginRight: 12 }}>定投频率：</span>
+          <Segmented
+            value={dcaFrequency}
+            onChange={(val: string | number) => handleDcaFrequencyChange(val as string)}
+            options={[
+              { label: '每日', value: 'daily' },
+              { label: '每周', value: 'weekly' },
+              { label: '每月', value: 'monthly' },
+            ]}
+          />
+        </div>
+
+        <Row gutter={16}>
+          <Col xs={24} sm={8}>
+            <div style={{ marginBottom: 8, fontWeight: 500 }}>{DCA_FREQ_CONFIG[dcaFrequency].amountLabel}</div>
+            <InputNumber
+              value={dcaAmount}
+              onChange={(v) => setDcaAmount(v || DCA_FREQ_CONFIG[dcaFrequency].defaultAmount)}
+              min={1}
+              step={dcaFrequency === 'daily' ? 10 : dcaFrequency === 'weekly' ? 50 : 100}
+              style={{ width: '100%' }}
+            />
+          </Col>
+          <Col xs={24} sm={8}>
+            <div style={{ marginBottom: 8, fontWeight: 500 }}>{DCA_FREQ_CONFIG[dcaFrequency].periodLabel}</div>
+            <InputNumber value={dcaPeriod} onChange={(v) => setDcaPeriod(v || 36)} min={1} max={120} style={{ width: '100%' }} />
+          </Col>
+          <Col xs={24} sm={8}>
+            <div style={{ marginBottom: 8, fontWeight: 500 }}>预期年化收益率（%）</div>
+            <InputNumber value={dcaExpectedReturn} onChange={(v) => setDcaExpectedReturn(v || 10)} min={-50} max={100} step={0.5} style={{ width: '100%' }} />
+          </Col>
+        </Row>
+
+        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
+          <span style={{ color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666', marginRight: 12 }}>快捷设置：</span>
+          <Space>
+            {[
+              { label: '保守型', freq: 'monthly' as const, amount: 500, period: 12, ret: 8 },
+              { label: '稳健型', freq: 'monthly' as const, amount: 1000, period: 36, ret: 10 },
+              { label: '激进型', freq: 'monthly' as const, amount: 2000, period: 60, ret: 15 },
+            ].map(p => (
+              <Tag
+                key={p.label}
+                style={{
+                  cursor: 'pointer',
+                  border: selectedDcaPreset === p.label ? '2px solid #1677ff' : undefined,
+                  background: selectedDcaPreset === p.label ? (isDark ? 'rgba(22,119,255,0.15)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.06)') : undefined,
+                  fontWeight: selectedDcaPreset === p.label ? 600 : undefined,
+                  padding: '2px 12px',
+                  borderRadius: 12,
+                }}
+                onClick={() => {
+                  setSelectedDcaPreset(p.label);

+      </Card>
+
+      {dcaResult && (
+        <>
+          {selectedDcaPreset && (
+            <div style={{
+              marginBottom: 12,
+              padding: '8px 14px',
+              borderRadius: 8,
+              background: isDark ? 'rgba(22,119,255,0.1)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.04)',
+              border: `1px solid ${isDark ? 'rgba(22,119,255,0.2)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.12)'}`,
+              fontSize: 13,
+              color: isDark ? '#8cb4ff' : '#1677ff',
+              fontWeight: 500,
+            }}>
+              当前方案：{selectedDcaPreset}
+            </div>
+          )}
+          <Card title="计算结果" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>

+              </Col>
+              <Col xs={12} sm={6}>
+                <Statistic title="总资产" value={dcaResult.totalValue} precision={2} prefix="¥" valueStyle={{ color: '#1677ff' }} />
+              </Col>
+              <Col xs={12} sm={6}>

+
+export function DeepAnalysisTab({

+  holdingsRisk, holdingsRiskLoading, attributionData, attributionLoading,
+  overlapData, overlapLoading, isDark,
+  onRefreshIndustry, onRefreshOverlap, onRefreshFee, onRefreshRisk, onRefreshAttribution,

+    xAxis: { type: 'value', name: '收益贡献(%)' },

+      data: attributionData.attributions.map((a: any) => ({
+        value: a.contribution, pnl: a.pnl,
+        itemStyle: { color: a.contribution >= 0 ? '#ff4d4f' : '#52c41a' },

+      label: { show: true, position: 'right', formatter: (p: any) => `${p.value >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${p.value}%`, fontSize: 11 },
+    }],
+  } : null;

+        </div>

+      <Row gutter={16} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+        <Col span={24}>

+      { name: '账户市值', type: 'line', data: goalResult.yearlyData.map((d: any) => d.value), lineStyle: { color: '#52c41a', width: 3 }, itemStyle: { color: '#52c41a' }, smooth: true },

+  } : null;

+              <Slider value={goalYears} onChange={setGoalYears} min={1} max={30} marks={{ 1: '1年', 5: '5年', 10: '10年', 20: '20年', 30: '30年' }} />
+            </div>
+            <Button type="primary" block size="large" onClick={handleGoalCalculate} loading={goalCalculating} icon={<CalculatorOutlined />}>
+              开始测算
+            </Button>
+          </Card>
+        </Col>
+        <Col xs={24} lg={14}>
+          {goalResult ? (
+            <>
+              {selectedGoalPreset && (
+                <div style={{
+                  marginBottom: 12,
+                  padding: '8px 14px',
+                  borderRadius: 8,
+                  background: isDark ? 'rgba(22,119,255,0.1)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.04)',
+                  border: `1px solid ${isDark ? 'rgba(22,119,255,0.2)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.12)'}`,
+                  fontSize: 13,
+                  color: isDark ? '#8cb4ff' : '#1677ff',
+                  fontWeight: 500,
+                }}>
+                  {GOAL_PRESETS.find(p => p.label === selectedGoalPreset)?.icon} 当前方案：{selectedGoalPreset}
+                </div>
+              )}
+              <Alert
+                type={goalResult.canReach ? 'success' : 'warning'}
+                icon={goalResult.canReach ? <CheckCircleOutlined /> : <WarningOutlined />}
+                message={goalResult.canReach ? '目标可达成！' : '目标较难达成'}
+                description={goalResult.canReach ? `按照当前方案，预计${goalResult.yearsToGoal}年可达成目标` : `建议每月投入¥${goalResult.requiredMonthly?.toLocaleString()}，或延长投资年限`}
+                showIcon
+                style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
+              />
+              <Row gutter={16} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+                <Col span={8}>
+                  <Card style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)', border: 'none' }}>
+                    <Statistic title={<span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)' }}>预计市值</span>} value={goalResult.projection.futureValue} prefix="¥" valueStyle={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: 22 }} />
+                  </Card>
+                </Col>

+                  <Card style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #43e97b 0%, #38f9d7 100%)', border: 'none' }}>

+                  </Card>
+                </Col>
+                <Col span={8}>
+                  <Card style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #fa709a 0%, #fee140 100%)', border: 'none' }}>
+                    <Statistic title={<span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)' }}>总收益率</span>} value={goalResult.projection.returnRate} suffix="%" valueStyle={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: 22 }} />
+                  </Card>
+                </Col>
+              </Row>
+              <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+                <Row gutter={16}>
+                  <Col span={8}><Statistic title="目标金额" value={goalResult.targetAmount} prefix="¥" /></Col>
+                  <Col span={8}><Statistic title="累计投入" value={goalResult.projection.totalInvested} prefix="¥" /></Col>
+                  <Col span={8}><Statistic title="达成时间" value={goalResult.yearsToGoal || '-'} suffix="年" prefix={<ClockCircleOutlined />} /></Col>
+                </Row>
+              </Card>
+              {goalChartOption && (
+                <Card title={<span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>资产增长预测</span>}>
+                  <ReactECharts option={goalChartOption} style={{ height: 350 }} />
+                </Card>
+              )}
+            </>
+          ) : (
+            <Card style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 60 }}>
+              <TrophyOutlined style={{ fontSize: 48, color: isDark ? '#555' : '#d9d9d9', marginBottom: 16 }} />
+              <p style={{ fontSize: 16, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999' }}>设定目标参数，点击"开始测算"查看结果</p>
+            </Card>
+          )}
+        </Col>
+      </Row>
+    </>
+  );
+}

+import { Card, Row, Col } from 'antd';
+import ReactECharts from 'echarts-for-react';
+import type { PortfolioHolding, PortfolioSummary } from '../../types';
+import { getEchartsTheme } from '../../utils/echarts-theme';
+
+interface Props {
+  holdings: PortfolioHolding[];
+  summary: PortfolioSummary | null;
+  benchmarkData: any[];
+  isDark: boolean;
+}
+
+export function HoldingsCharts({ holdings, summary, benchmarkData, isDark }: Props) {
+  const pieOption = holdings.length > 0 ? {
+    tooltip: { trigger: 'item', formatter: '{b}: {d}%' },
+    legend: { bottom: 0, type: 'scroll' },
+    series: [{
+      type: 'pie',
+      radius: ['40%', '65%'],
+      label: { formatter: '{b}\n{d}%' },
+      data: holdings.map(h => ({
+        name: h.fund_name,
+        value: h.market_value,
+      })),
+    }],
+  } : null;
+
+  const barOption = holdings.length > 0 ? {
+    tooltip: { trigger: 'axis' },
+    xAxis: {
+      type: 'category',
+      data: holdings.map(h => h.fund_name.slice(0, 6)),
+      axisLabel: { rotate: 30 },
+    },
+    yAxis: { type: 'value', name: '盈亏(元)' },
+    series: [{
+      type: 'bar',
+      data: holdings.map(h => ({
+        value: h.pnl,
+        itemStyle: { color: h.pnl >= 0 ? (isDark ? '#ff4d4f' : '#cf1322') : (isDark ? '#52c41a' : '#3f8600') },
+      })),
+    }],
+  } : null;
+
+  return (
+    <>
+      {holdings.length > 0 && pieOption && barOption && (
+        <Row gutter={[16, 16]} style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
+          <Col xs={24} lg={12}>
+            <Card title="持仓分布">
+              <ReactECharts theme={getEchartsTheme(isDark)} option={pieOption} style={{ height: 300 }} />
+            </Card>
+          </Col>
+          <Col xs={24} lg={12}>
+            <Card title="各基金盈亏">
+              <ReactECharts theme={getEchartsTheme(isDark)} option={barOption} style={{ height: 300 }} />
+            </Card>
+          </Col>
+        </Row>
+      )}
+
+      {holdings.length > 0 && benchmarkData.length > 0 && (
+        <Card
+          title="持仓 vs 沪深300 基准对比"
+          style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}
+        >
+          <ReactECharts
+            theme={getEchartsTheme(isDark)}
+            option={{
+              tooltip: {
+                trigger: 'axis',
+                formatter: (params: any) => {
+                  let html = `${params[0]?.axisValue}<br/>`;
+                  params.forEach((p: any) => {
+                    html += `${p.marker} ${p.seriesName}: ${p.value}%<br/>`;
+                  });
+                  return html;
+                },
+              },
+              legend: { data: ['我的持仓', '沪深300基准'], bottom: 0 },
+              grid: { top: 20, right: 20, bottom: 40, left: 60 },
+              xAxis: {
+                type: 'category',
+                data: benchmarkData.map(d => d.date),
+                axisLabel: { fontSize: 10, interval: Math.floor(benchmarkData.length / 8) },
+              },
+              yAxis: {
+                type: 'value',
+                axisLabel: { formatter: '{value}%', fontSize: 10 },
+                splitLine: { lineStyle: { type: 'dashed' } },
+              },
+              series: [
+                {
+                  name: '沪深300基准',
+                  type: 'line',
+                  data: benchmarkData.map(d => parseFloat(d.return_pct)),
+                  lineStyle: { width: 2, color: isDark ? '#666' : '#999', type: 'dashed' },
+                  itemStyle: { color: isDark ? '#666' : '#999' },
+                  showSymbol: false,
+                },
+                {
+                  name: '我的持仓',
+                  type: 'line',
+                  data: benchmarkData.map(() => summary?.totalReturn || 0),
+                  lineStyle: { width: 2, color: '#1677ff' },
+                  itemStyle: { color: '#1677ff' },
+                  showSymbol: false,
+                  areaStyle: {
+                    color: { type: 'linear', x: 0, y: 0, x2: 0, y2: 1,
+                      colorStops: [
+                        { offset: 0, color: 'rgba(22,119,255,0.15)' },
+                        { offset: 1, color: 'rgba(22,119,255,0.02)' },
+                      ],
+                    },
+                  },
+                },
+              ],
+            }}
+            style={{ height: 300 }}
+            opts={{ renderer: 'svg' }}
+          />
+          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 32, marginTop: 12 }}>

+              <div style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 700, color: (summary?.totalReturn || 0) >= 0 ? (isDark ? '#ff4d4f' : '#cf1322') : (isDark ? '#52c41a' : '#3f8600') }}>
+                {(summary?.totalReturn || 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{(summary?.totalReturn || 0).toFixed(2)}%
+              </div>
+            </div>
+            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+              <div style={{ color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#8c8c8c', fontSize: 12 }}>沪深300同期</div>
+              <div style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 700, color: parseFloat(benchmarkData[benchmarkData.length - 1]?.return_pct || 0) >= 0 ? (isDark ? '#ff4d4f' : '#cf1322') : (isDark ? '#52c41a' : '#3f8600') }}>
+                {benchmarkData.length > 0 ? `${parseFloat(benchmarkData[benchmarkData.length - 1].return_pct) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${benchmarkData[benchmarkData.length - 1].return_pct}%` : '-'}
+              </div>
+            </div>
+            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+              <div style={{ color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#8c8c8c', fontSize: 12 }}>超额收益</div>
+              <div style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 700, color: '#722ed1' }}>
+                {benchmarkData.length > 0
+                  ? `${((summary?.totalReturn || 0) - parseFloat(benchmarkData[benchmarkData.length - 1].return_pct)) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${((summary?.totalReturn || 0) - parseFloat(benchmarkData[benchmarkData.length - 1].return_pct)).toFixed(2)}%`
+                  : '-'}
+              </div>
+            </div>
+          </div>
+        </Card>
+      )}
+    </>
+  );

+import { Card, Table, Row, Col, Tag, Alert, Progress, Tooltip, Space } from 'antd';
+import { SafetyOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
+import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
+import type { PortfolioHolding } from '../../types';
+
+interface Props {
+  holdings: PortfolioHolding[];
+  isDark: boolean;
+  getHoldingDays: (h: PortfolioHolding) => number;
+  getFeeTier: (days: number) => { label: string; color: string; icon?: React.ReactNode };
+}
+
+export function HoldingsDiagnosis({ holdings, isDark, getHoldingDays, getFeeTier }: Props) {
+  if (holdings.length === 0) return null;
+
+  const winners = holdings.filter(h => h.pnl > 0).sort((a, b) => b.pnl - a.pnl);
+  const losers = holdings.filter(h => h.pnl < 0).sort((a, b) => a.pnl - b.pnl);
+  const totalWinPnl = winners.reduce((s, h) => s + h.pnl, 0);
+  const totalLossPnl = losers.reduce((s, h) => s + h.pnl, 0);
+  const winRate = holdings.length > 0 ? (winners.length / holdings.length * 100) : 0;
+  const topWinner = winners[0];
+  const topLoser = losers[0];
+  const totalMV = holdings.reduce((s, h) => s + h.market_value, 0);
+  const sortedByMV = [...holdings].sort((a, b) => b.market_value - a.market_value);
+  const top1Weight = sortedByMV.length > 0 ? sortedByMV[0].market_value / (totalMV || 1) * 100 : 0;
+  const top3Weight = sortedByMV.slice(0, 3).reduce((s, h) => s + h.market_value, 0) / (totalMV || 1) * 100;
+  const nearFreeFee = holdings.filter(h => { const d = getHoldingDays(h); return d >= 365 && d < 730; });
+
+  let healthScore = 50;
+  if (holdings.length >= 5) healthScore += 15;
+  else if (holdings.length >= 3) healthScore += 10;
+  else if (holdings.length >= 2) healthScore += 5;
+  if (top1Weight < 30) healthScore += 15;
+  else if (top1Weight < 50) healthScore += 8;
+  healthScore += Math.round(winRate * 0.25);
+  const plRatio = totalLossPnl !== 0 ? Math.abs(totalWinPnl / totalLossPnl) : 2;
+  healthScore += Math.min(20, Math.round(plRatio * 10));
+  const longTermCount = holdings.filter(h => getHoldingDays(h) >= 730).length;
+  healthScore += Math.round((longTermCount / holdings.length) * 15);
+  healthScore = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, healthScore));
+  const healthColor = healthScore >= 80 ? '#52c41a' : healthScore >= 60 ? '#faad14' : healthScore >= 40 ? '#fa8c16' : '#ff4d4f';
+  const healthLabel = healthScore >= 80 ? '优秀' : healthScore >= 60 ? '良好' : healthScore >= 40 ? '一般' : '需改善';
+
+  return (
+    <Card title={<span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}><SafetyOutlined style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />持仓诊断 & 调整建议</span>} style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
+      <Row gutter={[16, 16]} style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
+        <Col xs={24} sm={8}>
+          <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center', background: isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)' : '#fafafa' }}>
+            <Progress type="circle" percent={healthScore} size={100} strokeColor={healthColor}
+              format={() => <span style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 700, color: healthColor }}>{healthScore}</span>} />
+            <div style={{ marginTop: 8, fontWeight: 600, color: healthColor }}>组合健康 {healthLabel}</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999', marginTop: 4 }}>综合分散度、胜率、盈亏比、费用</div>
+          </Card>
+        </Col>
+        <Col xs={12} sm={4}>
+          <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: winRate >= 50 ? '#52c41a' : '#ff4d4f' }}>{winRate.toFixed(0)}%</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666' }}>持仓胜率</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999' }}>{winners.length}盈 / {losers.length}亏</div>
+          </Card>
+        </Col>
+        <Col xs={12} sm={4}>
+          <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: '#1677ff' }}>
+              {totalLossPnl !== 0 ? Math.abs(totalWinPnl / totalLossPnl).toFixed(2) : '-'}
+            </div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666' }}>盈亏比</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999' }}>盈¥{totalWinPnl.toFixed(0)}</div>
+          </Card>
+        </Col>
+        <Col xs={12} sm={4}>
+          <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: isDark ? '#ff4d4f' : '#cf1322' }}>
+              {topWinner ? `+¥${topWinner.pnl.toFixed(0)}` : '-'}
+            </div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666' }}>最大盈利</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999' }}>{topWinner?.fund_name?.slice(0, 6) || '-'}</div>
+          </Card>
+        </Col>
+        <Col xs={12} sm={4}>
+          <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: isDark ? '#52c41a' : '#3f8600' }}>
+              {topLoser ? `-¥${Math.abs(topLoser.pnl).toFixed(0)}` : '-'}
+            </div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666' }}>最大亏损</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999' }}>{topLoser?.fund_name?.slice(0, 6) || '-'}</div>
+          </Card>
+        </Col>
+      </Row>
+
+      <Card title="逐只基金诊断" size="small" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+        <Table dataSource={holdings.map(h => ({ ...h, key: h.fund_code }))} size="small" pagination={false}
+          scroll={{ x: 700 }}
+          columns={[
+            { title: '基金', dataIndex: 'fund_name', width: 140, ellipsis: true,
+              render: (n: string, r: any) => <Link to={`/funds/${r.fund_code}`}>{n}</Link> },
+            { title: '收益率', dataIndex: 'pnl_percent', width: 90, sorter: (a: any, b: any) => a.pnl_percent - b.pnl_percent,
+              render: (v: number) => <Tag color={v >= 0 ? 'red' : 'green'}>{v >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{v.toFixed(2)}%</Tag> },
+            { title: '盈亏', dataIndex: 'pnl', width: 100, sorter: (a: any, b: any) => a.pnl - b.pnl,
+              render: (v: number) => <span style={{ color: v >= 0 ? (isDark ? '#ff4d4f' : '#cf1322') : (isDark ? '#52c41a' : '#3f8600'), fontWeight: 600 }}>{v >= 0 ? '+' : ''}¥{Number(v).toFixed(0)}</span> },
+            { title: '持仓占比', key: 'weight', width: 100,
+              render: (_: any, r: any) => {
+                const w = totalMV > 0 ? (r.market_value / totalMV * 100) : 0;
+                return <Progress percent={w} size="small" strokeColor={w > 30 ? '#ff4d4f' : '#1677ff'} format={() => `${w.toFixed(1)}%`} />;
+              } },
+            { title: '持有天数', key: 'days', width: 90, sorter: (a: any, b: any) => getHoldingDays(a) - getHoldingDays(b),
+              render: (_: any, r: any) => {
+                const d = getHoldingDays(r);
+                const tier = getFeeTier(d);
+                return <Tooltip title={tier.label}><span style={{ color: tier.color }}>{d}天</span></Tooltip>;
+              } },
+            { title: '诊断', key: 'diagnosis', width: 160,
+              render: (_: any, r: any) => {
+                const tags = [];
+                const w = totalMV > 0 ? (r.market_value / totalMV * 100) : 0;
+                if (w > 30) tags.push(<Tag key="con" color="warning">占比过高</Tag>);
+                if (r.pnl_percent < -15) tags.push(<Tag key="loss" color="error">深度亏损</Tag>);
+                else if (r.pnl_percent < -5) tags.push(<Tag key="loss" color="orange">小幅亏损</Tag>);
+                if (r.pnl_percent > 20) tags.push(<Tag key="win" color="success">盈利丰厚</Tag>);
+                const d = getHoldingDays(r);
+                if (d >= 730) tags.push(<Tag key="fee" color="green">免赎回费</Tag>);
+                else if (d >= 365) tags.push(<Tag key="fee" color="blue">费率降档中</Tag>);
+                if (tags.length === 0) tags.push(<Tag key="ok" color="default">正常</Tag>);
+                return <Space size={2} wrap>{tags}</Space>;
+              } },
+          ]} />
+      </Card>
+
+      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
+        {top1Weight > 40 && (
+          <Alert type="warning" showIcon message="单只基金占比过高"
+            description={`最大持仓 "${sortedByMV[0]?.fund_name?.slice(0, 8)}" 占比 ${top1Weight.toFixed(1)}%，建议降至30%以下以分散风险。`} />
+        )}
+        {top3Weight > 70 && (
+          <Alert type="warning" showIcon message="持仓集中度过高"
+            description={`前3大持仓占比 ${top3Weight.toFixed(1)}%，建议增加不同行业/类型的基金，降低单一行业系统性风险。`} />
+        )}
+        {losers.length > 0 && topLoser && (
+          <Alert type={Math.abs(topLoser.pnl_percent) > 20 ? 'error' : 'warning'} showIcon
+            message={`${losers.length} 只基金处于亏损状态`}
+            description={
+              <span>
+                亏损最大：<strong>{topLoser.fund_name?.slice(0, 8)}</strong>（{topLoser.pnl_percent?.toFixed(2)}%，亏损¥{Math.abs(topLoser.pnl).toFixed(0)}）。
+                {Math.abs(topLoser.pnl_percent) > 20 && ' 深度亏损建议评估基本面是否变化，若行业逻辑未变可考虑补仓摊低成本，否则及时止损。'}
+                {Math.abs(topLoser.pnl_percent) > 10 && Math.abs(topLoser.pnl_percent) <= 20 && ' 中度亏损建议观望，避免恐慌性卖出。'}
+                {Math.abs(topLoser.pnl_percent) <= 10 && ' 小幅亏损属正常波动，可继续持有观察。'}
+              </span>
+            } />
+        )}
+        {nearFreeFee.length > 0 && (
+          <Alert type="info" showIcon message="赎回费即将降档"
+            description={
+              <span>
+                {nearFreeFee.map(h => h.fund_name?.slice(0, 6)).join('、')}
+                等 {nearFreeFee.length} 只基金持有已超1年，再持有一段时间可享受更低赎回费率。
+              </span>
+            } />
+        )}
+        {winners.length > 0 && topWinner && topWinner.pnl_percent > 30 && (
+          <Alert type="success" showIcon message="止盈提醒"
+            description={`"${topWinner.fund_name?.slice(0, 6)}" 已盈利 ${topWinner.pnl_percent.toFixed(2)}%，可考虑分批止盈锁定收益，避免回吐利润。`} />
+        )}
+        {losers.length === 0 && winners.length > 0 && (
+          <Alert type="success" showIcon message="持仓全部盈利" description="当前所有持仓均处于盈利状态，可考虑分批止盈锁定收益。" />
+        )}
+        {holdings.length < 3 && (
+          <Alert type="info" showIcon message="持仓过于集中"
+            description={`当前仅持有 ${holdings.length} 只基金，建议增加到 3-5 只不同行业/类型的基金以分散风险。`} />
+        )}
+        {holdings.length === 0 && (

+import { useRef } from 'react';
+import { Card, Table, Button, Space, Tag, Tooltip, Empty, Popconfirm, message } from 'antd';
+import {
+  PlusOutlined, EditOutlined, DeleteOutlined, UploadOutlined,
+  DownloadOutlined, SyncOutlined, LinkOutlined, SwapOutlined, WarningOutlined, CheckCircleOutlined,
+} from '@ant-design/icons';
+import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
+import type { PortfolioHolding } from '../../types';
+import { portfolioApi } from '../../services/api';
+
+interface Props {
+  holdings: PortfolioHolding[];
+  loading: boolean;
+  isDark: boolean;
+  refreshing: boolean;
+  lastRefreshTime: string | null;
+  onRefreshNav: () => void;
+  onAdd: () => void;
+  onEdit: (record: any) => void;
+  onImport: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
+  onAlipayImport: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
+  onDownloadTemplate: () => void;
+  onExportHoldings: () => void;
+  onSell: (holding: PortfolioHolding) => void;
+  onReload: () => void;
+  getHoldingDays: (h: PortfolioHolding) => number;
+  getFeeTier: (days: number) => { label: string; color: string; icon?: React.ReactNode };
+}
+
+export function HoldingsTable({
+  holdings, loading, isDark, refreshing, lastRefreshTime,
+  onRefreshNav, onAdd, onEdit, onImport, onAlipayImport,
+  onDownloadTemplate, onExportHoldings, onSell, onReload,
+  getHoldingDays, getFeeTier,
+}: Props) {
+  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
+  const alipayFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
+
+  const pnlColor = (v: number) => v >= 0 ? (isDark ? '#ff4d4f' : '#cf1322') : (isDark ? '#52c41a' : '#3f8600');
+  const pnlSign = (v: number) => v >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
+
+  const columns = [
+    {
+      title: '基金名称', dataIndex: 'fund_name', key: 'fund_name', width: 180,
+      sorter: (a: PortfolioHolding, b: PortfolioHolding) => a.fund_name.localeCompare(b.fund_name, 'zh-CN'),
+      render: (name: string, record: PortfolioHolding) => (
+        <Link to={`/funds/${record.fund_code}`} style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: '#1677ff' }}>
+          {name} <LinkOutlined style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#1677ff' }} />
+        </Link>
+      ),
+    },
+    {
+      title: '基金代码', dataIndex: 'fund_code', key: 'fund_code', width: 100,
+      sorter: (a: PortfolioHolding, b: PortfolioHolding) => a.fund_code.localeCompare(b.fund_code),
+      render: (code: string) => (
+        <Link to={`/funds/${code}`} style={{ color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#8c8c8c', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>{code}</Link>
+      ),
+    },
+    {
+      title: '持有份额', dataIndex: 'total_shares', key: 'total_shares', width: 100,
+      sorter: (a: PortfolioHolding, b: PortfolioHolding) => a.total_shares - b.total_shares,
+      render: (v: number) => v.toLocaleString(),
+    },
+    {
+      title: '成本价', dataIndex: 'avg_cost_price', key: 'avg_cost_price', width: 90,
+      sorter: (a: PortfolioHolding, b: PortfolioHolding) => a.avg_cost_price - b.avg_cost_price,
+      render: (v: any) => v != null ? Number(v).toFixed(4) : '-',
+    },
+    {
+      title: '当前净值', dataIndex: 'current_nav', key: 'current_nav', width: 90,
+      sorter: (a: PortfolioHolding, b: PortfolioHolding) => a.current_nav - b.current_nav,
+      render: (v: any, record: PortfolioHolding) => (
+        <Tooltip title={record.nav_updated_at ? `更新: ${new Date(record.nav_updated_at).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}` : '未更新'}>
+          <span>{v != null ? Number(v).toFixed(4) : '-'}</span>
+        </Tooltip>
+      ),
+    },
+    {
+      title: '市值', dataIndex: 'market_value', key: 'market_value', width: 110,
+      sorter: (a: PortfolioHolding, b: PortfolioHolding) => a.market_value - b.market_value,
+      render: (v: number) => `¥${v.toLocaleString()}`,
+    },
+    {
+      title: '盈亏', dataIndex: 'pnl', key: 'pnl', width: 110,
+      sorter: (a: PortfolioHolding, b: PortfolioHolding) => a.pnl - b.pnl,
+      render: (v: number) => (
+        <span style={{ color: pnlColor(v), fontWeight: 600 }}>
+          {pnlSign(v)}¥{Math.abs(v).toLocaleString()}
+        </span>
+      ),
+    },
+    {
+      title: '收益率', dataIndex: 'pnl_percent', key: 'pnl_percent', width: 90,
+      sorter: (a: PortfolioHolding, b: PortfolioHolding) => a.pnl_percent - b.pnl_percent,
+      defaultSortOrder: 'ascend' as const,
+      render: (v: number) => (
+        <Tag color={v >= 0 ? 'red' : 'green'}>{pnlSign(v)}{Math.abs(v).toFixed(2)}%</Tag>
+      ),
+    },
+    {
+      title: '持有天数', key: 'holding_days', width: 100,
+      sorter: (a: PortfolioHolding, b: PortfolioHolding) => getHoldingDays(a) - getHoldingDays(b),
+      render: (_: any, record: PortfolioHolding) => {
+        const days = getHoldingDays(record);
+        const tier = getFeeTier(days);
+        return (
+          <Tooltip title={tier.label}>
+            <span style={{ color: tier.color, fontWeight: 500 }}>
+              {days}天 {tier.icon}
+            </span>
+          </Tooltip>
+        );
+      },
+    },
+    {
+      title: '操作', key: 'action', width: 180, fixed: 'right' as const,
+      render: (_: any, holding: PortfolioHolding) => (
+        <Space>
+          <Button type="link" size="small" icon={<SwapOutlined />} style={{ color: '#faad14' }}
+            onClick={() => onSell(holding)}>
+            赎回
+          </Button>
+          <Button type="link" size="small" icon={<EditOutlined />}
+            onClick={() => onEdit(holding.records[0])}>
+            编辑
+          </Button>
+          <Popconfirm title="确认删除此基金的所有持仓记录？" onConfirm={async () => {
+            try {
+              await Promise.all(holding.records.map(r => portfolioApi.deleteRecord(r.id)));
+              message.success('删除成功');
+              onReload();
+            } catch {
+              message.error('删除失败');
+            }
+          }}>
+            <Button type="link" size="small" danger icon={<DeleteOutlined />}>删除</Button>
+          </Popconfirm>
+        </Space>
+      ),
+    },
+  ];
+
+  const tableData = holdings.map((h, i) => ({ ...h, key: h.fund_code || i }));
+
+  return (
+    <Card
+      title={
+        <span>
+          持仓明细
+          {lastRefreshTime && (
+            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#8c8c8c', fontWeight: 'normal', marginLeft: 12 }}>
+              净值更新于 {lastRefreshTime}
+            </span>
+          )}
+        </span>
+      }
+      extra={
+        <Space>
+          <Button
+            icon={<SyncOutlined spin={refreshing} />}
+            onClick={onRefreshNav}
+            loading={refreshing}
+          >
+            刷新净值
+          </Button>
+          <Button icon={<DownloadOutlined />} onClick={onDownloadTemplate}>下载模板</Button>
+          <Button icon={<UploadOutlined />} onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}>导入CSV</Button>
+          <Button icon={<DownloadOutlined />} onClick={onExportHoldings}>导出持仓</Button>
+          <Button icon={<UploadOutlined />} onClick={() => alipayFileInputRef.current?.click()}>支付宝导入</Button>
+          <Button type="primary" icon={<PlusOutlined />} onClick={onAdd}>添加持仓</Button>
+          <input
+            ref={fileInputRef}
+            type="file"
+            accept=".csv"
+            style={{ display: 'none' }}
+            onChange={onImport}
+          />
+          <input
+            ref={alipayFileInputRef}
+            type="file"
+            accept=".csv"
+            style={{ display: 'none' }}
+            onChange={onAlipayImport}
+          />
+        </Space>
+      }
+      style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}
+    >
+      {holdings.length === 0 && !loading ? (
+        <Empty description="暂无持仓记录，点击上方按钮添加" />
+      ) : (
+        <Table
+          columns={columns}
+          dataSource={tableData}
+          loading={loading}
+          scroll={{ x: 1000 }}
+          pagination={false}
+          size="middle"
+        />
+      )}
+    </Card>
+  );
+}

+import { useState } from 'react';
+import { Card, Steps, Radio, Space, Row, Col, Button, Alert, Statistic, Progress } from 'antd';
+import { fundApi, portfolioApi } from '../../services/api';
+
+interface Props {
+  isDark: boolean;
+}
+
+export function RiskAssessmentTab({ isDark }: Props) {
+  const [riskStep, setRiskStep] = useState(0);
+  const [riskProfile, setRiskProfile] = useState({
+    age: '', investmentAmount: '', investmentPeriod: '', riskTolerance: 'balanced' as 'conservative' | 'balanced' | 'aggressive', lossTolerance: '',
+  });
+  const [riskRecommendation, setRiskRecommendation] = useState<any>(null);
+  const [riskLoading, setRiskLoading] = useState(false);
+
+  const canNextRisk = () => {
+    if (riskStep === 0) return !!riskProfile.age;
+    if (riskStep === 1) return !!riskProfile.investmentAmount;
+    if (riskStep === 2) return !!riskProfile.investmentPeriod;
+    if (riskStep === 3) return !!riskProfile.riskTolerance && !!riskProfile.lossTolerance;
+    return false;
+  };
+
+  const handleRiskSubmit = async () => {
+    setRiskLoading(true);
+    try {
+      const data = await fundApi.getRiskProfile(riskProfile);
+      setRiskRecommendation(data);
+      setRiskStep(4);
+      const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
+      if (token) {
+        try {
+          await portfolioApi.saveRiskProfile({
+            ...riskProfile,
+            score: data.score || 0,
+            riskType: data.type,
+            riskLevel: data.riskLevel,
+            expectedReturn: data.expectedReturn,
+            allocation: data.allocation,
+          });
+        } catch { /* 非登录用户忽略 */ }
+      }
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('风险评估失败:', error);
+    } finally {
+      setRiskLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <>
+      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+        <Steps current={riskStep} items={[
+          { title: '年龄' }, { title: '投资金额' }, { title: '投资期限' }, { title: '风险偏好' }, { title: '评估结果' },
+        ]} size="small" />
+      </Card>
+
+      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16, minHeight: 300 }}>
+        {riskStep === 0 && (
+          <div>
+            <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>1. 您的年龄段</h3>
+            <Radio.Group value={riskProfile.age} onChange={(e) => setRiskProfile({ ...riskProfile, age: e.target.value })}>
+              <Space direction="vertical" size={12}>
+                {['18-25岁', '26-35岁', '36-45岁', '46-55岁', '55岁以上'].map((age) => (
+                  <Radio.Button key={age} value={age} style={{ width: 200, textAlign: 'center' }}>{age}</Radio.Button>
+                ))}
+              </Space>
+            </Radio.Group>
+          </div>
+        )}
+
+        {riskStep === 1 && (
+          <div>
+            <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>2. 计划投资金额</h3>
+            <Radio.Group value={riskProfile.investmentAmount} onChange={(e) => setRiskProfile({ ...riskProfile, investmentAmount: e.target.value })}>
+              <Space direction="vertical" size={12}>
+                {['1万以下', '1-5万', '5-20万', '20-50万', '50万以上'].map((amount) => (
+                  <Radio.Button key={amount} value={amount} style={{ width: 200, textAlign: 'center' }}>{amount}</Radio.Button>
+                ))}
+              </Space>
+            </Radio.Group>
+          </div>
+        )}
+
+        {riskStep === 2 && (
+          <div>
+            <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>3. 计划投资期限</h3>
+            <Radio.Group value={riskProfile.investmentPeriod} onChange={(e) => setRiskProfile({ ...riskProfile, investmentPeriod: e.target.value })}>
+              <Space direction="vertical" size={12}>
+                {['3个月以内', '3-6个月', '6-12个月', '1-3年', '3年以上'].map((period) => (
+                  <Radio.Button key={period} value={period} style={{ width: 200, textAlign: 'center' }}>{period}</Radio.Button>
+                ))}
+              </Space>
+            </Radio.Group>
+          </div>
+        )}
+
+        {riskStep === 3 && (
+          <div>
+            <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>4. 风险承受能力</h3>
+            <Radio.Group value={riskProfile.riskTolerance} onChange={(e) => setRiskProfile({ ...riskProfile, riskTolerance: e.target.value })}>
+              <Row gutter={[16, 16]}>
+                {[
+                  { value: 'conservative', label: '保守型', desc: '无法接受本金损失，追求稳定收益' },
+                  { value: 'balanced', label: '稳健型', desc: '能接受小幅波动，追求长期增值' },
+                  { value: 'aggressive', label: '激进型', desc: '能承受较大波动，追求高收益' },
+                ].map((option) => (
+                  <Col xs={24} sm={8} key={option.value}>
+                    <Card
+                      hoverable
+                      style={{ border: riskProfile.riskTolerance === option.value ? '2px solid #1677ff' : `1px solid ${isDark ? '#333' : '#e8e8e8'}`, cursor: 'pointer' }}
+                      onClick={() => setRiskProfile({ ...riskProfile, riskTolerance: option.value as any })}
+                    >
+                      <strong>{option.label}</strong>
+                      <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666', margin: '8px 0 0' }}>{option.desc}</p>
+                    </Card>
+                  </Col>
+                ))}
+              </Row>
+            </Radio.Group>
+
+            <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16, marginTop: 24 }}>5. 能承受的最大亏损</h3>
+            <Radio.Group value={riskProfile.lossTolerance} onChange={(e) => setRiskProfile({ ...riskProfile, lossTolerance: e.target.value })}>
+              <Space direction="vertical" size={12}>
+                {['5%以内', '5-10%', '10-20%', '20-30%', '30%以上'].map((loss) => (
+                  <Radio.Button key={loss} value={loss} style={{ width: 200, textAlign: 'center' }}>{loss}</Radio.Button>
+                ))}
+              </Space>
+            </Radio.Group>
+          </div>
+        )}
+
+        {riskStep === 4 && riskRecommendation && (
+          <div>
+            <Alert
+              type="success"
+              message={`您的风险类型：${riskRecommendation.type}`}
+              description={riskRecommendation.description}
+              showIcon
+              style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}
+            />
+
+            <Row gutter={16} style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
+              <Col xs={12} sm={6}>
+                <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+                  <Statistic title="预期年化收益" value={riskRecommendation.expectedReturn} valueStyle={{ color: '#1677ff' }} />
+                </Card>
+              </Col>
+              <Col xs={12} sm={6}>
+                <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+                  <Statistic title="风险等级" value={riskRecommendation.riskLevel} valueStyle={{ color: '#ff4d4f' }} />
+                </Card>
+              </Col>
+            </Row>
+
+            <Card title="推荐资产配置" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+              {riskRecommendation.allocation.map((item: any, index: number) => (
+                <div key={index} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 4 }}>
+                    <strong>{item.industry}</strong>
+                    <span style={{ color: '#1677ff', fontWeight: 600 }}>{item.percentage}%</span>
+                  </div>
+                  <Progress percent={item.percentage} showInfo={false} />
+                  <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666', marginTop: 4 }}>推荐基金：{item.funds.join('、')}</div>
+                </div>
+              ))}
+            </Card>
+
+            <Card title="操作建议">
+              <ul style={{ fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 2, margin: 0, paddingLeft: 20 }}>
+                {riskProfile.riskTolerance === 'conservative' && (
+                  <>
+                    <li>建议以债券基金和货币基金为主，占比80%</li>
+                    <li>可配置少量沪深300指数基金，占比20%</li>
+                    <li>适合长期持有，不建议频繁操作</li>
+                  </>
+                )}
+                {riskProfile.riskTolerance === 'balanced' && (
+                  <>
+                    <li>建议均衡配置，股票型基金和债券型基金各占50%</li>
+                    <li>股票型基金可选择沪深300、消费、医药等</li>
+                    <li>建议采用定投方式，分散买入成本</li>
+                  </>
+                )}
+                {riskProfile.riskTolerance === 'aggressive' && (
+                  <>
+                    <li>建议以股票型基金为主，占比80-90%</li>
+                    <li>可配置AI、半导体、纳斯达克等高弹性品种</li>
+                    <li>建议分批建仓，不要一次性投入</li>
+                  </>
+                )}
+              </ul>
+            </Card>
+
+            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 20 }}>
+              <Button type="primary" onClick={() => { setRiskStep(0); setRiskRecommendation(null); }}>重新评估</Button>
+            </div>
+          </div>
+        )}
+      </Card>
+
+      {riskStep < 4 && (
+        <Card>
+          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
+            <Button onClick={() => setRiskStep(Math.max(0, riskStep - 1))} disabled={riskStep === 0}>上一步</Button>
+            {riskStep < 3 ? (
+              <Button type="primary" onClick={() => setRiskStep(riskStep + 1)} disabled={!canNextRisk()}>下一步</Button>
+            ) : (
+              <Button type="primary" onClick={handleRiskSubmit} loading={riskLoading} disabled={!canNextRisk()}>获取推荐</Button>
+            )}
+          </div>
+        </Card>
+      )}
+    </>
+  );
+}
