+import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+import { Card, Select, InputNumber, Slider, Button, Row, Col, Statistic, Tag, Table, Spin } from 'antd';
+import { CalculatorOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
+import ReactECharts from 'echarts-for-react';
+import { fundApi } from '../../services/api';
+
+function getSmartMultiplier(pePercentile: number) {
+  if (pePercentile < 15) return { multiplier: 2.0, label: '极度低估-加倍', color: '#52c41a' };
+  if (pePercentile < 30) return { multiplier: 1.5, label: '低估-多投', color: '#73d13d' };
+  if (pePercentile < 45) return { multiplier: 1.2, label: '偏低-略多', color: '#95de64' };
+  if (pePercentile < 55) return { multiplier: 1.0, label: '适中-正常', color: '#1677ff' };
+  if (pePercentile < 70) return { multiplier: 0.8, label: '偏高-略少', color: '#ffc53d' };
+  if (pePercentile < 85) return { multiplier: 0.5, label: '高估-少投', color: '#ff7a45' };
+  return { multiplier: 0, label: '极高-暂停', color: '#ff4d4f' };
+}
+
+interface Props {
+  isDark: boolean;
+}
+
+export function SmartDCATab({ isDark }: Props) {

+  const [smartPeriod, setSmartPeriod] = useState(36);

+  const [smartComparing, setSmartComparing] = useState<any>(null);
+  const [smartCalculating, setSmartCalculating] = useState(false);
+  const [smartLoading, setSmartLoading] = useState(false);

+    if (smartIndices.length === 0 && !smartLoading) {
+      setSmartLoading(true);
+      fundApi.getValuationCenter().then(data => {
+        setSmartIndices(data);
+        if (data.length > 0 && !data.find((i: any) => i.code === '000300')) {
+          setSmartSelectedCode(data[0].code);
+        }
+      }).catch(() => {
+        // error handled silently
+      }).finally(() => setSmartLoading(false));
+    }
+  }, []);
+
+  const handleSmartDCACalculate = () => {
+    setSmartCalculating(true);
+    const idx = smartIndices.find((i: any) => i.code === smartSelectedCode);
+    if (!idx || !idx.pePercentile) {
+      setSmartCalculating(false);
+      return;
+    }
+    const simResults: any[] = [];
+    let cumulativeInvest = 0;
+    let cumulativeShares = 0;
+    const baseNav = idx.pe || 15;
+    let seed = smartSelectedCode.split('').reduce((s: number, c: string) => s * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0), smartBaseAmount) | 0;
+    const seededRandom = () => { seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) | 0; return (seed >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
+    for (let m = 0; m < smartPeriod; m++) {
+      const noise = Math.sin(m * 0.7 + idx.pePercentile * 0.1) * 20 + (seededRandom() - 0.5) * 10;
+      const simulatedPercentile = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, idx.pePercentile + noise));
+      const { multiplier } = getSmartMultiplier(simulatedPercentile);
+      const amount = Math.round(smartBaseAmount * multiplier);
+      const navFactor = 1 + (simulatedPercentile - 50) / 200 + (seededRandom() - 0.5) * 0.03;
+      const nav = baseNav * navFactor;
+      const shares = amount > 0 ? amount / nav : 0;
+      cumulativeInvest += amount;
+      cumulativeShares += shares;
+      const marketValue = cumulativeShares * nav;
+      const profit = marketValue - cumulativeInvest;
+      const returnRate = cumulativeInvest > 0 ? (profit / cumulativeInvest) * 100 : 0;
+      const date = new Date();
+      date.setMonth(date.getMonth() + m);
+      simResults.push({
+        month: m + 1,
+        date: `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
+        pePercentile: Math.round(simulatedPercentile),
+        multiplier, amount,
+        nav: parseFloat(nav.toFixed(4)),
+        shares: parseFloat(shares.toFixed(2)),
+        cumulativeInvest,
+        cumulativeShares: parseFloat(cumulativeShares.toFixed(2)),
+        marketValue: parseFloat(marketValue.toFixed(2)),
+        profit: parseFloat(profit.toFixed(2)),
+        returnRate: parseFloat(returnRate.toFixed(2)),
+      });
+    }
+    setSmartResults(simResults);
+    const normalInvest = smartBaseAmount * smartPeriod;
+    const normalShares = simResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (smartBaseAmount / r.nav), 0);
+    const lastNav = simResults[simResults.length - 1]?.nav || baseNav;
+    const normalMarketValue = normalShares * lastNav;
+    const normalReturn = ((normalMarketValue - normalInvest) / normalInvest) * 100;
+    const smartInvest = simResults[simResults.length - 1]?.cumulativeInvest || 0;
+    const smartMarketValue = simResults[simResults.length - 1]?.marketValue || 0;
+    const smartReturn = simResults[simResults.length - 1]?.returnRate || 0;
+    setSmartComparing({
+      normal: { invest: normalInvest, marketValue: normalMarketValue, returnRate: normalReturn },
+      smart: { invest: smartInvest, marketValue: smartMarketValue, returnRate: smartReturn },
+      advantage: smartReturn - normalReturn,

+    setSmartCalculating(false);
+  };
+
+  const smartSelected = smartIndices.find((i: any) => i.code === smartSelectedCode);
+
+  const smartChartOption = smartResults.length ? {
+    tooltip: {
+      trigger: 'axis',
+      formatter: (params: any) => {
+        const r = smartResults[params[0]?.dataIndex];
+        if (!r) return '';
+        return `<div style="font-weight:600">${r.date}</div><div>PE分位: ${r.pePercentile}% | 倍数: ${r.multiplier}x</div><div>定投金额: ${r.amount}元 | 累计投入: ${r.cumulativeInvest}元</div><div>市值: ${r.marketValue}元 | 收益率: ${r.returnRate}%</div>`;

+      { type: 'value', name: 'PE分位(%)', position: 'right', max: 100, axisLabel: { color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999' } },
+    ],
+    series: [
+      { name: '累计投入', type: 'line', data: smartResults.map(r => r.cumulativeInvest), yAxisIndex: 0, lineStyle: { color: '#1677ff', width: 2 }, itemStyle: { color: '#1677ff' }, showSymbol: false, areaStyle: { color: 'rgba(22,119,255,0.1)' } },
+      { name: '市值', type: 'line', data: smartResults.map(r => r.marketValue), yAxisIndex: 0, lineStyle: { color: '#52c41a', width: 2 }, itemStyle: { color: '#52c41a' }, showSymbol: false },

+import { Card, Row, Col, Alert } from 'antd';
+import { BarChartOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
+import type { PortfolioHolding } from '../../types';
+
+interface Props {
+  holdings: PortfolioHolding[];
+  txStats: any;
+  isDark: boolean;
+  getHoldingDays: (h: PortfolioHolding) => number;
+}
+
+export function TransactionBehaviorAnalysis({ holdings, txStats, isDark, getHoldingDays }: Props) {
+  if (holdings.length === 0) return null;
+
+  const totalMV = holdings.reduce((s, h) => s + h.market_value, 0);
+  const totalUnrealizedPnl = holdings.reduce((s, h) => s + h.pnl, 0);
+  const realizedPnl = txStats?.total_realized_pnl || 0;
+  const totalFees = txStats?.total_buy_fees || 0;
+  const buyCount = txStats?.buy_count || 0;
+  const sellCount = txStats?.sell_count || 0;
+  const avgHoldDays = holdings.length > 0
+    ? Math.round(holdings.map(h => getHoldingDays(h)).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / holdings.length)
+    : 0;
+  const feeImpact = totalMV > 0 ? (totalFees / totalMV * 100) : 0;
+
+  return (
+    <Card title={<span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}><BarChartOutlined style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />交易行为分析</span>} style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
+      <Row gutter={[16, 16]} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+        <Col xs={12} sm={8}>
+          <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: '#1677ff' }}>{buyCount + sellCount}</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666' }}>总交易笔数</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999' }}>买{buyCount} / 卖{sellCount}</div>
+          </Card>
+        </Col>
+        <Col xs={12} sm={8}>

+          { title: '价格', dataIndex: 'cost_price', width: 90, render: (v: number, r: any) => r.record_type === 'sell' ? (r.sell_price || v) : v },

+import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode } from 'react';
+
+interface ThemeContextType {
+  isDark: boolean;
+  toggleTheme: () => void;
+}
+
+const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextType>({
+  isDark: false,
+  toggleTheme: () => {},
+});
+
+export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
+  const [isDark, setIsDark] = useState(() => {
+    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
+    if (saved) return saved === 'dark';
+    return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
+  });
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
+    localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
+  }, [isDark]);
+
+  const toggleTheme = () => setIsDark(prev => !prev);
+
+  return (
+    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ isDark, toggleTheme }}>
+      {children}
+    </ThemeContext.Provider>
+  );
+}
+
+export function useTheme() {
+  return useContext(ThemeContext);
+}

+    color: '#52c41a',
+    gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #52c41a 0%, #389e0d 100%)',
+    questions: [
+      { icon: <SearchOutlined />, text: '搜索医药行业基金', desc: '按行业关键词搜索' },
+      { icon: <PercentageOutlined />, text: '费率最低的基金', desc: '综合费率<0.8%' },
+      { icon: <ExperimentOutlined />, text: '搜索半导体基金', desc: '科技赛道布局' },
+      { icon: <SafetyOutlined />, text: '搜索债券基金', desc: '稳健收益之选' },
+    ],
+  },
+];
+
+function safeParseTime(ts: string): string {
+  try {
+    const d = new Date(ts);
+    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
+    return d.toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
+  } catch (e) { console.error('解析时间戳失败:', e); return ''; }
+}
+
+export default function AIAssistant() {
+  const { isDark } = useTheme();
+  const { user } = useAuth();
+  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([]);
+  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
+  const [sessionId, setSessionId] = useState<string>('');
+  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(false);
+  const [loadingHistory, setLoadingHistory] = useState(false);
+  const chatContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+  const chatEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+  const inputRef = useRef<any>(null);
+  const isLoadingMore = useRef(false);
+  const messagesRef = useRef<Message[]>([]);
+  const prevScrollHeightRef = useRef<number>(0);
+
+  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<Session[]>([]);
+  const [sessionsDrawerOpen, setSessionsDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
+  const [loadingSessions, setLoadingSessions] = useState(false);
+
+  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState('portfolio');
+  const [showScrollBtn, setShowScrollBtn] = useState(false);
+  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | number | null>(null);
+  const [copiedCode, setCopiedCode] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [welcomeText, setWelcomeText] = useState('');
+
+  // 欢迎页打字动画
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (messages.length > 0) return;
+    const text = '基于 Claude AI 驱动，实时数据分析，智能基金问答';
+    let i = 0;
+    const timer = setInterval(() => {
+      if (i <= text.length) {
+        setWelcomeText(text.slice(0, i));
+        i++;
+      } else {
+        clearInterval(timer);
+      }
+    }, 50);
+    return () => clearInterval(timer);
+  }, [messages.length]);
+
+  // 追问建议（根据最后一条 AI 回复动态生成）
+  const getFollowUpSuggestions = (): string[] => {
+    if (messages.length < 2) return [];
+    const lastAiMsg = [...messages].reverse().find(m => m.role === 'assistant');
+    if (!lastAiMsg) return [];
+    const content = lastAiMsg.content;
+    if (content.includes('收益') || content.includes('持仓')) return ['哪些基金表现最好？', '帮我分析持仓风险', '推荐类似的基金'];
+    if (content.includes('推荐') || content.includes('基金')) return ['这些基金费率怎么样？', '对比一下这几只基金', '适合定投吗？'];
+    if (content.includes('估值') || content.includes('指数')) return ['现在适合买入吗？', '历史估值趋势', '相关行业基金推荐'];
+    if (content.includes('行业') || content.includes('板块')) return ['这个行业有哪些基金？', '行业估值怎么样？', '推荐行业配置方案'];
+    return ['继续分析', '换个话题聊聊', '帮我推荐基金'];
+  };
+
+  useEffect(() => { messagesRef.current = messages; }, [messages]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (prevScrollHeightRef.current > 0 && chatContainerRef.current) {
+      const container = chatContainerRef.current;
+      const diff = container.scrollHeight - prevScrollHeightRef.current;
+      if (diff > 0) container.scrollTop += diff;
+      prevScrollHeightRef.current = 0;
+    }
+  }, [messages]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const savedSessionId = localStorage.getItem('ai_chat_session_id');
+    if (savedSessionId) {
+      setSessionId(savedSessionId);
+      loadHistory(savedSessionId);
+    } else {
+      const newSid = 'chat_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9);
+      setSessionId(newSid);
+      localStorage.setItem('ai_chat_session_id', newSid);
+    }
+    setTimeout(() => scrollToBottom(), 350);
+  }, []);
+
+  const scrollToBottom = useCallback(() => {
+    setTimeout(() => { chatEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); }, 100);
+  }, []);
+
+  const loadHistory = useCallback(async (sid: string, before?: number) => {
+    setLoadingHistory(true);
+    if (before && chatContainerRef.current) {
+      prevScrollHeightRef.current = chatContainerRef.current.scrollHeight;
+    }
+    try {
+      const result = await fundApi.getAIHistory({ sessionId: sid, limit: PAGE_SIZE, before });
+      const historyMessages = result.messages || [];
+      setHasMore(result.hasMore || false);
+      if (before) {
+        setMessages(prev => [...historyMessages, ...prev]);
+      } else {
+        setMessages(historyMessages);
+        if (historyMessages.length > 0) scrollToBottom();
+      }
+    } catch (e) { console.error('加载历史记录失败:', e); }
+    finally { setLoadingHistory(false); }
+  }, [scrollToBottom]);
+
+  const loadSessions = useCallback(async () => {
+    setLoadingSessions(true);
+    try { const result = await fundApi.getAISessions(); setSessions(result.sessions || []); }
+    catch (e) { /* ignore */ console.error('加载AI会话列表失败:', e); }
+    setLoadingSessions(false);
+  }, []);
+
+  const switchSession = useCallback((sid: string) => {
+    if (sid === sessionId) return;
+    setSessionId(sid);
+    localStorage.setItem('ai_chat_session_id', sid);
+    setMessages([]);
+    loadHistory(sid);
+    setSessionsDrawerOpen(false);
+  }, [sessionId, loadHistory]);
+
+  const newSession = useCallback(() => {
+    const newSid = 'chat_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9);
+    setSessionId(newSid);
+    localStorage.setItem('ai_chat_session_id', newSid);
+    setMessages([]);
+    setSessionsDrawerOpen(false);
+    message.success('已创建新会话');
+  }, []);
+
+  const handleScroll = useCallback(() => {
+    const container = chatContainerRef.current;
+    if (!container) return;
+    const dist = container.scrollHeight - container.scrollTop - container.clientHeight;
+    setShowScrollBtn(dist > 200);
+    if (isLoadingMore.current || !hasMore || loadingHistory) return;
+    if (container.scrollTop < 50) {
+      isLoadingMore.current = true;
+      const msgs = messagesRef.current;
+      const oldestId = msgs.length > 0 ? (typeof msgs[0].id === 'number' ? msgs[0].id : undefined) : undefined;
+      loadHistory(sessionId, oldestId).finally(() => { isLoadingMore.current = false; });
+    }
+  }, [sessionId, hasMore, loadingHistory, loadHistory]);
+
+  // 发送消息（流式）
+  const sendMessage = async (text: string) => {
+    if (!text.trim() || loading) return;
+    const userMsg: Message = { id: Date.now(), role: 'user', content: text.trim(), timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
+    setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMsg]);
+    setInput('');
+    setLoading(true);
+    scrollToBottom();
+
+    const aiMsgId = Date.now() + 1;
+    let streamedContent = '';
+    try {
+      await fundApi.aiChatStream(text.trim(), sessionId,
+        (chunk) => {
+          streamedContent += chunk;
+          setMessages(prev => {
+            const exists = prev.some(m => m.id === aiMsgId);
+            if (exists) return prev.map(m => m.id === aiMsgId ? { ...m, content: streamedContent } : m);
+            return [...prev, { id: aiMsgId, role: 'assistant' as const, content: streamedContent, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }];
+          });
+          scrollToBottom();
+        },
+        (sid) => { if (sid && sid !== sessionId) { setSessionId(sid); localStorage.setItem('ai_chat_session_id', sid); } },
+        (errMsg) => { if (!streamedContent) setMessages(prev => [...prev, { id: aiMsgId, role: 'assistant' as const, content: errMsg || '网络错误，请稍后重试', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }]); },
+      );
+    } catch (e) {
+      console.error('发送AI消息失败:', e);
+      if (!streamedContent) setMessages(prev => [...prev, { id: aiMsgId, role: 'assistant' as const, content: '网络错误，请稍后重试', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }]);
+    } finally {
+      setLoading(false);
+      scrollToBottom();
+      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 200);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const clearHistory = async () => {
+    try {
+      await fundApi.clearAIHistory(sessionId);
+      setMessages([]);
+      const newSid = 'chat_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9);
+      setSessionId(newSid);
+      localStorage.setItem('ai_chat_session_id', newSid);
+      message.success('聊天记录已清空');
+    } catch (e) { console.error('清空聊天记录失败:', e); message.error('清空失败'); }
+  };
+
+  const copyToClipboard = (text: string, id: string | number) => {
+    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
+      setCopiedId(id);
+      setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2000);
+    });
+  };
+
+  // 渲染基金卡片
+  const renderFundList = (funds: any[]) => {
+    if (!funds?.length) return null;
+    return (
+      <div style={{ marginTop: 12, display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr))', gap: 8 }}>
+        {funds.slice(0, 6).map((f: any) => (
+          <Link key={f.code} to={`/funds/${f.code}`} style={{ textDecoration: 'none' }}>
+            <div style={{
+              padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: 10,
+              background: isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.04)',
+              border: `1px solid ${isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.12)'}`,
+              transition: 'all 0.2s', cursor: 'pointer',
+            }}>
+              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 4 }}>
+                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
+                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 13, color: isDark ? '#e8e8e8' : '#1f1f1f', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
+                    {f.name}
+                    {f.isGoldSelected && <Tag color="gold" style={{ marginLeft: 4, fontSize: 10, lineHeight: '16px' }}>金选</Tag>}
+                  </div>
+                  <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>{f.code}</div>
+                </div>
+                <div style={{ textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 15, color: (f.return1y || 0) >= 0 ? '#ff4d4f' : '#52c41a' }}>
+                  {(f.return1y || 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{f.return1y?.toFixed(2)}%
+                </div>
+              </div>
+              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#888' }}>
+                <span>费率 {f.totalFee?.toFixed(2)}%</span>
+                <span>规模 {f.scale?.toFixed(1)}亿</span>
+              </div>
+            </div>
+          </Link>
+        ))}
+      </div>
+    );
+  };
+
+  const renderIndices = (data: any) => {
+    if (!data?.indices) return null;
+    return (
+      <div style={{ marginTop: 12, display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 8 }}>
+        {data.indices.map((idx: any) => (
+          <div key={idx.code} style={{
+            padding: '10px 12px', borderRadius: 10,
+            background: isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.04)',
+            border: `1px solid ${isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.1)'}`,
+          }}>
+            <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 4 }}>{idx.name}</div>
+            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'baseline' }}>
+              <span style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700 }}>{idx.price?.toFixed(2)}</span>
+              <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: idx.changePercent >= 0 ? '#ff4d4f' : '#52c41a' }}>
+                {idx.changePercent >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{idx.changePercent?.toFixed(2)}%
+              </span>
+            </div>
+            {idx.pePercentile != null && (
+              <Tag color={idx.pePercentile < 30 ? 'green' : idx.pePercentile < 70 ? 'blue' : 'red'} style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 4 }}>
+                PE分位 {idx.pePercentile}%
+              </Tag>
+            )}
+          </div>
+        ))}
+      </div>
+    );
+  };
+
+  const renderIndustries = (data: any) => {
+    if (!data?.industries) return null;
+    return (
+      <div style={{ marginTop: 12, display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }}>
+        {data.industries.map((ind: string) => (
+          <Link key={ind} to={`/industry?name=${encodeURIComponent(ind)}`}>
+            <Tag color="blue" style={{ cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: 12, padding: '2px 12px' }}>{ind}</Tag>
+          </Link>
+        ))}
+      </div>
+    );
+  };
+
+  const renderStructuredData = (data: any) => {
+    if (!data) return null;
+    if (Array.isArray(data)) return renderFundList(data);
+    if (data.type === 'indices' || data.type === 'valuation') return renderIndices(data);
+    if (data.type === 'industries') return renderIndustries(data);
+    return null;
+  };
+
+  // 渲染消息
+  const renderMessage = (msg: Message) => {
+    const isUser = msg.role === 'user';
+    const time = safeParseTime(msg.timestamp);
+    return (
+      <div key={msg.id} style={{
+        display: 'flex', justifyContent: isUser ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start',
+        marginBottom: 16, animation: 'fadeInUp 0.3s ease-out',
+      }}>
+        {!isUser && (
+          <div style={{
+            width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 11,
+            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)',
+            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
+            marginRight: 10, flexShrink: 0,
+            boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(102,126,234,0.25)',
+          }}>
+            <RobotOutlined style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: 15 }} />
+          </div>
+        )}
+        <div style={{ maxWidth: '78%', minWidth: 60, position: 'relative' }}>
+          <div style={{
+            padding: '12px 16px',
+            borderRadius: isUser ? '16px 16px 4px 16px' : '16px 16px 16px 4px',
+            background: isUser
+              ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1677ff 0%, #0958d9 100%)'
+              : (isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' : '#f7f8fa'),
+            color: isUser ? '#fff' : (isDark ? '#e8e8e8' : '#1f1f1f'),
+            whiteSpace: isUser ? 'pre-wrap' : 'normal',
+            lineHeight: 1.7, fontSize: 14,
+            boxShadow: isUser ? '0 2px 12px rgba(22,119,255,0.18)' : (isDark ? 'none' : '0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)'),
+          }}>
+            {isUser ? msg.content : (
+              <div className="markdown-body" style={{ color: 'inherit', fontSize: 14 }}>
+                <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}>{msg.content}</ReactMarkdown>
+              </div>
+            )}
+            {renderStructuredData(msg.data)}
+          </div>
+          <div style={{
+            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
+            marginTop: 4, padding: '0 4px',
+            justifyContent: isUser ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start',
+          }}>
+            {time && <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#555' : '#bbb' }}>{time}</span>}
+            {!isUser && msg.content && (
+              <Tooltip title={copiedId === msg.id ? '已复制' : '复制'}>
+                <span
+                  onClick={() => copyToClipboard(msg.content, msg.id)}
+                  style={{ fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#555' : '#bbb', cursor: 'pointer', transition: 'color 0.2s' }}
+                  onMouseEnter={e => { e.currentTarget.style.color = '#1677ff'; }}
+                  onMouseLeave={e => { e.currentTarget.style.color = isDark ? '#555' : '#bbb'; }}
+                >
+                  {copiedId === msg.id ? <CheckOutlined /> : <CopyOutlined />}
+                </span>
+              </Tooltip>
+            )}
+          </div>
+        </div>
+        {isUser && (
+          <div style={{
+            width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 11,
+            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1677ff 0%, #0958d9 100%)',
+            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
+            marginLeft: 10, flexShrink: 0,
+            boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(22,119,255,0.25)',
+          }}>
+            <UserOutlined style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: 15 }} />
+          </div>
+        )}
+      </div>
+    );
+  };
+
+  const currentCategory = quickCategories.find(c => c.key === selectedCategory) || quickCategories[0];
+
+  // 快捷操作 chips
+  const quickChips = [
+    { text: '我的收益怎么样？', icon: <FundOutlined /> },
+    { text: '推荐几只优质基金', icon: <BulbOutlined /> },
+    { text: '当前指数估值', icon: <LineChartOutlined /> },
+    { text: '市场行情分析', icon: <BarChartOutlined /> },
+  ];
+
+  // 追问建议
+  const followUps = getFollowUpSuggestions();
+
+  // 会话侧边栏
+  const renderSessionsDrawer = () => (

+      title={<div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}><HistoryOutlined /><span>会话记录</span></div>}
+      placement="right" onClose={() => setSessionsDrawerOpen(false)} open={sessionsDrawerOpen} width={360}
+      extra={<Button type="primary" icon={<PlusOutlined />} size="small" onClick={newSession}>新会话</Button>}
+    >
+      {loadingSessions ? (
+        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 40 }}><Spin /></div>
+      ) : sessions.length === 0 ? (
+        <Empty description="暂无历史会话" />
+      ) : (
+        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
+          {sessions.map(s => (
+            <div key={s.sessionId} onClick={() => switchSession(s.sessionId)} style={{
+              padding: '12px 14px', borderRadius: 10, cursor: 'pointer',
+              background: s.sessionId === sessionId ? (isDark ? 'rgba(22,119,255,0.15)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.08)') : (isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' : '#fff'),
+              border: `1px solid ${s.sessionId === sessionId ? '#1677ff' : (isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' : '#f0f0f0')}`,
+              transition: 'all 0.2s',
+            }}>
+              <div style={{ fontWeight: 500, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 4, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
+                {s.firstMessage || '新会话'}
+              </div>
+              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 11, color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999' }}>
+                <span>{s.messageCount} 条消息</span>
+                <span>{new Date(s.lastMessageAt).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}</span>
+              </div>
+            </div>
+          ))}
+        </div>
+      )}
+    </Drawer>
+  );
+
+  return (
+    <div className="fade-in" style={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
+      <style>{`
+        @keyframes fadeInUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
+        @keyframes pulse-glow { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(102,126,234,0.2); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(102,126,234,0.4); } }
+        @keyframes typingDot { 0%, 60%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.8); } 30% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
+        @keyframes shimmer { 0% { background-position: -200% 0; } 100% { background-position: 200% 0; } }
+        .markdown-body { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; }
+        .markdown-body table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin: 10px 0; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
+        .markdown-body th, .markdown-body td { border: 1px solid ${isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' : '#e8e8e8'}; padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left; }
+        .markdown-body th { background: ${isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' : '#f0f5ff'}; font-weight: 600; color: ${isDark ? '#ccc' : '#333'}; }
+        .markdown-body tr:hover td { background: ${isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.02)'}; }
+        .markdown-body h2 { font-size: 16px; margin: 14px 0 8px; font-weight: 700; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid ${isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' : '#f0f0f0'}; }
+        .markdown-body h3 { font-size: 14px; margin: 10px 0 4px; font-weight: 600; }
+        .markdown-body ul, .markdown-body ol { padding-left: 20px; margin: 6px 0; }
+        .markdown-body li { margin: 3px 0; }
+        .markdown-body blockquote { border-left: 3px solid #1677ff; padding: 8px 12px; margin: 10px 0; background: ${isDark ? 'rgba(22,119,255,0.06)' : 'rgba(22,119,255,0.03)'}; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; }
+        .markdown-body code { background: ${isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.04)'}; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Monaco', 'Consolas', monospace; }
+        .markdown-body pre { background: ${isDark ? 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)' : '#f6f8fa'}; padding: 14px; border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; margin: 10px 0; position: relative; border: 1px solid ${isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' : '#e8e8e8'}; }
+        .markdown-body pre code { background: none; padding: 0; font-size: 13px; }

+import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
+import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
+import { Card, Breadcrumb, Tag, Spin, Typography, Row, Col, Statistic, Space, Button } from 'antd';
+import { BankOutlined, ArrowUpOutlined, ArrowDownOutlined, ReloadOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
+import ReactECharts from 'echarts-for-react';
+import { fundApi } from '../services/api';
+import { useTheme } from '../contexts/ThemeContext';
+import { getEchartsTheme } from '../utils/echarts-theme';
+
+const { Title, Text } = Typography;
+
+interface NavItem {
+  unit_nav: number;
+  cumulative_nav: number | null;
+  nav_date: string;
+  cumulative_return: number;
+}
+
+interface ProductData {
+  product_code: string;
+  product_name: string;
+  risk_level: string;
+  product_status: string;
+  nav_history: NavItem[];
+}
+
+const riskColor: Record<string, string> = {
+  'R1': 'green', 'R2': 'blue', 'R3': 'orange', 'R4': 'red', 'R5': 'magenta',
+  '稳健型': 'blue', '平衡型': 'orange', '进取型': 'red', '保守型': 'green',
+};
+
+const statusColor: Record<string, string> = {
+  '存续': 'green', '正常': 'green', '封闭期': 'orange', '开放期': 'blue',
+  '已到期': 'red', '募集中': 'cyan',
+};
+
+export default function CMBProductDetail() {
+  const { code } = useParams<{ code: string }>();
+  const { isDark } = useTheme();
+  const [data, setData] = useState<ProductData | null>(null);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
+
+  const fetchData = async () => {
+    if (!code) return;
+    try {
+      setLoading(true);
+      setError(null);
+      const result = await fundApi.getCmbProductNavHistory(code);
+      setData(result);
+    } catch (err: any) {
+      setError(err.message || '获取数据失败');
+    } finally {
+      setLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  useEffect(() => { fetchData(); }, [code]);
+
+  // 统计数据
+  const stats = useMemo(() => {
+    if (!data || data.nav_history.length === 0) return null;
+    const history = data.nav_history;
+    const latest = history[history.length - 1];
+    const first = history[0];
+    const latestNav = latest.unit_nav;
+    const latestReturn = latest.cumulative_return;
+    const latestDate = latest.nav_date;
+    const startDate = first.nav_date;
+    const maxNav = Math.max(...history.map(h => h.unit_nav));
+    const minNav = Math.min(...history.map(h => h.unit_nav));
+    return { latestNav, latestReturn, latestDate, startDate, maxNav, minNav };
+  }, [data]);
+
+  // 图表配置
+  const chartOption = useMemo(() => {
+    if (!data || data.nav_history.length === 0) return null;
+    const history = data.nav_history;
+    const dates = history.map(h => h.nav_date);
+    const returns = history.map(h => h.cumulative_return);
+    const navs = history.map(h => h.unit_nav);
+
+    const positiveColor = '#f5222d';
+    const negativeColor = '#52c41a';
+
+    return {
+      tooltip: {
+        trigger: 'axis',
+        formatter: (params: any) => {
+          const p = params[0];
+          const idx = p.dataIndex;
+          const date = dates[idx];
+          const ret = returns[idx];
+          const nav = navs[idx];
+          const retColor = ret >= 0 ? positiveColor : negativeColor;
+          const sign = ret >= 0 ? '+' : '';
+          return `<div style="font-size:13px">
+            <div style="margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600">${date}</div>
+            <div>单位净值: <b>${nav.toFixed(4)}</b></div>
+            <div>累计收益率: <span style="color:${retColor};font-weight:600">${sign}${ret.toFixed(2)}%</span></div>
+          </div>`;
+        },
+        axisPointer: { type: 'cross', crossStyle: { color: '#999' } },
+      },
+      grid: { left: 60, right: 30, top: 30, bottom: 60 },
+      xAxis: {
+        type: 'category',
+        data: dates,
+        axisLabel: {
+          rotate: 0,
+          formatter: (val: string) => {
+            const d = new Date(val);
+            return `${d.getMonth() + 1}/${d.getDate()}`;
+          },
+        },
+        axisTick: { alignWithLabel: true },
+      },
+      yAxis: {
+        type: 'value',
+        name: '累计收益率(%)',
+        nameTextStyle: { fontSize: 12 },
+        axisLabel: {
+          formatter: '{value}%',
+        },
+        splitLine: { lineStyle: { type: 'dashed' } },
+      },
+      series: [
+        {
+          name: '累计收益率',
+          type: 'line',
+          data: returns,
+          smooth: true,
+          symbol: 'none',
+          lineStyle: { width: 2 },
+          areaStyle: {
+            color: {
+              type: 'linear',
+              x: 0, y: 0, x2: 0, y2: 1,
+              colorStops: [
+                { offset: 0, color: 'rgba(24, 144, 255, 0.3)' },
+                { offset: 1, color: 'rgba(24, 144, 255, 0.02)' },
+              ],
+            },
+          },
+          itemStyle: { color: '#1890ff' },
+          markLine: {
+            silent: true,
+            symbol: 'none',
+            lineStyle: { color: '#999', type: 'dashed' },
+            data: [{ yAxis: 0 }],
+          },
+        },
+      ],
+      dataZoom: [
+        { type: 'inside', start: 0, end: 100 },
+        {
+          type: 'slider',
+          start: 0,
+          end: 100,
+          height: 20,
+          bottom: 10,
+          borderColor: '#ccc',
+          fillerColor: 'rgba(24, 144, 255, 0.15)',
+        },
+      ],
+    };
+  }, [data]);
+
+  if (loading) {
+    return (
+      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 80 }}>
+        <Spin size="large" tip="加载中..." />
+      </div>
+    );
+  }
+
+  if (error || !data) {
+    return (
+      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 80 }}>
+        <Title level={4} type="danger">{error || '产品不存在'}</Title>
+        <Link to="/cmb-products">
+          <Button type="primary" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>返回产品列表</Button>
+        </Link>
+      </div>
+    );
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <div>
+      {/* 面包屑 */}
+      <Breadcrumb
+        items={[
+          { title: <Link to="/"><BankOutlined /> 首页</Link> },
+          { title: <Link to="/cmb-products">招行持仓理财</Link> },
+          { title: data.product_code },
+        ]}
+        style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
+      />
+
+      {/* 产品信息头部 */}
+      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
+          <div>
+            <Space align="center" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
+              <Title level={4} style={{ margin: 0 }}>{data.product_name}</Title>
+            </Space>
+            <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
+              <Space>
+                <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 600 }}>
+                  {data.product_code}
+                </Text>
+                <Tag color={riskColor[data.risk_level] || 'default'}>{data.risk_level}</Tag>
+                <Tag color={statusColor[data.product_status] || 'default'}>{data.product_status}</Tag>
+              </Space>
+            </div>
+          </div>
+          <Button icon={<ReloadOutlined />} onClick={fetchData}>刷新</Button>
+        </div>
+      </Card>
+
+      {/* 统计卡片 */}
+      {stats && (
+        <Row gutter={16} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+          <Col xs={12} sm={6}>
+            <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+              <Statistic
+                title="最新净值"
+                value={stats.latestNav}
+                precision={4}
+                valueStyle={{ color: '#1890ff', fontWeight: 700 }}
+              />
+              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{stats.latestDate}</Text>
+            </Card>
+          </Col>
+          <Col xs={12} sm={6}>
+            <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+              <Statistic
+                title="累计收益率"
+                value={stats.latestReturn}
+                precision={2}
+                suffix="%"
+                prefix={stats.latestReturn >= 0 ? <ArrowUpOutlined /> : <ArrowDownOutlined />}
+                valueStyle={{ color: stats.latestReturn >= 0 ? '#f5222d' : '#52c41a', fontWeight: 700 }}
+              />
+            </Card>
+          </Col>
+          <Col xs={12} sm={6}>
+            <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+              <Statistic
+                title="最高净值"
+                value={stats.maxNav}
+                precision={4}
+                valueStyle={{ color: '#f5222d' }}
+              />
+            </Card>
+          </Col>
+          <Col xs={12} sm={6}>
+            <Card size="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>

+export default function CMBProducts() {

+  const [personalLoading, setPersonalLoading] = useState(true);
+  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false);
+
+  // 加载个人产品
+  const fetchPersonalData = async () => {
+    try {
+      setPersonalLoading(true);
+      const result = await fundApi.getCMBProducts();
+      setPersonalData(result);
+    } catch (err: any) {
+      message.error(err.message || '获取数据失败');
+    } finally {
+      setPersonalLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const handleUpdate = async () => {
+    try {
+      setUpdating(true);
+      await fundApi.triggerCMBUpdate();
+      message.success('数据更新已启动，请稍后刷新查看');
+    } catch (err: any) {
+      message.error(err.message || '触发更新失败');
+    } finally {
+      setUpdating(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  useEffect(() => { fetchPersonalData(); }, []);
+
+  // 个人产品统计
+  const personalStats = useMemo(() => {
+    const calc = (key: keyof CMBProduct) => {
+      const valid = personalData.filter(d => d[key] !== null);
+      if (valid.length === 0) return 0;
+      return valid.reduce((s, d) => s + ((d[key] as number) || 0), 0) / valid.length;
+    };
+    return {
+      count: personalData.length,
+      avg1m: calc('return_1m'),
+      avg3m: calc('return_3m'),
+      avg6m: calc('return_6m'),
+      avgYtd: calc('return_ytd'),
+      avgSince: calc('return_since'),
+    };
+  }, [personalData]);
+
+  const latestUpdate = personalData.reduce((latest, d) => {
+    if (!d.updated_at) return latest;
+    return !latest || new Date(d.updated_at) > new Date(latest) ? d.updated_at : latest;
+  }, '' as string);
+
+  const renderReturnCard = (label: string, val: number) => (
+    <StatCard
+      label={label}
+      value={`${val >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${val.toFixed(2)}%`}
+      color={getReturnColor(val)}
+    />
+  );
+
+  return (
+    <div>
+      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 24 }}>
+        <Space align="center">
+          <BankOutlined style={{ fontSize: 24, color: '#1677ff' }} />
+          <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>招商银行持仓理财</Title>
+        </Space>
+        <Space>
+          {latestUpdate && (
+            <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
+              最后更新: {new Date(latestUpdate).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}
+            </Text>
+          )}
+          <Button
+            icon={<ReloadOutlined spin={updating} />}
+            onClick={handleUpdate}
+            loading={updating}
+          >
+            更新数据
+          </Button>
+        </Space>
+      </div>

+      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
+        <StatCard label="产品数量" value={String(personalStats.count)} color="#1677ff" />
+        {renderReturnCard('平均近1月', personalStats.avg1m)}
+        {renderReturnCard('平均近3月', personalStats.avg3m)}

+type Frequency = 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly';
+
+const FREQ_CONFIG: Record<Frequency, { label: string; amountLabel: string; periodLabel: string; periodsPerYear: number; defaultAmount: number }> = {
+  daily:   { label: '每日',  amountLabel: '每日定投金额（元）',  periodLabel: '定投期限（月）', periodsPerYear: 252, defaultAmount: 100 },
+  weekly:  { label: '每周',  amountLabel: '每周定投金额（元）',  periodLabel: '定投期限（月）', periodsPerYear: 52,  defaultAmount: 500 },
+  monthly: { label: '每月',  amountLabel: '每月定投金额（元）',  periodLabel: '定投期限（月）', periodsPerYear: 12,  defaultAmount: 1000 },
+};
+
+// 交易日/月 和 周/月 的近似值
+const TRADING_DAYS_PER_MONTH = 22;
+const WEEKS_PER_MONTH = 4.33;
+
+interface PeriodDetail {
+  index: number;
+  investment: number;
+  cumulativeInvestment: number;
+  value: number;
+  returnRate: number;
+}
 
 interface DCAResult {
   totalInvestment: number;
   totalValue: number;
   totalReturn: number;
   annualizedReturn: number;
-  monthlyDetails: {
-    month: number;
-    investment: number;
-    cumulativeInvestment: number;
-    value: number;
-    return: number;
-  }[];
+  details: PeriodDetail[];
+  totalPeriods: number;
+}
+
+function calculateDCA(amount: number, months: number, annualRate: number, freq: Frequency): DCAResult {
+  const cfg = FREQ_CONFIG[freq];
+  const periodRate = annualRate / 100 / cfg.periodsPerYear;
+
+  let totalPeriods: number;
+  if (freq === 'daily') totalPeriods = Math.round(months * TRADING_DAYS_PER_MONTH);
+  else if (freq === 'weekly') totalPeriods = Math.round(months * WEEKS_PER_MONTH);
+  else totalPeriods = months;
+
+  let totalValue = 0;
+  const details: PeriodDetail[] = [];
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < totalPeriods; i++) {
+    totalValue = (totalValue + amount) * (1 + periodRate);
+    const cumulativeInvestment = amount * (i + 1);
+    details.push({
+      index: i + 1,
+      investment: amount,
+      cumulativeInvestment,
+      value: parseFloat(totalValue.toFixed(2)),
+      returnRate: parseFloat((((totalValue - cumulativeInvestment) / cumulativeInvestment) * 100).toFixed(2)),
+    });
+  }
+
+  const totalInvestment = amount * totalPeriods;
+  const totalReturn = totalInvestment > 0 ? ((totalValue - totalInvestment) / totalInvestment) * 100 : 0;
+  const years = months / 12;
+  const annualizedReturn = years > 0 ? (Math.pow(totalValue / totalInvestment, 1 / years) - 1) * 100 : 0;
+
+  return {
+    totalInvestment,
+    totalValue: parseFloat(totalValue.toFixed(2)),
+    totalReturn: parseFloat(totalReturn.toFixed(2)),
+    annualizedReturn: parseFloat(annualizedReturn.toFixed(2)),
+    details,
+    totalPeriods,
+  };
 }

+import { useState } from 'react';
+import { Card, Select, Button, Table, Tag, Typography, Space, Spin, Divider, message } from 'antd';
+import { BarChartOutlined, LockOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
+import ReactECharts from 'echarts-for-react';
+import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
+import { fundCompareApi } from '../services/api';
+import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
+import { useTheme } from '../contexts/ThemeContext';
+import { formatReturn, getReturnColor } from '../utils/format';
+
+const { Title, Text, Paragraph } = Typography;
+
+export default function FundCompare() {
+  const navigate = useNavigate();
+  const { user } = useAuth();
+  const { isDark } = useTheme();
+  const [codes, setCodes] = useState<string[]>([]);
+  const [basicData, setBasicData] = useState<any>(null);
+  const [premiumData, setPremiumData] = useState<any>(null);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
+  const [premiumLoading, setPremiumLoading] = useState(false);
+
+  const handleCompare = async () => {
+    if (codes.length < 2) return message.warning('请输入至少2只基金代码');
+    setLoading(true);
+    try {
+      const data = await fundCompareApi.analyze(codes);
+      setBasicData(data);
+    } catch (e: any) {
+      message.error(e.message || '对比失败');
+    } finally {
+      setLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const handlePremium = async () => {
+    if (!user) return navigate('/login');
+    setPremiumLoading(true);
+    try {
+      const data = await fundCompareApi.premiumAnalyze(codes);
+      setPremiumData(data);
+    } catch (e: any) {
+      if (e.message?.includes('会员')) {
+        message.warning('此功能需要开通会员');
+      } else {
+        message.error(e.message || '深度对比失败');
+      }
+    } finally {
+      setPremiumLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const navChartOption = basicData ? {
+    tooltip: { trigger: 'axis' },
+    legend: { data: basicData.funds.map((f: any) => f.name), top: 0 },
+    grid: { left: 60, right: 20, top: 40, bottom: 30 },
+    xAxis: { type: 'category', data: (Object.values(basicData.navHistories)[0] as any[])?.map((n: any) => n.nav_date) || [] },
+    yAxis: { type: 'value', name: '净值' },
+    series: basicData.funds.map((f: any) => ({
+      name: f.name,
+      type: 'line',
+      data: (basicData.navHistories[f.code] || []).map((n: any) => parseFloat(n.nav)),
+      smooth: true,
+    })),
+  } : null;
+
+  const returnChartOption = basicData ? {
+    tooltip: { trigger: 'axis' },
+    legend: { data: ['近1月', '近3月', '近6月', '近1年'] },
+    grid: { left: 80, right: 20, top: 40, bottom: 30 },
+    xAxis: { type: 'category', data: basicData.funds.map((f: any) => f.name) },
+    yAxis: { type: 'value', name: '收益率(%)' },
+    series: [
+      { name: '近1月', type: 'bar', data: basicData.funds.map((f: any) => parseFloat(f.return_1m) || 0) },
+      { name: '近3月', type: 'bar', data: basicData.funds.map((f: any) => parseFloat(f.return_3m) || 0) },
+      { name: '近6月', type: 'bar', data: basicData.funds.map((f: any) => parseFloat(f.return_6m) || 0) },
+      { name: '近1年', type: 'bar', data: basicData.funds.map((f: any) => parseFloat(f.return_1y) || 0) },
+    ],
+  } : null;
+
+  return (
+    <div>
+      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+        <Title level={4}><BarChartOutlined /> 基金对比工具</Title>
+        <Space wrap style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
+          <Select mode="tags" placeholder="输入基金代码（2-5只）" style={{ minWidth: 300, maxWidth: 500 }}
+            value={codes} onChange={setCodes} maxCount={5} tokenSeparators={[',', ' ', '\n']} />
+          <Button type="primary" loading={loading} onClick={handleCompare} disabled={codes.length < 2}>开始对比</Button>
+          {basicData && (
+            <Button loading={premiumLoading} onClick={handlePremium} icon={<LockOutlined />}>
+              深度分析{!user ? '（需登录）' : ''}
+            </Button>
+          )}
+        </Space>
+      </Card>
+
+      {basicData && (
+        <>
+          {/* 基础对比表 */}
+          <Card title="基础对比" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+            <Table dataSource={basicData.funds} rowKey="code" size="small" pagination={false} scroll={{ x: 800 }}
+              columns={[
+                { title: '基金名称', dataIndex: 'name', fixed: 'left', width: 200 },
+                { title: '代码', dataIndex: 'code', width: 80 },
+                { title: '类型', dataIndex: 'type', width: 50, render: (v: string) => <Tag>{v}</Tag> },
+                { title: '最新净值', dataIndex: 'nav', width: 90, render: (v: any) => parseFloat(v).toFixed(4) },
+                { title: '近1周', dataIndex: 'return_1w', width: 80, render: (v: any) => <span style={{ color: getReturnColor(parseFloat(v)) }}>{formatReturn(parseFloat(v))}</span> },
+                { title: '近1月', dataIndex: 'return_1m', width: 80, render: (v: any) => <span style={{ color: getReturnColor(parseFloat(v)) }}>{formatReturn(parseFloat(v))}</span> },
+                { title: '近3月', dataIndex: 'return_3m', width: 80, render: (v: any) => <span style={{ color: getReturnColor(parseFloat(v)) }}>{formatReturn(parseFloat(v))}</span> },
+                { title: '近6月', dataIndex: 'return_6m', width: 80, render: (v: any) => <span style={{ color: getReturnColor(parseFloat(v)) }}>{formatReturn(parseFloat(v))}</span> },
+                { title: '近1年', dataIndex: 'return_1y', width: 80, render: (v: any) => <span style={{ color: getReturnColor(parseFloat(v)) }}>{formatReturn(parseFloat(v))}</span> },
+                { title: '综合费率', dataIndex: 'total_fee', width: 90, render: (v: any) => `${v}%` },
+                { title: '规模(亿)', dataIndex: 'scale', width: 80, render: (v: any) => parseFloat(v).toFixed(1) },
+              ]}
+            />
+          </Card>
+
+          {/* 净值走势 */}
+          <Card title="净值走势对比" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+            <ReactECharts option={navChartOption} style={{ height: 400 }} theme={isDark ? 'dark' : undefined} />
+          </Card>
+
+          {/* 收益对比 */}
+          <Card title="收益率对比" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+            <ReactECharts option={returnChartOption} style={{ height: 350 }} theme={isDark ? 'dark' : undefined} />
+          </Card>
+        </>
+      )}
+
+      {/* 付费深度分析 */}
+      {premiumData && (
+        <>
+          <Divider>深度分析</Divider>
+
+          {/* 风险指标 */}
+          <Card title="风险指标" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+            <Table dataSource={premiumData.results} rowKey="code" size="small" pagination={false}
+              columns={[
+                { title: '基金', dataIndex: 'name' },
+                { title: '年化波动率(%)', render: (_: any, r: any) => r.riskMetrics.volatility },
+                { title: '最大回撤(%)', render: (_: any, r: any) => <span style={{ color: '#ff4d4f' }}>{r.riskMetrics.maxDrawdown}%</span> },
+                { title: '夏普比率', render: (_: any, r: any) => <span style={{ color: r.riskMetrics.sharpeRatio > 0 ? '#52c41a' : '#ff4d4f' }}>{r.riskMetrics.sharpeRatio}</span> },
+                { title: '卡玛比率', render: (_: any, r: any) => r.riskMetrics.calmarRatio },
+                { title: '3年持有成本(%)', render: (_: any, r: any) => `${r.feeComparison.cost3y}%` },
+              ]}
+            />
+          </Card>
+
+          {/* 投资建议 */}
+          <Card title="投资建议" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+            <Space direction="vertical" style={{ width: '100%' }}>
+              <Paragraph><Tag color="blue">短期（1月内）</Tag> {premiumData.recommendation.shortTerm}</Paragraph>
+              <Paragraph><Tag color="green">中期（3-6月）</Tag> {premiumData.recommendation.mediumTerm}</Paragraph>
+              <Paragraph><Tag color="purple">长期（1年+）</Tag> {premiumData.recommendation.longTerm}</Paragraph>
+              <Paragraph><Tag color="orange">最低费率</Tag> {premiumData.recommendation.lowestFee}</Paragraph>
+            </Space>
+          </Card>
+
+          {/* 业绩归因 */}
+          <Card title="各时段表现最优" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+            <Space wrap>
+              {Object.entries(premiumData.attribution).map(([key, val]: any) => (
+                <Tag key={key} color={val.winner === premiumData.results[0]?.code ? 'green' : 'default'}>
+                  {val.label}：{val.winner}（{formatReturn(val.value)}）
+                </Tag>
+              ))}
+            </Space>
+          </Card>
+        </>
+      )}
+
+      {!basicData && !loading && (
+        <Card style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 60 }}>
+          <BarChartOutlined style={{ fontSize: 64, color: isDark ? '#444' : '#d9d9d9' }} />
+          <Title level={4} type="secondary">输入基金代码开始对比</Title>
+          <Text type="secondary">支持2-5只基金同时对比，基础功能免费使用</Text>
+        </Card>
+      )}
+    </div>
+  );
+}

+import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

+interface ScoreDetail {
+  score: number;
+  label: string;
+  detail: string;
+  percentile?: number;
+}
+
+interface DiagnosisData {
+  fund: {
+    code: string;
+    name: string;
+    type: string;
+    industry: string;
+    nav: number | null;
+    return1y: number;
+    return6m: number;
+    return3m: number;
+    return1m: number;
+    totalFee: number;
+    scale: number;
+    rating: number;
+    manager: string;
+    buySuggestion: string;
+  };
+  scores: {
+    profitability: ScoreDetail;
+    riskResistance: ScoreDetail;
+    costEfficiency: ScoreDetail;
+    scaleStability: ScoreDetail;
+    managerAbility: ScoreDetail;
+  };
+  totalScore: number;
+  peerCount: number;
+  diagnosis: {
+    level: string;
+    summary: string;
+    advantages: string[];
+    risks: string[];
+    suggestion: string;
+  };
+  generatedAt: string;
+}
+
+const SCORE_DIMENSIONS = [
+  { key: 'profitability', label: '盈利能力', max: 30, icon: <ThunderboltOutlined />, color: '#ff4d4f' },
+  { key: 'riskResistance', label: '抗风险力', max: 25, icon: <SafetyOutlined />, color: '#1677ff' },
+  { key: 'costEfficiency', label: '费率优势', max: 15, icon: <DollarOutlined />, color: '#52c41a' },
+  { key: 'scaleStability', label: '规模稳定性', max: 15, icon: <FundOutlined />, color: '#722ed1' },
+  { key: 'managerAbility', label: '经理能力', max: 15, icon: <UserOutlined />, color: '#fa8c16' },
+];
+
+const LEVEL_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
+  'A+': '#52c41a',
+  'A': '#73d13d',
+  'B+': '#1677ff',
+  'B': '#4096ff',
+  'C': '#faad14',
+  'D': '#ff4d4f',
+};
+
+function getScoreColor(score: number, max: number): string {
+  const ratio = score / max;
+  if (ratio >= 0.8) return '#52c41a';
+  if (ratio >= 0.6) return '#1677ff';
+  if (ratio >= 0.4) return '#faad14';
+  return '#ff4d4f';
+}

+import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+import { Card, Row, Col, Table, Tag, Spin, Alert, Empty, Progress } from 'antd';
+import { WarningOutlined, CheckCircleOutlined, PieChartOutlined, FundOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
+import ReactECharts from 'echarts-for-react';
+import { fundApi } from '../services/api';
+import { useTheme } from '../contexts/ThemeContext';
+import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
+
+interface OverlapPair {
+  industry: string;
+  funds: { code: string; name: string; shares: number }[];
+  fundCount: number;
+  weight: number;
+  riskLevel: string;
+}
+
+interface IndustryAllocation {
+  industry: string;
+  funds: { code: string; name: string; shares: number }[];
+  fundCount: number;
+  weight: number;
+}
+
+interface TypeDistribution {
+  type: string;
+  weight: number;
+}
+
+interface OverlapData {
+  overlapPairs: OverlapPair[];
+  industryAllocation: IndustryAllocation[];
+  typeDistribution: TypeDistribution[];
+  summary: {
+    totalFunds: number;
+    industryCount: number;
+    typeCount: number;
+    hhi: number;
+    concentrationLevel: string;
+    concentrationAdvice: string;
+    topIndustry: string;
+    topIndustryWeight: string;
+  };
+}
+
+export default function PortfolioOverlap() {
+  const { isDark } = useTheme();
+  const [data, setData] = useState<OverlapData | null>(null);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+  const [error, setError] = useState('');
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    loadData();
+  }, []);
+
+  const loadData = async () => {
+    setLoading(true);
+    setError('');
+    try {
+      const result = await fundApi.getPortfolioOverlap();
+      if (result.error) {
+        setError(result.error);
+      } else {
+        setData(result);
+      }
+    } catch (e: any) {
+      setError(e.message || '加载失败');
+    } finally {
+      setLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const getConcentrationColor = (level: string) => {
+    if (level.includes('高度')) return '#ff4d4f';
+    if (level.includes('中度')) return '#faad14';
+    return '#52c41a';
+  };
+
+  const getRiskColor = (level: string) => {
+    if (level === 'high') return '#ff4d4f';
+    if (level === 'medium') return '#faad14';
+    return '#52c41a';
+  };
+
+  const getPieOption = () => {
+    if (!data?.industryAllocation) return {};
+    return {
+      tooltip: { trigger: 'item', formatter: '{b}: {d}%' },
+      legend: { orient: 'vertical', right: 10, top: 'center', textStyle: { color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666', fontSize: 11 } },
+      series: [{
+        type: 'pie',
+        radius: ['40%', '70%'],
+        center: ['40%', '50%'],
+        data: data.industryAllocation.slice(0, 10).map(ia => ({
+          name: ia.industry,
+          value: parseFloat(ia.weight.toFixed(1)),
+        })),
+        emphasis: { itemStyle: { shadowBlur: 10, shadowOffsetX: 0, shadowColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)' } },
+        label: { show: false },
+      }],
+    };
+  };
+
+  const getTypePieOption = () => {
+    if (!data?.typeDistribution) return {};
+    return {
+      tooltip: { trigger: 'item', formatter: '{b}: {d}%' },
+      series: [{
+        type: 'pie',
+        radius: ['40%', '70%'],
+        data: data.typeDistribution.map(td => ({
+          name: td.type,
+          value: parseFloat(td.weight.toFixed(1)),
+        })),
+        label: { show: true, formatter: '{b}\n{d}%', fontSize: 11 },
+      }],
+    };
+  };
+
+  if (loading) {
+    return <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 80 }}><Spin size="large" tip="分析持仓重叠..." /></div>;
+  }
+
+  if (error) {
+    return (
+      <div>
+        <h1 style={{ marginBottom: 24, fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 600 }}>
+          <PieChartOutlined style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />持仓重叠分析
+        </h1>
+        <Empty description={error} />
+      </div>
+    );
+  }
+
+  if (!data) return null;
+
+  return (
+    <div className="fade-in">
+      <h1 style={{ marginBottom: 8, fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 600, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
+        <PieChartOutlined style={{ color: '#1677ff' }} />
+        持仓重叠分析
+      </h1>
+      <p style={{ marginBottom: 24, fontSize: 13, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666' }}>
+        分析您的持仓基金在行业和类型上的重叠情况，帮助优化资产配置
+      </p>
+
+      {/* 概览卡片 */}
+      <Row gutter={16} style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
+        <Col xs={12} sm={6}>
+          <Card style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: '#1677ff' }}>{data.summary.totalFunds}</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666' }}>持仓基金数</div>
+          </Card>
+        </Col>
+        <Col xs={12} sm={6}>
+          <Card style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: '#722ed1' }}>{data.summary.industryCount}</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666' }}>覆盖行业数</div>
+          </Card>
+        </Col>
+        <Col xs={12} sm={6}>
+          <Card style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: getConcentrationColor(data.summary.concentrationLevel) }}>{data.summary.concentrationLevel}</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666' }}>集中度评估</div>
+          </Card>
+        </Col>
+        <Col xs={12} sm={6}>
+          <Card style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: '#faad14' }}>{data.summary.hhi}</div>
+            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isDark ? '#a0a0a0' : '#666' }}>HHI指数</div>
+          </Card>
+        </Col>
+      </Row>
+
+      {/* 集中度建议 */}
+      <Alert
+        type={data.summary.concentrationLevel.includes('高度') ? 'warning' : data.summary.concentrationLevel.includes('中度') ? 'info' : 'success'}
+        message={data.summary.concentrationLevel}
+        description={data.summary.concentrationAdvice}
+        showIcon
+        style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}
+      />
+

+import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
+import { Card, Button, Typography, Space, Tag, Table, Modal, message, Spin, Result } from 'antd';
+import { CrownOutlined, CheckCircleOutlined, ShoppingOutlined, LockOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
+import { subscriptionApi } from '../services/api';
+import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
+import { useTheme } from '../contexts/ThemeContext';
+
+const { Title, Text, Paragraph } = Typography;
+
+export default function Subscription() {
+  const { user, setUser } = useAuth();
+  const { isDark } = useTheme();
+  const [plans, setPlans] = useState<any[]>([]);
+  const [status, setStatus] = useState<any>(null);
+  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<any[]>([]);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+  const [qrModal, setQrModal] = useState(false);
+  const [qrBase64, setQrBase64] = useState('');
+  const [outTradeNo, setOutTradeNo] = useState('');
+  const [paying, setPaying] = useState(false);
+  const [paySuccess, setPaySuccess] = useState(false);
+  const pollRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    loadData();
+  }, []);
+
+  const loadData = async () => {
+    try {
+      const [plansRes, statusRes, ordersRes] = await Promise.all([
+        subscriptionApi.getPlans(),
+        subscriptionApi.getStatus(),
+        subscriptionApi.getOrders(),
+      ]);
+      setPlans(plansRes.plans);
+      setStatus(statusRes);
+      setOrders(ordersRes.orders);
+    } catch (e: any) {
+      message.error(e.message || '加载失败');
+    } finally {
+      setLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const handleSubscribe = async (planId: number) => {
+    try {
+      setPaying(true);
+      const res = await subscriptionApi.createOrder(planId);
+      setOutTradeNo(res.outTradeNo);
+      setQrBase64(res.qrCodeBase64);
+      setQrModal(true);
+      setPaySuccess(false);
+      // 轮询支付结果
+      pollRef.current = setInterval(async () => {
+        try {
+          const check = await subscriptionApi.checkOrder(res.outTradeNo);
+          if (check.paid) {
+            clearInterval(pollRef.current!);
+            setPaySuccess(true);
+            message.success('开通成功！');
+            loadData();
+            // 更新AuthContext中的user
+            if (user && setUser) {
+              setUser({ ...user, subscription_status: 'premium' });
+            }
+          }
+        } catch (e) { console.error('支付状态轮询失败:', e); }
+      }, 3000);
+    } catch (e: any) {
+      message.error(e.message || '创建订单失败');
+    } finally {
+      setPaying(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const handleCloseModal = () => {
+    setQrModal(false);
+    if (pollRef.current) clearInterval(pollRef.current);
+  };
+
+  if (loading) return <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 80 }}><Spin size="large" /></div>;
+
+  const isPremium = status?.isPremium;
+
+  return (
+    <div style={{ maxWidth: 800, margin: '0 auto' }}>
+      {/* 当前状态 */}
+      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24, textAlign: 'center', background: isPremium ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd700 0%, #ffed4a 100%)' : undefined }}>
+        <Space direction="vertical" size="middle" style={{ width: '100%' }}>
+          {isPremium ? (
+            <>
+              <CrownOutlined style={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#d48806' }} />
+              <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0, color: '#614700' }}>尊享会员</Title>
+              <Text style={{ color: '#876800' }}>到期时间：{new Date(status.expiresAt).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}（剩余{status.daysRemaining}天）</Text>
+              <Tag color="gold">{status.planName}</Tag>
+            </>
+          ) : (
+            <>
+              <LockOutlined style={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#999' }} />
+              <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>免费用户</Title>
+              <Text type="secondary">开通会员解锁全部功能</Text>
+            </>
+          )}
+        </Space>
+      </Card>
+
+      {/* 套餐卡片 */}
+      {plans.map(plan => (
+        <Card key={plan.id} style={{ marginBottom: 24 }} hoverable>
+          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 16 }}>
+            <div>
+              <Title level={4} style={{ margin: 0 }}>{plan.name}</Title>
+              <Title level={2} style={{ margin: '8px 0', color: '#1677ff' }}>
+                ¥{plan.price}<Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 14 }}> / {plan.duration_days}天</Text>
+              </Title>
+              <Space wrap>
+                {(plan.features || []).map((f: string, i: number) => (
+                  <Tag key={i} icon={<CheckCircleOutlined />} color="success">{f}</Tag>
+                ))}
+              </Space>
+            </div>
+            <Button type="primary" size="large" icon={<ShoppingOutlined />} loading={paying}
+              onClick={() => handleSubscribe(plan.id)} disabled={isPremium}>
+              {isPremium ? '已开通' : '立即开通'}
+            </Button>
+          </div>
+        </Card>
+      ))}
+
+      {/* 订单历史 */}
+      {orders.length > 0 && (
+        <Card title="订单记录">
+          <Table dataSource={orders} rowKey="id" size="small" pagination={false}
+            columns={[
+              { title: '套餐', dataIndex: 'plan_name' },
+              { title: '金额', dataIndex: 'amount', render: (v: number) => `¥${v}` },
+              { title: '状态', dataIndex: 'status', render: (v: string) => <Tag color={v === 'paid' ? 'green' : 'orange'}>{v === 'paid' ? '已支付' : '待支付'}</Tag> },
+              { title: '时间', dataIndex: 'created_at', render: (v: string) => new Date(v).toLocaleString('zh-CN') },
+            ]}
+          />
+        </Card>
+      )}
+
+      {/* 支付二维码弹窗 */}
+      <Modal open={qrModal} onCancel={handleCloseModal} footer={null} width={360} title="支付宝扫码支付">
+        {paySuccess ? (
+          <Result status="success" title="开通成功" subTitle="会员权益已生效" />
+        ) : (
+          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 20 }}>
+            {qrBase64 ? (
+              <img src={qrBase64} alt="支付宝二维码" style={{ width: 260, height: 260 }} />
+            ) : (
+              <div style={{ width: 260, height: 260, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', background: isDark ? '#1f1f1f' : '#f5f5f5', margin: '0 auto' }}>
+                <Text type="secondary">二维码生成中...</Text>
+              </div>
+            )}
+            <Paragraph style={{ marginTop: 16 }} type="secondary">请使用支付宝扫描二维码完成支付</Paragraph>
+            <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>支付完成后页面将自动刷新</Text>
+          </div>
+        )}
+      </Modal>
+    </div>
+  );

+import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+import { Card, Row, Col, Tag, Spin, Space, Tooltip, Button, Select, Empty } from 'antd';
+import { BarChartOutlined, RiseOutlined, FallOutlined, InfoCircleOutlined, ReloadOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
+import ReactECharts from 'echarts-for-react';
+import { fundApi } from '../services/api';
+import { useTheme } from '../contexts/ThemeContext';
+import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
+
+interface IndexValuation {
+  code: string;
+  name: string;
+  price: number | null;
+  changePercent: number | null;
+  pe: number | null;
+  pb: number | null;
+  pePercentile: number | null;
+  pbPercentile: number | null;
+  roe: number | null;
+  dividendYield: number | null;
+  valuation: string | null;
+  suggestion: string | null;
+  history: {
+    dataPoints: number;
+    peMin: number | null;
+    peMax: number | null;
+    peAvg: number | null;
+    pbMin: number | null;
+    pbMax: number | null;
+    pbAvg: number | null;
+  };
+  trend: { pe: number; pb: number; date: string }[];
+}
+
+const getValuationColor = (p: number | null) => {
+  if (p === null || p === undefined) return '#999';
+  if (p < 20) return '#52c41a';
+  if (p < 40) return '#73d13d';
+  if (p < 60) return '#1677ff';
+  if (p < 80) return '#faad14';
+  return '#ff4d4f';
+};
+
+const getValuationBg = (p: number | null, isDark: boolean) => {
+  if (isDark) {
+    if (p === null || p === undefined) return '#262626';
+    if (p < 20) return '#162312';
+    if (p < 40) return '#111d2c';
+    if (p < 60) return '#111a2c';
+    if (p < 80) return '#2b2111';
+    return '#2c1618';
+  }
+  if (p === null || p === undefined) return '#f5f5f5';
+  if (p < 20) return '#f6ffed';
+  if (p < 40) return '#e6fffb';
+  if (p < 60) return '#e6f4ff';
+  if (p < 80) return '#fffbe6';
+  return '#fff2f0';
+};
+
+const getValuationLabel = (p: number | null) => {
+  if (p === null || p === undefined) return '未知';
+  if (p < 20) return '极度低估';
+  if (p < 40) return '偏低估';
+  if (p < 60) return '合理';
+  if (p < 80) return '偏高估';
+  return '极度高估';
+};
+
+export default function ValuationCenter() {
+  const { isDark } = useTheme();
+  const [indices, setIndices] = useState<IndexValuation[]>([]);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+  const [selectedCode, setSelectedCode] = useState<string>('');
+  const [trendData, setTrendData] = useState<any[]>([]);
+  const [trendLoading, setTrendLoading] = useState(false);
+  const [trendDays, setTrendDays] = useState(365);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    loadData();
+  }, []);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (selectedCode) loadTrend(selectedCode, trendDays);
+  }, [selectedCode, trendDays]);
+
+  const loadData = async () => {
+    setLoading(true);
+    try {
+      const data = await fundApi.getValuationCenter();
+      setIndices(data);
+      if (data.length > 0 && !selectedCode) {
+        setSelectedCode(data[0].code);
+      }
+    } catch (e) {
+      console.error('加载估值数据失败:', e);
+    } finally {
+      setLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const loadTrend = async (code: string, days: number) => {
+    setTrendLoading(true);
+    try {
+      const result = await fundApi.getIndexValuationTrend(code, days);
+      setTrendData(result?.data || []);
+    } catch (e) {

+    } finally {

+      return `${date.getFullYear()}/${(date.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}/${date.getDate().toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
+    });
+    const peValues = trendData.map(d => d.pe);
+    const pbValues = trendData.map(d => d.pb);
+
+    return {
+      tooltip: {
+        trigger: 'axis',

+          let html = `<div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">${date}</div>`;

+      grid: { top: 40, left: 50, right: 50, bottom: 30 },
+      xAxis: { type: 'category', data: dates, axisLabel: { color: isDark ? '#6b6b6b' : '#999', fontSize: 11 } },
+      yAxis: [

+// Gauge chart component
+function GaugeChart({ value, title, color, max }: { value: number; title: string; color: string; max?: number }) {
+  const option = {
+    series: [{
+      type: 'gauge',
+      startAngle: 210,
+      endAngle: -30,
+      min: 0,
+      max: max || 100,
+      splitNumber: 5,
+      axisLine: { lineStyle: { width: 12, color: [[1, color]] } },
+      pointer: { itemStyle: { color }, length: '60%', width: 4 },
+      axisTick: { show: false },
+      splitLine: { length: 8, lineStyle: { color: '#999', width: 1 } },
+      axisLabel: { distance: 16, fontSize: 9, color: '#999' },
+      detail: { valueAnimation: true, formatter: max ? '{value}' : '{value}%', fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, color, offsetCenter: [0, '70%'] },
+      title: { offsetCenter: [0, '90%'], fontSize: 11, color: '#666' },
+      data: [{ value, name: title }],
+    }],
+  };
+  return <ReactECharts option={option} style={{ height: 160 }} />;
+}

+// Real-time metrics line chart
+function MetricsChart({ data }: { data: { timestamp: number; qps: number; cacheHit: number; connections: number; slowQueries: number }[] }) {
+  const option = {
+    tooltip: { trigger: 'axis' },
+    legend: { data: ['QPS', '缓存命中率(%)', '活跃连接', '慢查询'], bottom: 0 },
+    grid: { left: 50, right: 50, top: 10, bottom: 45 },
+    xAxis: { type: 'category', data: data.map(d => new Date(d.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour12: false })), boundaryGap: false },
+    yAxis: [
+      { type: 'value', name: 'QPS / 连接', position: 'left' },
+      { type: 'value', name: '%', position: 'right', min: 0, max: 100 },
+    ],
+    series: [
+      { name: 'QPS', type: 'line', smooth: true, data: data.map(d => d.qps), lineStyle: { width: 2 }, areaStyle: { opacity: 0.15 }, color: '#1677ff' },
+      { name: '活跃连接', type: 'line', smooth: true, data: data.map(d => d.connections), lineStyle: { width: 2 }, color: '#52c41a' },
+      { name: '缓存命中率(%)', type: 'line', smooth: true, yAxisIndex: 1, data: data.map(d => d.cacheHit), lineStyle: { width: 2 }, color: '#faad14' },
+      { name: '慢查询', type: 'line', smooth: true, data: data.map(d => d.slowQueries), lineStyle: { width: 2 }, color: '#ff4d4f' },
+    ],
+  };
+  return <ReactECharts option={option} style={{ height: 280 }} />;

+// Health check component
+function HealthCheck() {
+  const [data, setData] = useState<any>(null);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+
+  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
+    try { setData(await adminApi.getHealthCheck()); }
+    catch (e) { console.error('健康检查失败:', e); message.error('健康检查失败'); }
+    finally { setLoading(false); }
+  }, []);
+
+  useEffect(() => { fetchData(); }, [fetchData]);
+
+  if (loading) return <Spin style={{ display: 'block', margin: '40px auto' }} />;
+  if (!data) return null;
+
+  const statusIcon = (s: string) => {
+    if (s === 'healthy') return <CheckCircleOutlined style={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: 18 }} />;
+    if (s === 'warning') return <WarningOutlined style={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: 18 }} />;
+    if (s === 'critical' || s === 'unhealthy') return <CloseCircleOutlined style={{ color: '#ff4d4f', fontSize: 18 }} />;
+    return <ExclamationCircleOutlined style={{ color: '#999', fontSize: 18 }} />;
+  };
+
+  const overallColor = data.status === 'healthy' ? '#52c41a' : data.status === 'warning' ? '#faad14' : '#ff4d4f';
+  const overallLabel = data.status === 'healthy' ? '健康' : data.status === 'warning' ? '警告' : '异常';
+
+  return (
+    <div>
+      <Card size="small" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
+        <Row gutter={16} align="middle">
+          <Col>
+            <Space>
+              <HeartOutlined style={{ fontSize: 28, color: overallColor }} />
+              <div>
+                <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 600, color: overallColor }}>系统{overallLabel}</div>
+                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-tertiary)' }}>检查耗时 {data.totalLatency}ms</div>
+              </div>
+            </Space>
+          </Col>
+          <Col flex="auto" />
+          <Col><Button icon={<ReloadOutlined />} onClick={fetchData}>重新检查</Button></Col>
+        </Row>
+      </Card>
+
+      <Row gutter={[12, 12]}>
+        {data.checks?.map((check: any, idx: number) => (
+          <Col xs={24} sm={12} md={8} key={idx}>
+            <Card size="small" hoverable style={{ borderLeft: `3px solid ${check.status === 'healthy' ? '#52c41a' : check.status === 'warning' ? '#faad14' : '#ff4d4f'}` }}>
+              <Space>
+                {statusIcon(check.status)}
+                <div>
+                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{check.name}</div>
+                  <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-tertiary)' }}>{check.detail}</div>
+                </div>
+              </Space>
+              {check.value !== undefined && (
+                <Progress percent={check.value} size="small" showInfo={false}
+                  strokeColor={check.value > 90 ? '#ff4d4f' : check.value > 70 ? '#faad14' : '#52c41a'}
+                  style={{ marginTop: 8 }} />
+              )}
+            </Card>
+          </Col>
+        ))}
+      </Row>
+    </div>
+  );
+}
